import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ArrowRight,
  BookOpen,
  CheckCircle2,
  Crosshair,
  FolderKanban,
  Lock,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { ProgressLine } from "@/components/patterns/progress-line";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";
import { SetFocusButton } from "@/components/focus/set-focus-button";
import { TaskRow } from "@/components/tasks/task-row";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { getFocusState } from "@/lib/data/focus";
import { listProjects } from "@/lib/data/projects";
import { listCourses } from "@/lib/data/courses";
import { listTasks } from "@/lib/data/tasks";
import { formatShortDatePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";
import { projectStageLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Meu foco" };

export default async function FocusPage() {
  const context = await getAppContext();

  if (!context.workspace) {
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-6">
        <PageHeader
          title="Meu foco"
          description="Seu espaço ainda não está pronto. Rode as migrações do Supabase para começar."
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const workspaceId = context.workspace.id;
  const [projects, courses, focus, tasks] = await Promise.all([
    listProjects({ workspaceId, today: context.today }),
    listCourses({ workspaceId, today: context.today }),
    getFocusState({
      workspaceId,
      userId: context.user.id,
      focusScope: context.workspace.focus_scope,
    }),
    listTasks({ workspaceId, today: context.today }),
  ]);

  const focusProject =
    projects.find((project) => project.id === focus.projectId) ?? null;
  const focusCourse =
    courses.find((course) => course.id === focus.courseId) ?? null;
  const otherProjects = projects.filter(
    (project) => project.id !== focus.projectId,
  );
  const otherCourses = courses.filter((course) => course.id !== focus.courseId);

  const todayQueue = tasks
    .filter((task) => task.dueState === "overdue" || task.dueState === "today")
    .slice(0, 6);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_24%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Uma decisão por vez"
        title="Meu foco"
        description="Um projeto e um curso por vez. O resto continua disponível, sem ser apagado."
        actions={
          <StatusChip
            label="1 projeto · 1 curso por espaço"
            tone="neutral"
            icon={Lock}
          />
        }
      />
      </section>

      <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(300px,1fr)]">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-5">
          <section
            aria-labelledby="projeto-principal"
            className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/30 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_20%,transparent),transparent_58%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] shadow-[var(--shadow-2)]"
          >
            <div className="h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-brand via-[#f26a1b] to-[#ffc857]" />
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
              {focusProject ? (
                <>
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <span className="grid size-10 flex-none place-items-center rounded-[10px] bg-brand-soft text-brand">
                      <Crosshair className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                        <StatusChip
                          label="Projeto principal"
                          tone="brand"
                          icon={Crosshair}
                        />
                        <StatusChip
                          label={projectStageLabel(focusProject.stage)}
                          tone="neutral"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <h2
                        id="projeto-principal"
                        className="mt-2 text-[19px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em]"
                      >
                        <Link
                          href={`/projetos/${focusProject.id}`}
                          className="text-ink no-underline hover:underline"
                        >
                          {focusProject.title}
                        </Link>
                      </h2>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                        {focusProject.objective ?? "Sem objetivo escrito ainda."}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4">
                    <ProgressLine progress={focusProject.progress} />
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-brand/30 bg-brand-soft p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] sm:p-5">
                    <p className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-[var(--brand-700)] uppercase">
                      Seu próximo passo
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                      <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed font-medium">
                        {focusProject.nextStep ??
                          "Abra o projeto e escreva o próximo passo em uma frase."}
                      </p>
                      <Link
                        href={`/projetos/${focusProject.id}`}
                        className="inline-flex h-9 flex-none items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-brand px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
                      >
                        Começar
                        <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div id="projeto-principal">
                  <EmptyState
                    icon={Crosshair}
                    title="Escolha seu projeto principal"
                    description="Ele aparece na visão geral e no seu dia. Você pode trocar quando quiser — o projeto anterior não é apagado."
                    action={
                      otherProjects[0] ? (
                        <SetFocusButton
                          workspaceId={workspaceId}
                          kind="project"
                          targetId={otherProjects[0].id}
                          targetTitle={otherProjects[0].title}
                          currentTitle={null}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <Link
                          href="/criar?tipo=projeto"
                          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-md bg-brand px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
                        >
                          Criar meu primeiro projeto
                        </Link>
                      )
                    }
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>

          <SectionCard
            title="Fila de hoje"
            description="Atrasadas primeiro, depois o que vence hoje."
            action={
              <Link
                href="/tarefas"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-brand no-underline hover:underline"
              >
                Ver todas <ArrowRight className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
              </Link>
            }
            bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0"
          >
            {todayQueue.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
                <EmptyState
                  icon={CheckCircle2}
                  title="Fila do dia zerada"
                  description="Nada atrasado e nada vencendo hoje. Você pode escolher uma tarefa da semana ou descansar."
                  compact
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                {todayQueue.map((task) => (
                  <TaskRow key={task.id} task={task} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard
            title="Curso principal"
            action={
              <Link
                href="/cursos"
                className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-brand no-underline hover:underline"
              >
                Ver cursos
              </Link>
            }
          >
            {focusCourse ? (
              <div className="grid gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span className="grid size-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-[10px] bg-[var(--success-050)] text-[var(--success-700)]">
                    <BookOpen className="size-[18px]" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="text-[14.5px] leading-snug font-semibold">
                      {focusCourse.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-faint">
                      {[
                        focusCourse.platform,
                        focusCourse.moduleCount > 0
                          ? `${focusCourse.doneModules} de ${focusCourse.moduleCount} módulos`
                          : null,
                        focusCourse.dueDate
                          ? `prazo ${formatShortDatePtBr(focusCourse.dueDate)}`
                          : null,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(" · ") || "Sem detalhes ainda"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <StatusChip
                    label={`${focusCourse.progress}%`}
                    tone="success"
                  />
                </div>
                <ProgressLine
                  progress={{
                    completedWeight: focusCourse.progress,
                    totalWeight: 100,
                    percent: focusCourse.progress,
                    label: "Progresso registrado do curso",
                  }}
                />
                {focusCourse.nextLesson ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2.5">
                    <ArrowRight
                      className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 flex-none text-brand"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                        Próxima aula
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] leading-snug font-medium">
                        {focusCourse.nextLesson}

                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <EmptyState
                icon={BookOpen}
                title="Nenhum curso principal"
                description="Estudar também é foco. Escolha um curso para acompanhar o progresso sem disputar atenção com o projeto."
                compact
                action={
                  otherCourses[0] ? (
                    <SetFocusButton
                      workspaceId={workspaceId}
                      kind="course"
                      targetId={otherCourses[0].id}
                      targetTitle={otherCourses[0].title}
                      currentTitle={null}
                    />
                  ) : undefined
                }
              />
            )}
          </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <aside className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-5">
          <SectionCard title="Trocar o foco">
            <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
              Só pode existir um projeto principal. Ao trocar, o anterior volta
              para a lista com todas as tarefas, arquivos e notas. Nada é
              apagado.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                Outros projetos
              </h3>
              {otherProjects.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                  Nenhum outro projeto disponível. Crie um para poder alternar.
                </p>
              ) : (
                otherProjects.slice(0, 6).map((project) => (
                  <div
                    key={project.id}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition hover:border-brand/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium">
                        {project.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">
                        {projectStageLabel(project.stage)} ·{" "}
                        {project.progress.percent}%
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <SetFocusButton
                      workspaceId={workspaceId}
                      kind="project"
                      targetId={project.id}
                      targetTitle={project.title}
                      currentTitle={
                        focusProject ? focusProject.title : null
                      }
                    />
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 grid gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                Outros cursos
              </h3>
              {otherCourses.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">
                  Nenhum outro curso disponível.
                </p>
              ) : (
                otherCourses.slice(0, 5).map((course) => (
                  <div
                    key={course.id}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition hover:border-brand/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium">
                        {course.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">
                        {course.progress}% concluído
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <SetFocusButton
                      workspaceId={workspaceId}
                      kind="course"
                      targetId={course.id}
                      targetTitle={course.title}
                      currentTitle={focusCourse ? focusCourse.title : null}
                    />
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed text-faint">
              <ShieldCheck
                className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 flex-none"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              A troca é registrada com autor, data e foco anterior. Dois
              dispositivos não conseguem definir focos diferentes ao mesmo
              tempo.
            </div>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="Fora do foco">
            {otherProjects.length === 0 && otherCourses.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                Tudo o que você tem já está no foco. Que tal registrar uma ideia
                para o futuro?
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                {otherProjects.slice(0, 4).map((project) => (
                  <Link
                    key={project.id}
                    href={`/projetos/${project.id}`}
                    className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-ink no-underline transition hover:border-brand/30 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
                  >
                    <FolderKanban
                      className="size-4 flex-none text-faint"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium">
                      {project.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">
                      {project.progress.percent}%
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
                {otherCourses.slice(0, 3).map((course) => (
                  <Link
                    key={course.id}
                    href="/cursos"
                    className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-ink no-underline transition hover:border-brand/30 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
                  >
                    <BookOpen
                      className="size-4 flex-none text-faint"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium">
                      {course.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">
                      {course.progress}%
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </SectionCard>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { History } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { listActivity } from "@/lib/data/activity";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { formatDateTimePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";
import { describeActivity } from "@/modules/tasks/kanban";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Histórico" };

const HREF: Record<string, (id: string | null) => string> = {
  project: (id) => (id ? `/projetos/${id}` : "/projetos"),
  task: () => "/tarefas/quadro",
  idea: () => "/backlog",
  course: () => "/cursos",
};

export default async function HistoryPage() {
  const context = await getAppContext();

  if (!context.workspace) {
    return (
      <PageHeader
        title="Histórico"
        description="Seu espaço ainda não está disponível. Rode as migrações do Supabase para começar."
      />
    );
  }

  const events = await listActivity(context.workspace.id);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_24%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
      <PageHeader
        title="Histórico"
        description="O que aconteceu no seu espaço, do mais recente ao mais antigo. Edições simples e mudanças de ordem não entram."
      />
      </section>

      {events.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={History}
          title="Ainda não há histórico"
          description="Criar, concluir, arquivar ou converter algo aparece aqui automaticamente."
        />
      ) : (
        <SectionCard title={`Últimos ${events.length} eventos`} bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0">
          <ol className="grid gap-3">
            {events.map((event) => {
              const mine = event.actorId === context.user.id;
              const text = describeActivity(
                event.verb,
                event.title,
                mine ? "Você" : "Alguém",
              );
              const href = (HREF[event.entityType] ?? (() => "/"))(event.entityId);
              return (
                <li key={event.id} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition hover:border-brand/35 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-3">
                  <Link href={href} className="min-w-0 text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed text-ink no-underline hover:text-brand hover:underline">
                    {text}
                  </Link>
                  <time dateTime={event.createdAt} className="text-xs text-faint sm:ml-auto">
                    {formatDateTimePtBr(event.createdAt)}
                  </time>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </SectionCard>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { restoreItemFormAction } from "@/lib/actions/mvp";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { listTrash } from "@/lib/data/search";
import { formatDateTimePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Lixeira" };

const KIND_LABELS = {
  projects: "Projeto",
  tasks: "Tarefa",
  ideas: "Ideia",
  courses: "Curso",
  files: "Arquivo",
} as const;

export default async function TrashPage() {
  const context = await getAppContext();

  if (!context.workspace) {
    return (
      <PageHeader
        title="Lixeira"
        description="Seu espaço ainda não está disponível. Rode as migrações do Supabase para começar."
      />
    );
  }

  const items = await listTrash(context.workspace.id);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_24%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
      <PageHeader
        title="Lixeira"
        description="Itens excluídos ficam aqui e podem ser restaurados. Itens com mais de 30 dias são removidos de vez pela limpeza diária."
      />
      </section>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Trash2}
          title="A lixeira está vazia"
          description="Quando você excluir uma tarefa, ideia ou arquivo, ela aparece aqui."
        />
      ) : (
        <SectionCard title={`${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? "item" : "itens"}`} bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0">
          <ul className="grid gap-3">
            {items.map((item) => (
              <li key={`${item.kind}-${item.id}`} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition hover:border-brand/35 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate text-[13.5px] font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">
                    {KIND_LABELS[item.kind]} · excluído em {formatDateTimePtBr(item.deletedAt)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <form action={restoreItemFormAction}>
                  <input type="hidden" name="kind" value={item.kind} />
                  <input type="hidden" name="id" value={item.id} />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    aria-label={`Restaurar ${item.title}`}
                    className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-brand/30 bg-surface px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-ink transition hover:border-brand hover:bg-surface-2 sm:w-auto"
                  >
                    Restaurar
                  </button>
                </form>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </SectionCard>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Bell, CheckCheck, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { markNotificationsReadAction } from "@/lib/actions/collab";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import {
  countUnreadNotifications,
  listNotifications,
} from "@/lib/data/notifications";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Notificações" };

function formatDate(value: string, timeZone: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    timeZone,
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

export default async function NotificationsPage() {
  const context = await getAppContext();
  const [items, unreadCount] = await Promise.all([
    listNotifications(50),
    countUnreadNotifications(),
  ]);
  const unread = items.filter((item) => !item.read);
  const read = items.filter((item) => item.read);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_24%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
      <PageHeader
        title="Notificações"
        description="Comentários, atribuições e mudanças nos seus espaços. Só aparece o que diz respeito à sua conta."
        actions={
          unreadCount > 0 ? (
            <form action={markNotificationsReadAction}>
              <Button type="submit" variant="outline" className="min-h-10 gap-2">
                <CheckCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                Marcar todas como lidas
              </Button>
            </form>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
      </section>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Bell}
          title="Nada por aqui"
          description="Quando alguém comentar ou atribuir uma tarefa a você, avisamos aqui."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <SectionCard
            title={`Novas · ${unreadCount}`}
            description="Atividades que ainda não foram marcadas como lidas."
            bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0"
          >
            {unread.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="px-4 py-5 text-sm text-muted">Nenhuma notificação nova.</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="grid gap-3">
                {unread.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-brand/30 bg-brand/[0.055] p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] sm:p-5">
                    <span aria-hidden="true" className="size-2 flex-none rounded-full bg-brand" />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink">{item.text}</p>
                      <time dateTime={item.createdAt} className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">
                        {formatDate(item.createdAt, context.timeZone)}
                      </time>
                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                        {item.href ? (
                          <Link href={item.href} className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand no-underline hover:underline">
                            Abrir conteúdo <ExternalLink className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </Link>
                        ) : null}
                        <form action={markNotificationsReadAction}>
                          <input type="hidden" name="notificationId" value={item.id} />
                          <button type="submit" className="min-h-9 text-xs font-medium text-muted hover:text-ink">
                            Marcar como lida
                          </button>
                        </form>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard
            title={`Anteriores · ${read.length}`}
            description="Notificações que você já marcou como lidas."
            bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0"
          >
            {read.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="px-4 py-5 text-sm text-muted">As notificações lidas aparecerão aqui.</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="grid gap-3">
                {read.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] sm:p-5">
                    <span aria-hidden="true" className="size-2 flex-none rounded-full bg-transparent" />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      {item.href ? (
                        <Link href={item.href} className={cn("text-[13.5px] text-muted no-underline hover:text-ink hover:underline")}>
                          {item.text}
                        </Link>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-[13.5px] text-muted">{item.text}</p>
                      )}
                      <time dateTime={item.createdAt} className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">
                        {formatDate(item.createdAt, context.timeZone)}
                      </time>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </SectionCard>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, EyeOff, Globe2, Link2, Lock, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";
import { EntryActions } from "@/components/portfolio/entry-actions";
import { PublishForm } from "@/components/portfolio/publish-form";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { listProjects } from "@/lib/data/projects";
import { canPublishPortfolio } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";
import { listPortfolioEntries } from "@/lib/data/portfolio";
import { formatDatePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Portfólio" };

const VISIBILITY_LABELS = {
  private: "Privado",
  unlisted: "Link não listado",
  public: "Público",
} as const;

export default async function PortfolioPage() {
  const context = await getAppContext();

  if (!context.workspace) {
    return (
      <PageHeader
        title="Portfólio"
        description="Seu espaço ainda não está disponível. Rode as migrações do Supabase para começar."
      />
    );
  }

  const [entries, projects] = await Promise.all([
    listPortfolioEntries(context.workspace.id),
    listProjects({ workspaceId: context.workspace.id, today: context.today }),
  ]);
  const canPublish = canPublishPortfolio(context.workspace.role);
  const activeProjectIds = new Set(
    entries.filter((e) => e.visibility !== "private" && !e.revokedAt).map((e) => e.projectId),
  );
  const publishable = projects
    .filter((project) => !activeProjectIds.has(project.id))
    .map(({ id, title }) => ({ id, title }));

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_24%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
<PageHeader
        eyebrow="Privado por padrão"
        title="Portfólio"
        description="Mostre seu trabalho sem abrir o espaço inteiro. Cada projeto publicado tem seu próprio link."
      />
</section>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(300px,1fr)]">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-5">
          <SectionCard
            title={`Publicações · ${entries.length}`}
            description="O portfólio nunca expõe tarefas, arquivos internos ou dados de outras pessoas."
          >
            {entries.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={Globe2}
                title="Nenhum projeto publicado"
                description="Seu espaço é privado. Quando quiser, escolha um projeto e crie um link não listado com token — revogável a qualquer momento."
                compact
                action={
                  <Link
                    href="/projetos"
                    className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink no-underline hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
                  >
                    Ver meus projetos
                    <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </Link>
                }
              />
            ) : (
              <ul className="grid gap-3">
                {entries.map((entry) => (
                  <li key={entry.id} className="rounded-[20px] border border-border bg-[linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] sm:p-5">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                      <StatusChip
                        label={VISIBILITY_LABELS[entry.visibility]}
                        tone={entry.visibility === "private" ? "neutral" : "brand"}
                        icon={
                          entry.visibility === "private" ? Lock : Link2
                        }
                      />
                      {entry.revokedAt ? (
                        <StatusChip label="Revogado" tone="danger" />
                      ) : null}
                      {entry.publishedAt ? (
                        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-faint">
                          {formatDatePtBr(entry.publishedAt.slice(0, 10))}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-[14px] font-semibold">
                      {entry.projectTitle}
                    </h3>
                    {entry.summary ? (
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                        {entry.summary}
                      </p>
                    ) : null}
                    {canPublish && entry.visibility === "unlisted" && !entry.revokedAt ? (
                      <EntryActions entryId={entry.id} />
                    ) : null}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="O link não listado">
            <div className="grid gap-3 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <Link2 className="mt-0.5 size-4 flex-none text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
                Quem tem o link e o token consegue abrir. Não aparece em buscadores
                e a resposta inclui <code className="rounded bg-surface-2 px-1">noindex</code>.
              </p>
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <EyeOff className="mt-0.5 size-4 flex-none text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
                O token fica só como hash no banco. Revogar invalida o link
                imediatamente, sem apagar o projeto.
              </p>
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 size-4 flex-none text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
                O projeto continua privado no app. Publicar é uma decisão
                separada e reversível.
              </p>
            </div>
          </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <aside className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-5">
          <SectionCard title="Publicar um projeto">
            {canPublish ? (
              <PublishForm projects={publishable} />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                Só editores, administradores e donos publicam no portfólio.
              </p>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="Privacidade por padrão">
            <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
              Nenhum projeto é público até você escolher. O portfólio é um recorte
              curado, não uma cópia do espaço de trabalho.
            </p>
          </SectionCard>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">{active.map(project=><ProjectCard key={project.id} project={project}/>)}</div>
        </section> : null}
        {paused.length ? <section className="grid gap-4" aria-labelledby="paused-projects"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-surface-2 text-muted"><PauseCircle className="size-4"/></span><div><h2 id="paused-projects" className="text-base font-semibold">Em pausa</h2><p className="text-xs text-muted">Projetos que podem ser retomados</p></div></div><div className="grid min-w-0 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">{paused.map(project=><ProjectCard key={project.id} project={project}/>)}</div></section> : null}
        {completed.length ? <section className="grid gap-4" aria-labelledby="completed-projects"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-[var(--success-050)] text-[var(--success-700)]"><CheckCircle2 className="size-4"/></span><div><h2 id="completed-projects" className="text-base font-semibold">Concluídos</h2><p className="text-xs text-muted">Entregas finalizadas e registradas</p></div></div><div className="grid min-w-0 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">{completed.map(project=><ProjectCard key={project.id} project={project}/>)}</div></section> : null}
      </div>}
      <Link href="/tarefas/quadro" className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface px-5 py-4 text-sm no-underline transition hover:border-brand/40 hover:bg-surface-2"><span><span className="block font-semibold text-ink">Acompanhe suas entregas no Kanban</span><span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-muted">Veja tarefas e andamento em um quadro visual.</span></span><ArrowUpRight className="size-5 shrink-0 text-brand"/></Link>
    </div>
  );
}

import Image from "next/image";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  ListChecks,
  Plus,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

import { CommentThread } from "@/components/comments/comment-thread";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { ProgressLine } from "@/components/patterns/progress-line";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { DueDateChip, StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";

type PageParams = Promise<{ id: string }>;

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: PageParams;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params;
  const context = await getAppContext().catch(() => null);

  if (!context?.workspace) return { title: "Projeto" };

  const project = await getProjectDetail({
    workspaceId: context.workspace.id,
    projectId: id,
    today: context.today,
  });

  return { title: project?.title ?? "Projeto" };
}

export default async function ProjectDetailPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: PageParams;
  searchParams: Promise<{ aviso?: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const { aviso } = await searchParams;
  const context = await getAppContext();

  if (!context.workspace) notFound();
  const workspace = context.workspace;

  const project = await getProjectDetail({
    workspaceId: workspace.id,
    projectId: id,
    today: context.today,
  });

  if (!project) notFound();

  const [tasks, workspaceProjects] = await Promise.all([listTasks({
    workspaceId: workspace.id,
    today: context.today,
    includeDone: true,
    projectId: project.id,
  }), listProjects({ workspaceId: workspace.id, today: context.today })]);
  const canEditProject = project.ownerId === context.user.id && canEditContent(workspace.role);
  const openTasks = tasks.filter((task) => task.status !== "done");
  const [comments, projectFiles] = await Promise.all([listComments({
    workspaceId: workspace.id,
    entityType: "project",
    entityId: project.id,
  }), listProjectFiles({ workspaceId: workspace.id, projectId: project.id })]);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-7">
      <div>
        <Link
          href="/projetos"
          className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface/80 px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-muted no-underline transition-colors hover:border-brand/40 hover:text-ink hover:no-underline"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          Voltar para projetos
        </Link>
      </div>

      {aviso === "foco" ? (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-md border border-warning/35 bg-warning-soft px-3.5 py-3 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink"
        >
          <ShieldAlert
            className="mt-0.5 size-4 flex-none text-[var(--warning-700)]"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          Projeto criado. Não foi possível defini-lo como principal agora — use
          “Definir como principal” na tela Meu foco.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_20%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
        <div className="relative z-10">
          <PageHeader
        eyebrow={<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">{project.coverUrl ? <Image src={project.coverUrl} alt="" width={20} height={20} sizes="20px" className="size-5 rounded-md object-cover" /> : project.emoji} Projeto</span>}
        title={project.title}
        description={project.objective ? <FileMentionText workspaceId={workspace.id} text={project.objective} /> : "Sem objetivo escrito ainda. Um objetivo ajuda a decidir o que fica de fora."}
        actions={
          <>
            <ProjectSwitcher currentProjectId={project.id} projects={workspaceProjects} />
            {canEditProject ? <ProjectDetailsEditor project={project} workspaceId={workspace.id} /> : null}
            <Link
              href={`/criar?tipo=tarefa&projeto=${project.id}`}
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-brand px-3.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
            >
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              Nova tarefa
            </Link>
          </>
        }
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      {canEditProject ? (
        <SectionCard title="Identidade do projeto" description="Use um emoji ou envie uma imagem para identificar o projeto nos cartões, listas e nesta página.">
          <ProjectEmojiEditor projectId={project.id} currentEmoji={project.emoji} currentImage={project.coverUrl} />
        </SectionCard>
      ) : null}

      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface/80 p-3 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] sm:p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <StatusChip label={projectStageLabel(project.stage)} tone="brand" />
        <StatusChip
          label={PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[project.status]}
          tone={project.status === "completed" ? "success" : "neutral"}
        />
        {project.dueDate ? (
          <DueDateChip state={project.dueState} />
        ) : (
          <StatusChip label="Sem prazo" tone="neutral" />
        )}
        {project.startDate ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-faint">
            <CalendarDays className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            Início em {formatDatePtBr(project.startDate)}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(280px,1fr)]">
        <div className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-6">
          <SectionCard title="Progresso">
            <ProgressLine progress={project.progress} />
            <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-faint">
              O progresso considera apenas as tarefas de primeiro nível ativas,
              com peso igual por padrão. Tarefas arquivadas não entram na conta.
            </p>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard
            title="Próximo passo"
            description="Uma frase clara sobre o que fazer em seguida."
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <span className="grid size-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-full bg-brand-soft text-brand">
                <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </span>
              <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed font-medium">
                {project.nextStep ? <FileMentionText workspaceId={workspace.id} text={project.nextStep} /> : "Ainda não definido. Escreva o próximo passo em uma frase curta e acionável."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard
            title={`Tarefas · ${openTasks.length} em aberto`}
            description="Concluir é um toque. Você pode desfazer em seguida."
            action={
              <Link
                href={`/criar?tipo=tarefa&projeto=${project.id}`}
                className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink no-underline hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
              >
                <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                Adicionar
              </Link>
            }
            bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0"
          >
            {tasks.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
                <EmptyState
                  icon={ListChecks}
                  title="Nenhuma tarefa ainda"
                  description="Divida o projeto em passos pequenos o suficiente para concluir em uma sentada."
                  compact
                  action={
                    <Link
                      href={`/criar?tipo=tarefa&projeto=${project.id}`}
                      className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-md bg-brand px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
                    >
                      Criar primeira tarefa
                    </Link>
                  }
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                {tasks.map((task) => (
                  <TaskRow key={task.id} task={task} showProject={false} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          {tasks.some((task) => task.status === "done") ? (
            <p className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1 text-[12px] text-faint">
              <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              Tarefas concluídas continuam aparecendo aqui, com risco no título.
            </p>
          ) : null}

          <SectionCard title={`Arquivos do projeto · ${projectFiles.length}`} description="Materiais e referências compartilhados com quem tem acesso a este projeto.">
            <div className="grid gap-4">
              <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">A biblioteca central fica na aba <Link href="/arquivos" className="font-semibold text-brand underline underline-offset-2">Arquivos</Link>. Envie os materiais lá e mencione qualquer um deles aqui usando @.</p>
              {projectFiles.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="rounded-md border border-dashed border-border p-4 text-center text-[12.5px] text-muted">Nenhum arquivo vinculado diretamente a este projeto. Você ainda pode mencionar qualquer arquivo do espaço.</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                  {projectFiles.map((file) => (
                    <li key={file.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                      <span className="grid size-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-md bg-surface-2 text-brand"><span className="text-[11px] font-bold">{file.fileName.split(".").pop()?.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()}</span></span>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{file.fileName}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-faint">{formatBytes(file.sizeBytes)} · {file.authorName} · {formatDatePtBr(file.createdAt.slice(0, 10))}</p>
                      </div>
                      <FileActions fileId={file.id} fileName={file.fileName} mime={file.mime} ready={file.status === "ready"} canManage={canEditContent(workspace.role)} />
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="Conversa">
            <CommentThread
              workspaceId={workspace.id}
              entityType="project"
              entityId={project.id}
              comments={comments}
              viewerId={context.user.id}
              canComment={canComment(workspace.role)}
              canModerate={canManageMembers(workspace.role)}
            />
          </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <aside className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-4">
          <SectionCard title="Sobre o projeto">
            <dl className="grid gap-3 text-[13px]">
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                  Objetivo
                </dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 leading-relaxed text-muted">
                  {project.objective ?? "Não escrito."}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                  Descrição
                </dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 leading-relaxed text-muted">
                  {project.description ? <FileMentionText workspaceId={workspace.id} text={project.description} /> : "Não escrita."}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.06em] text-faint uppercase">
                  Criado em
                </dt>
                <dd className="mt-0.5 text-muted">
                  {formatDatePtBr(project.createdAt.slice(0, 10))}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="Riscos e bloqueios">
            {project.risks ? (
              <p className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                <FileMentionText workspaceId={workspace.id} text={project.risks} />
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
                <ShieldAlert
                  className="mt-0.5 size-4 flex-none text-[var(--warning-700)]"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                Nenhum risco registrado. Se algo pode travar a entrega, escreva
                aqui antes que vire surpresa.
              </div>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <p className="px-1 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed text-faint">
            Excluir um projeto leva para a lixeira por 30 dias. Nada é apagado
            de imediato.
          </p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: app\(app)\tarefas\page.tsx

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CheckCircle2, ListChecks, Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/patterns/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { TaskRow } from "@/components/tasks/task-row";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { listTasks } from "@/lib/data/tasks";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Tarefas" };

const VIEWS = [
  { id: "abertas", label: "Em aberto" },
  { id: "semana", label: "Próximos 7 dias" },
  { id: "todas", label: "Todas" },
  { id: "concluidas", label: "Concluídas" },
] as const;

type ViewId = (typeof VIEWS)[number]["id"];

function addDaysIso(date: string, days: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = date.split("-").map(Number);
  const value = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  value.setUTCDate(value.getUTCDate() + days);
  return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export default async function TasksPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ vista?: string }>;
}) {
  const context = await getAppContext();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const view: ViewId = VIEWS.some((entry) => entry.id === params.vista)
    ? (params.vista as ViewId)
    : "abertas";

  if (!context.workspace) {
    return (
      <PageHeader
        title="Tarefas"
        description="Seu espaço ainda não está disponível. Rode as migrações do Supabase para começar."
      />
    );
  }

  const tasks = await listTasks({
    workspaceId: context.workspace.id,
    today: context.today,
    includeDone: view === "concluidas" || view === "todas",
  });

  const weekLimit = addDaysIso(context.today, 7);
  const filtered = tasks.filter((task) => {
    if (view === "concluidas") return task.status === "done";
    if (view === "semana") {
      return (
        task.status !== "done" &&
        Boolean(task.dueDate) &&
        (task.dueDate as string) <= weekLimit
      );
    }
    if (view === "todas") return true;
    return task.status !== "done";
  });

  const overdue = filtered.filter(
    (task) => task.status !== "done" && task.dueState === "overdue",
  );
  const today = filtered.filter(
    (task) => task.status !== "done" && task.dueState === "today",
  );
  const upcoming = filtered.filter(
    (task) => task.status !== "done" && task.dueState === "upcoming",
  );
  const noDate = filtered.filter(
    (task) => task.status !== "done" && task.dueState === "none",
  );
  const done = filtered.filter((task) => task.status === "done");

  const groups = [
    { id: "atrasadas", title: "Atrasadas", tasks: overdue },
    { id: "hoje", title: "Vencem hoje", tasks: today },
    { id: "proximas", title: "Próximas", tasks: upcoming },
    { id: "sem-prazo", title: "Sem prazo", tasks: noDate },
    { id: "concluidas", title: "Concluídas recentemente", tasks: done },
  ].filter((group) => group.tasks.length > 0);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={`${filtered.length} ${filtered.length === 1 ? "tarefa" : "tarefas"} nesta vista`}
        title="Tarefas"
        description="Atrasada, vence hoje ou sem prazo: cada tarefa mostra o estado por extenso, nunca só por cor."
        actions={
          <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:w-auto sm:flex-row">
            <Link
              href="/tarefas/quadro"
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3.5 sm:w-auto text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink no-underline hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
            >
              Ver como quadro
            </Link>
          <Link
            href="/criar?tipo=tarefa"
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand px-3.5 sm:w-auto text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
          >
            <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            Nova tarefa
          </Link>
          </div>
        }
      />

      <nav aria-label="Filtros de tarefas" className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {VIEWS.map((entry) => {
          const active = entry.id === view;
          return (
            <Link
              key={entry.id}
              href={`/tarefas?vista=${entry.id}`}
              aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-full border px-4 text-[12.5px] font-semibold no-underline transition-colors",
                active
                  ? "border-brand bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
                  : "border-border-strong bg-surface text-ink hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline",
              )}
            >
              {entry.label}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={view === "concluidas" ? CheckCircle2 : ListChecks}
          title={
            view === "concluidas"
              ? "Nenhuma tarefa concluída ainda"
              : view === "semana"
                ? "Nada nos próximos 7 dias"
                : "Nenhuma tarefa nesta vista"
          }
          description={
            view === "concluidas"
              ? "Quando você concluir uma tarefa, ela continua aqui como histórico. Nada desaparece."
              : "Crie uma tarefa com prazo ou registre uma ideia para não perder o que passou pela cabeça."
          }
          action={
            <Link
              href="/criar?tipo=tarefa"
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-brand px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline"
            >
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              Criar tarefa
            </Link>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-5">
          {groups.map((group) => (
            <SectionCard
              key={group.id}
              title={`${group.title} · ${group.tasks.length}`}
              bodyClassName="p-0 sm:p-0"
            >
              <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                {group.tasks.map((task) => (
                  <TaskRow key={task.id} task={task} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </SectionCard>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { CommentThread } from "@/components/comments/comment-thread";
import { FileMentionText } from "@/components/files/file-mention-text";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/patterns/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/patterns/section-card";
import { DueDateChip, StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";
import { AssigneeSelect } from "@/components/tasks/assignee-select";
import { listComments } from "@/lib/data/comments";
import { getAppContext } from "@/lib/data/context";
import { getTaskDetail } from "@/lib/data/tasks";
import { listWorkspaceMembers } from "@/lib/data/workspace-members";
import { priorityLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import { KANBAN_COLUMNS } from "@/modules/tasks/kanban";
import { canComment, canEditContent, canManageMembers } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Tarefa" };

export default async function TaskPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const context = await getAppContext();
  if (!context.workspace) notFound();

  const task = await getTaskDetail({ workspaceId: context.workspace.id, taskId: id, today: context.today });
  if (!task) notFound();

  const [comments, members] = await Promise.all([
    listComments({ workspaceId: context.workspace.id, entityType: "task", entityId: task.id }),
    listWorkspaceMembers(context.workspace.id),
  ]);

  const role = context.workspace.role;
  const assignee = members.find((member) => member.userId === task.assigneeId);
  const options = members
    .filter((member) => member.status === "active" && member.role !== "reader")
    .map((member) => ({ id: member.userId, name: member.userId === context.user.id ? `${member.name} (você)` : member.name }));
  const statusLabel = KANBAN_COLUMNS.find((column) => column.status === task.status)?.label ?? task.status;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-7">
      <Link href="/tarefas/quadro" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface/80 px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-muted no-underline transition-colors hover:border-brand/40 hover:text-ink hover:no-underline">
        <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        Voltar ao quadro
      </Link>

      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-brand/25 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand)_20%,transparent),transparent_55%),linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
        <div className="relative z-10">
          <PageHeader
        eyebrow={task.projectTitle ?? "Sem projeto"}
        title={task.title}
        description={task.description ? <FileMentionText workspaceId={context.workspace.id} text={task.description} /> : undefined}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(280px,1fr)]">
        <div className="order-2 lg:order-1">
        <SectionCard title="Conversa">
          <CommentThread
            workspaceId={context.workspace.id}
            entityType="task"
            entityId={task.id}
            comments={comments}
            viewerId={context.user.id}
            canComment={canComment(role)}
            canModerate={canManageMembers(role)}
          />
        </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <aside className="order-1 grid content-start gap-5 lg:order-2">
          <SectionCard title="Detalhes" description="Status, prioridade e responsabilidade desta tarefa.">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <StatusChip label={statusLabel} tone={task.status === "done" ? "success" : "neutral"} />
              <StatusChip label={priorityLabel(task.priority)} tone={task.priority === "high" || task.priority === "urgent" ? "danger" : "neutral"} />
              {task.status !== "done" ? <DueDateChip state={task.dueState} /> : null}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4">
              {canEditContent(role) ? (
                <AssigneeSelect taskId={task.id} current={task.assigneeId} options={options} />
              ) : (
                <p className="text-[13px]">
                  <span className="text-faint">Responsável: </span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{assignee ? assignee.name : "Sem responsável"}</span>
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </SectionCard>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

==================================================
ARQUIVO: app\api\cron\purge-files\route.ts
==================================================
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { BUCKET, json } from "@/lib/files/http";

/**
 * Limpeza diária: lixeira com mais de 30 dias e uploads pendentes há mais de 24 h.
 * Protegida por CRON_SECRET (Authorization: Bearer ...). Usa a service role só aqui.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const secret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!secret || secret.length < 24 || !url || !serviceKey) {
    return json({ error: "nao_configurado" }, 503);
  }

  const provided = Buffer.from(request.headers.get("authorization")?.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "") ?? "");
  const expected = Buffer.from(secret);
  if (provided.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(provided, expected)) {
    return json({ error: "nao_autorizado" }, 401);
  }

  const admin = createClient(url, serviceKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });
  const { data, error } = await admin.rpc("list_expired_files");
  if (error) return json({ error: "falha_ao_listar" }, 500);

  const expired = (data ?? []) as { id: string; storage_path: string }[];
  if (expired.length === 0) return json({ removed: 0 });

  // Fase 1: remove objetos. Fase 2: só então apaga os registros dos que saíram do Storage.
  const { error: removeError } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).remove(expired.map((f) => f.storage_path));
  if (removeError) return json({ error: "falha_ao_remover_objetos" }, 502);

  const { data: count, error: deleteError } = await admin.rpc("delete_purged_files", {
    p_ids: expired.map((f) => f.id),
  });
  if (deleteError) return json({ error: "falha_ao_apagar_registros" }, 500);
  return json({ removed: Number(count) });
}

import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";

import { authorize, json } from "@/lib/files/http";

const querySchema = z.uuid();

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const auth = await authorize(request, { mutating: false });
  if ("error" in auth) return auth.error;
  const workspaceId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("workspaceId");
  if (!querySchema.safeParse(workspaceId).success) return json({ error: "requisicao_invalida" }, 400);

  const files: { id: string; file_name: string }[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 1000) {
    const { data, error } = await auth.supabase
      .from("files_metadata")
      .select("id, file_name")
      .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId!)
      .eq("status", "ready")
      .is("deleted_at", null)
      .order("file_name", { ascending: true })
      .range(offset, offset + 999);

    if (error) return json({ error: "falha_ao_listar" }, 500);
    const batch = (data ?? []) as typeof files;
    files.push(...batch);
    if (batch.length < 1000) break;
  }

  return json({ files: files.map((file) => ({ id: file.id, fileName: file.file_name })) });
}

ARQUIVO: app\api\files\sign\route.ts

import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";

import { authorize, BUCKET, json } from "@/lib/files/http";
import { SIGNED_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS, validateUploadRequest } from "@/modules/files/domain";

const bodySchema = z.object({
  workspaceId: z.uuid(),
  name: z.string().max(400),
  size: z.number(),
  mime: z.string().max(150),
  entityType: z.enum(["project", "task", "course", "idea"]).nullable().optional(),
  entityId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(),
});

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const auth = await authorize(request, { mutating: true });
  if ("error" in auth) return auth.error;

  const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return json({ error: "requisicao_invalida" }, 400);

  if (parsed.data.entityType === "project" && parsed.data.entityId) {
    const { data: project } = await auth.supabase
      .from("projects")
      .select("id")
      .eq("id", parsed.data.entityId)
      .eq("workspace_id", parsed.data.workspaceId)
      .is("deleted_at", null)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!project) return json({ error: "projeto_nao_encontrado" }, 404);
  } else if (parsed.data.entityType || parsed.data.entityId) {
    return json({ error: "vinculo_invalido" }, 400);
  }

  const check = validateUploadRequest(parsed.data);
  if (!check.ok) return json({ error: check.code, message: check.message }, 422);

  const { data, error } = await auth.supabase.rpc("begin_file_upload", {
    p_workspace: parsed.data.workspaceId,
    p_name: check.name,
    p_size: parsed.data.size,
    p_mime: check.mime,
    p_entity_type: parsed.data.entityType ?? null,
    p_entity_id: parsed.data.entityId ?? null,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === "53400") {
      return json({ error: "quota_exceeded", message: "O espaço atingiu o limite de 1 GB." }, 413);
    }
    if (error.code === "42501") return json({ error: "sem_permissao" }, 403);
    if (error.code === "22023") return json({ error: "arquivo_invalido" }, 422);
    return json({ error: "falha_ao_iniciar" }, 500);
  }

  const row = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data) as { id: string; storage_path: string } | undefined;
  if (!row) return json({ error: "falha_ao_iniciar" }, 500);

  const signed = await auth.supabase.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUploadUrl(row.storage_path);
  if (signed.error || !signed.data) {
    // Sem URL, o registro pendente não serve: sai da cota agora (o expurgo remove depois).
    await auth.supabase
      .from("files_metadata")
      .update({ deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq("id", row.id)
      .eq("status", "pending");
    return json({ error: "storage_indisponivel" }, 502);
  }

  return json({
    fileId: row.id,
    signedUrl: signed.data.signedUrl,
    expiresInSeconds: SIGNED_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS,
  });
}

ARQUIVO: app\api\files\[id]\complete\route.ts

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";

import { authorize, BUCKET, json } from "@/lib/files/http";
import { MAX_FILE_BYTES, verifyUploadedObject } from "@/modules/files/domain";

const HEAD_BYTES = 4096;

export async function POST(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const auth = await authorize(request, { mutating: true });
  if ("error" in auth) return auth.error;

  const { id } = await params;
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) return json({ error: "id_invalido" }, 400);

  const { data: file } = await auth.supabase
    .from("files_metadata")
    .select("id, storage_path, mime, size_bytes, status")
    .eq("id", id)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!file) return json({ error: "nao_encontrado" }, 404);
  if (file.status !== "pending") return json({ error: "ja_finalizado", status: file.status }, 409);

  const signed = await auth.supabase.storage.from(BUCKET).createSignedUrl(file.storage_path, 60);
  if (signed.error || !signed.data) return json({ error: "storage_indisponivel" }, 502);

  const response = await fetch(signed.data.signedUrl);
  if (!response.ok || !response.body) return json({ error: "envio_nao_encontrado" }, 409);

  // Lê o objeto uma única vez: conta bytes, guarda o início e calcula o SHA-256.
  const hash = createHash("sha256");
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const head = new Uint8Array(HEAD_BYTES);
  let total = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    if (total < HEAD_BYTES) head.set(value.subarray(0, HEAD_BYTES - total), total);
    total += value.byteLength;
    hash.update(value);
    if (total > MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1) {
      await reader.cancel();
      break;
    }
  }

  const verdict = verifyUploadedObject({
    declaredMime: file.mime,
    declaredSize: Number(file.size_bytes),
    actualSize: total,
    head: head.subarray(0, Math.min(total, HEAD_BYTES)),
  });

  const { data: status, error } = await auth.supabase.rpc("finalize_file_upload", {
    p_file: id,
    p_ok: verdict.ok,
    p_checksum: verdict.ok ? hash.digest("hex") : null,
    p_reason: verdict.ok ? null : verdict.reason,
  });

  if (error) return json({ error: "falha_ao_finalizar" }, error.code === "23514" ? 409 : 500);
  return json({
    status,
    message: verdict.ok ? undefined : "O arquivo não confere com o tipo informado e ficou em análise.",
  });
}

ARQUIVO: app\api\files\[id]\url\route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";

import { authorize, BUCKET, json } from "@/lib/files/http";
import { isInlinePreviewable, SIGNED_READ_TTL_SECONDS } from "@/modules/files/domain";

/** GET /api/files/{id}/url — redireciona para uma URL assinada de 5 minutos. */
export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const auth = await authorize(request, { mutating: false });
  if ("error" in auth) return auth.error;

  const { id } = await params;
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) return json({ error: "id_invalido" }, 400);

  const { data: file } = await auth.supabase
    .from("files_metadata")
    .select("storage_path, file_name, mime, status")
    .eq("id", id)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!file || file.status !== "ready") return json({ error: "nao_encontrado" }, 404);

  const forceDownload = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("baixar") === "1";
  const download = forceDownload || !isInlinePreviewable(file.mime) ? file.file_name : undefined;

  const signed = await auth.supabase.storage
    .from(BUCKET)
    .createSignedUrl(file.storage_path, SIGNED_READ_TTL_SECONDS, download ? { download } : undefined);
  if (signed.error || !signed.data) return json({ error: "storage_indisponivel" }, 502);

  const redirect = NextResponse.redirect(signed.data.signedUrl, 302);
  redirect.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  redirect.headers.set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
  return redirect;
}

ARQUIVO: app\auth\callback\route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { getSupabaseConfig } from "@/lib/env";
import { safeNextPath } from "@/lib/auth/errors";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/**
 * PKCE callback for password recovery (and future OAuth providers).
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);
  const code = searchParams.get("code");
  const next = safeNextPath(searchParams.get("next"));
  const errorDescription = searchParams.get("error_description");

  if (errorDescription || !getSupabaseConfig() || !code) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL("/login?erro=link-invalido", origin),
    );
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL("/login?erro=link-expirado", origin),
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, origin));
}

ARQUIVO: app\auth\confirm\route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import type { EmailOtpType } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

import { getSupabaseConfig } from "@/lib/env";
import { safeNextPath } from "@/lib/auth/errors";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/**
 * Email confirmation / recovery link handler for the token_hash flow.
 * Configure the Supabase email templates to point here:
 *   {{ .SiteURL }}/auth/confirm?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=email&next=/
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);
  const tokenHash = searchParams.get("token_hash");
  const type = (searchParams.get("type") ?? "email") as EmailOtpType;
  const next = safeNextPath(searchParams.get("next"));

  if (!getSupabaseConfig() || !tokenHash) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL("/login?erro=link-invalido", origin),
    );
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
    type,
    token_hash: tokenHash,
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL("/login?erro=link-expirado", origin),
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, origin));
}
