import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AlertCircle, Users } from "lucide-react";

import { BrandLockup } from "@/components/brand/logo";
import { acceptInvitationAction } from "@/lib/actions/collab";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { previewInvitation } from "@/lib/data/invitations";
import {
  collabErrorMessage,
  isKnownCollabError,
  isValidInviteToken,
} from "@/modules/collab/domain";
import { hashInviteToken } from "@/modules/collab/token";
import { ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS, ROLE_LABELS } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";

// O token vive na URL: nada de indexação nem de vazar para outros sites.
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Convite",
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
  referrer: "no-referrer",
};
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const STATE_MESSAGES = {
  used: "invitation_used",
  revoked: "invitation_revoked",
  expired: "invitation_expired",
} as const;

function Shell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto grid min-h-dvh w-full max-w-md content-center gap-6 px-4 py-10">
      <BrandLockup />
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)]">{children}</div>
    </main>
  );
}

function Problem({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <Shell>
      <p role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[14px]">
        <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 size-5 flex-none text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
        {message}
      </p>
      <Link href="/" className="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-[13px] font-semibold text-brand">
        Ir para o início
      </Link>
    </Shell>
  );
}

export default async function InvitePage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ token: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ erro?: string }>;
}) {
  const { token } = await params;
  const { erro } = await searchParams;

  if (!isValidInviteToken(token)) {
    return <Problem message={collabErrorMessage("invitation_invalid")} />;
  }

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const here = `/convite/${token}`;

  // Sem sessão não mostramos nada sobre o espaço: só pedimos para entrar.
  if (!user) {
    const next = encodeURIComponent(here);
    return (
      <Shell>
        <h1 className="text-[18px] font-semibold">Você recebeu um convite</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[14px] text-muted">
          Entre na sua conta ou crie uma para ver o espaço e aceitar o convite.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Link href={`/login?proximo=${next}`} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-md bg-brand px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white no-underline hover:bg-brand-hover hover:no-underline">
            Entrar
          </Link>
          <Link href={`/criar-conta?proximo=${next}`} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-md border border-border-strong px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink no-underline hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline">
            Criar conta
          </Link>
        </div>
      </Shell>
    );
  }

  const preview = await previewInvitation(hashInviteToken(token));
  if (!preview) return <Problem message={collabErrorMessage("invitation_invalid")} />;

  if (preview.state !== "valid") {
    return <Problem message={collabErrorMessage(STATE_MESSAGES[preview.state])} />;
  }

  const blocked = preview.emailBound && !preview.emailMatches;
  const error = erro && isKnownCollabError(erro) ? collabErrorMessage(erro) : null;

  return (
    <Shell>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-brand-soft text-brand">
          <Users className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">
            {preview.invitedByName ? `${preview.invitedByName} convidou você para` : "Você foi convidado para"}
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-[18px] leading-tight font-semibold">{preview.workspaceName}</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <dl className="mt-5 grid gap-1 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3 text-[13px]">
        <dt className="font-semibold">Seu papel: {ROLE_LABELS[preview.role]}</dt>
        <dd className="text-muted">{ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS[preview.role]}</dd>
      </dl>

      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-4 text-[13px] text-danger">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {blocked ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-4 text-[13px] text-danger">
          {collabErrorMessage("invitation_email_mismatch")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <form action={acceptInvitationAction} className="mt-5">
          <input type="hidden" name="token" value={token} />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-md bg-brand px-5 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand"
          >
            Aceitar convite
          </button>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint">
            Você só entra no espaço depois de aceitar. O convite vale uma única vez.
          </p>
        </form>
      )}
    </Shell>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CloudOff, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

import { LogoMark } from "@/components/brand/logo";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Sem conexão",
  description: "Você está offline. Seus dados continuam no servidor.",
};

export default function OfflinePage() {
  return (
    <main className="grid min-h-dvh place-items-center bg-background px-4 py-10">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-8">
        <span className="inline-grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-[12px] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#2c6be0] to-[#1d4fb8] text-white">

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { BrandLockup } from "@/components/brand/logo";
import { getPublicPortfolio } from "@/lib/data/portfolio-public";
import { formatDatePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";
import { projectStageLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import { publicProgress } from "@/modules/portfolio/domain";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Nunca indexar, nunca vazar o token por Referer, nunca guardar em cache.
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Projeto",
  robots: { index: false, follow: false, nocache: true },
  referrer: "no-referrer",
};

export default async function PublicPortfolioPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; token: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug, token } = await params;
  const item = await getPublicPortfolio(slug, token);
  if (!item) notFound();

  const progress = publicProgress(item.tasksDone, item.tasksTotal);

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto grid min-h-dvh w-full max-w-2xl content-start gap-6 px-4 py-10">
      <BrandLockup />

      <article className="grid gap-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5 sm:p-7">
        <header className="grid gap-2">
          <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold tracking-wide text-brand uppercase">
            {projectStageLabel(item.stage)}
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-2xl leading-tight font-semibold">{item.title}</h1>
          {item.summary ? (
            <p className="text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-muted">{item.summary}</p>
          ) : null}
        </header>

        {item.objective ? (
          <section aria-labelledby="objetivo" className="grid gap-1">
            <h2 id="objetivo" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
              Objetivo
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[14px] leading-relaxed">{item.objective}</p>
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {item.description ? (
          <section aria-labelledby="sobre" className="grid gap-1">
            <h2 id="sobre" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
              Sobre
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[14px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{item.description}</p>
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {progress !== null ? (
          <section aria-labelledby="progresso" className="grid gap-1.5">
            <h2 id="progresso" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
              Progresso
            </h2>
            <div
              role="progressbar"
              aria-valuenow={progress}
              aria-valuemin={0}
              aria-valuemax={100}
              aria-label={`Progresso do projeto: ${progress}%`}
              className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-2"
            >
              <div className="h-full bg-brand" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">
              {item.tasksDone} de {item.tasksTotal} tarefas concluídas
            </p>
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {item.publishedAt ? (
          <p className="text-[12px] text-faint">
            Publicado em {formatDatePtBr(item.publishedAt.slice(0, 10))}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </article>

      <p className="text-center text-[11.5px] text-faint">
        Página compartilhada por link privado. Não aparece em buscadores.
      </p>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ThemeProvider } from "next-themes";

import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/sonner";
import { MotionPreferenceProvider } from "@/components/providers/motion-preference";
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";

export function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: 30_000,
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
            retry: 1,
          },
        },
      }),
  );

  return (
    <ThemeProvider
      attribute="data-theme"
      defaultTheme="dark"
      enableSystem={true}
      disableTransitionOnChange
    >
      <MotionPreferenceProvider />
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <TooltipProvider delayDuration={250}>
          {children}
          <Toaster />
        </TooltipProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\auth\field.tsx

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type FieldProps = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  label: string;
  type?: React.HTMLInputTypeAttribute;
  autoComplete?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  error?: string[];
  hint?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  inputMode?: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>["inputMode"];
  className?: string;
};

export function Field({
  id,
  name,
  label,
  type = "text",
  autoComplete,
  placeholder,
  defaultValue,
  error,
  hint,
  required = true,
  autoFocus,
  inputMode,
  className,
}: FieldProps) {
  const errorId = `${id}-error`;
  const hintId = `${id}-hint`;
  const describedBy =
    [hint ? hintId : null, error?.length ? errorId : null]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ") || undefined;

  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-1.5", className)}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        {label}
        {!required ? (
          <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
        ) : null}
      </Label>
      <Input
        id={id}
        name={name}
        type={type}
        autoComplete={autoComplete}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        defaultValue={defaultValue}
        required={required}
        autoFocus={autoFocus}
        inputMode={inputMode}
        aria-invalid={error?.length ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        className="h-11 bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
      />
      {hint ? (
        <p id={hintId} className="text-xs text-faint">
          {hint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error?.length ? (
        <p id={errorId} className="text-[13px] font-medium text-danger">
          {error[0]}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { isSupabaseConfigured } from "@/lib/env";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function SetupNotice() {
  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) return null;

  return (
    <Alert className="mb-6 border-warning/40 bg-warning-soft text-ink">
      <AlertCircle className="text-[var(--warning-700)]" aria-hidden="true" />
      <AlertDescription className="text-ink">
        <strong className="font-semibold">Modo de configuração.</strong> Este
        ambiente ainda não tem o Supabase conectado. Copie{" "}
        <code className="rounded bg-black/5 px-1 py-0.5 text-[12px]">
          .env.example
        </code>{" "}
        para{" "}
        <code className="rounded bg-black/5 px-1 py-0.5 text-[12px]">
          .env.local
        </code>{" "}
        e preencha a URL e a chave pública do projeto.
      </AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  );
}

export function FormMessage({
  status,
  message,
}: {
  status: "error" | "success";
  message?: string;
}) {
  if (!message) return null;

  const isError = status === "error";

  return (
    <Alert
      variant={isError ? "destructive" : "default"}
      className={cn(
        "mb-5",
        isError
          ? "border-danger/30 bg-danger-soft"
          : "border-success/30 bg-success-soft",
      )}
    >
      {isError ? (
        <AlertCircle aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        <CheckCircle2 aria-hidden="true" className="text-[var(--success-700)]" />
      )}
      <AlertDescription className={cn(isError ? "text-danger" : "text-ink")}>
        {message}
      </AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

type PasswordFieldProps = {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  autoComplete: "current-password" | "new-password";
  error?: string[];
  hint?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
};

export function PasswordField({
  name,
  label,
  autoComplete,
  error,
  hint,
  defaultValue,
}: PasswordFieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const errorId = `${id}-error`;
  const hintId = `${id}-hint`;
  const describedBy =
    [hint ? hintId : null, error?.length ? errorId : null]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ") || undefined;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        {label}
      </Label>
      <div className="relative">
        <Input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          required
          defaultValue={defaultValue}
          aria-invalid={error?.length ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={describedBy}
          className="h-11 bg-surface pr-12 pl-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
          className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 grid w-11 place-items-center rounded-r-md text-muted transition-colors hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-[-4px] focus-visible:outline-brand"
          aria-label={visible ? "Ocultar senha" : "Mostrar senha"}
          aria-pressed={visible}
        >
          {visible ? (
            <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
      {hint ? (
        <p id={hintId} className="text-xs text-faint">
          {hint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error?.length ? (
        <p id={errorId} className="text-[13px] font-medium text-danger">
          {error[0]}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BrandLockup({
  className,
  compact = false,
}: {
  className?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <span className={cn("flex items-center gap-2.5", className)}>
      <span className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-[11px] border border-[#d6a45f]/25 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#202b3d] to-[#080d16] text-[#e5b76e] shadow-[0_5px_18px_rgb(0_0_0/0.28),inset_0_1px_0_rgb(255_255_255/0.08)]">
        <LogoMark className="size-[25px]" />
      </span>
      <span className="grid leading-tight">
        <span className="text-[15px] font-bold tracking-[0.14em] text-white">
          ÓRBITA
        </span>
        {!compact ? (
          <span className="text-[11px] tracking-[0.02em] text-[#9aa7bc]">
            seu espaço de trabalho
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\brand\workspace-avatar.tsx
==================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function WorkspaceAvatar({
  name,
  brandColor,
  coverUrl,
  size = "md",
  className,
}: {
  name: string;
  brandColor: string;
  coverUrl?: string | null;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const imageSize = size === "sm" ? 24 : size === "lg" ? 44 : 32;
  const sizes = {
    sm: "size-6 rounded-md text-[10px]",
    md: "size-8 rounded-lg text-[12px]",
    lg: "size-11 rounded-xl text-sm",
  } as const;
  const showImage = Boolean(coverUrl && failedSrc !== coverUrl);

  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-grid flex-none place-items-center overflow-hidden font-bold shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgb(255_255_255/0.2)]",
        sizes[size],
        className,
      )}
      style={{ backgroundColor: brandColor, color: "#101521" }}
    >
      {showImage ? (
        <Image
          src={coverUrl!}
          alt=""
          width={imageSize}
          height={imageSize}
          sizes={`${imageSize}px`}
          unoptimized
          onError={() => setFailedSrc(coverUrl!)}
          className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover"
        />
      ) : (
        name.trim().slice(0, 1).toLocaleUpperCase("pt-BR") || "Ó"
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\collab\invite-form.tsx

"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy, Link2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormMessage } from "@/components/auth/form-message";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/forms/submit-button";
import { createInvitationAction, type InviteState } from "@/lib/actions/collab";
import { INVITE_TTL_DAYS } from "@/modules/collab/domain";
import { ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS, ROLE_LABELS, type WorkspaceRole } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";

const initial: InviteState = { status: "idle" };

export function InviteForm({
  workspaceId,
  roles,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  roles: WorkspaceRole[];
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(createInvitationAction, initial);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<WorkspaceRole>(roles.includes("editor") ? "editor" : roles[0]);

  async function copy(link: string) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      setCopied(false); // o campo continua selecionável para copiar à mão
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <form action={formAction} className="grid gap-3">
        <input type="hidden" name="workspaceId" value={workspaceId} />

        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="invite-role" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
            Papel
          </label>
          <select
            id="invite-role"
            name="role"
            value={role}
            onChange={(event) => setRole(event.target.value as WorkspaceRole)}
            className="h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
          >
            {roles.map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {ROLE_LABELS[value]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-faint">{ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS[role]}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="invite-email" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
            E-mail da pessoa <span className="font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="invite-email"
            name="email"
            type="email"
            inputMode="email"
            autoComplete="off"
            maxLength={254}
            placeholder="nome@exemplo.com"
            aria-invalid={state.fieldErrors?.email ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby="invite-email-hint"
            className="h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
          />
          <p id="invite-email-hint" className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-faint">
            Se informar, só quem entrar com esse e-mail consegue aceitar. Sem e-mail, vale para
            quem tiver o link. Nenhum e-mail é enviado: você compartilha o link.
          </p>
          {state.fieldErrors?.email?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-danger">{state.fieldErrors.email[0]}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {state.status === "error" ? <FormMessage status="error" message={state.message} /> : null}

        <div>
          <SubmitButton pending={pending} pendingLabel="Criando…">
            <Link2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            Criar link de convite
          </SubmitButton>
        </div>
      </form>

      {state.status === "success" && state.link ? (
        <div role="status" className="grid gap-2 rounded-md border border-success/30 bg-success-soft p-3">
          <p className="text-[13px] font-medium">{state.message}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              readOnly
              value={state.link}
              aria-label="Link do convite"
              onFocus={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()}
              className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[13px]"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => copy(state.link as string)}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-surface-2"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
              {copied ? "Copiado" : "Copiar"}
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11.5px] text-muted">
            Vale por {INVITE_TTL_DAYS} dias e só pode ser usado uma vez. Você pode cancelá-lo na lista abaixo.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}


==================================================
ARQUIVO: components\comments\comment-thread.tsx
==================================================
"use client";

import { useActionState, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Pencil, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { FormMessage } from "@/components/auth/form-message";
import { FileMentionTextarea } from "@/components/files/file-mention-textarea";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/forms/submit-button";
import { UserAvatar } from "@/components/layout/user-avatar";
import { addCommentAction, deleteCommentAction, editCommentAction } from "@/lib/actions/collab";
import { initialFormState } from "@/lib/actions/state";
import type { CommentEntity, CommentItem } from "@/lib/data/comments";
import { formatDateTimePtBr } from "@/lib/dates";
import { MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH } from "@/modules/collab/domain";

export function CommentThread({
  workspaceId,
  entityType,
  entityId,
  comments,
  viewerId,
  canComment,
  canModerate,
  files: initialFiles = [],
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  entityType: CommentEntity;
  entityId: string;
  comments: CommentItem[];
  viewerId: string;
  canComment: boolean;
  canModerate: boolean;
  files?: { id: string; fileName: string }[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(initialFiles);
  const [filesLoaded, setFilesLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch("/api/files/mentions?workspaceId=" + encodeURIComponent(workspaceId))
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : { files: [] })
      .then((data) => { if (active) { setFiles(data.files ?? []); setFilesLoaded(true); } })
      .catch(() => { if (active) { setFiles([]); setFilesLoaded(true); } });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [workspaceId]);
  const commentFormRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [newBody, setNewBody] = useState("");
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (previousState: typeof initialFormState, formData: FormData) => {
      const result = await addCommentAction(previousState, formData);
      if (result.status === "success") setNewBody("");
      return result;
    },
    initialFormState,
  );

  function renderBody(body: string) {
    const parts = body.split(/(\[\[arquivo:[0-9a-f-]{36}\]\])/gi);
    return parts.map((part, index) => {
      const match = /^\[\[arquivo:([0-9a-f-]{36})\]\]$/i.exec(part);
      if (!match) return <span key={index}>{part}</span>;
      const file = files.find((item) => item.id === match[1]);
      if (!file) return <span key={index} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-background">{filesLoaded ? "📎 Arquivo indisponível" : "📎 Carregando arquivo…"}</span>;
      return (
        <a key={index} href={"/api/files/" + match[1] + "/url"} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 font-semibold text-background underline underline-offset-2">
          <span aria-hidden="true">📎</span>{file.fileName}
        </a>
      );
    });
  }
  async function saveEdit(id: string) {
    const result = await editCommentAction({ commentId: id, body: draft });
    if (result.status === "error") {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível editar.");
      return;
    }
    setEditing(null);
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    const result = await deleteCommentAction(id);
    if (result.status === "error") {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível apagar.");
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="comments-heading" className="grid gap-4">
      <h2 id="comments-heading" className="text-[15px] font-semibold">
        Comentários {comments.length > 0 ? `(${comments.length})` : ""}
      </h2>

      {comments.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Ainda não há comentários.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="grid gap-3">
          {comments.map((comment) => {
            const mine = comment.authorId === viewerId;
            return (
              <li key={comment.id} className="flex gap-3">
                <UserAvatar name={comment.authorName} size="lg" />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-3 text-ink">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2">
                    <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{mine ? "Você" : comment.authorName}</span>
                    <time dateTime={comment.createdAt} className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">
                      {formatDateTimePtBr(comment.createdAt)}
                    </time>
                    {comment.edited ? <span className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">· editado</span> : null}
                  </div>

                  {editing === comment.id ? (
                    <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2">
                      <label htmlFor={`edit-${comment.id}`} className="sr-only">
                        Editar comentário
                      </label>
                      <FileMentionTextarea
                        id={`edit-${comment.id}`}
                        workspaceId={workspaceId}
                        value={draft}
                        onChange={setDraft}
                        maxLength={MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH}
                        rows={3}
                      />
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => saveEdit(comment.id)} className="min-h-11 rounded-md bg-brand px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-hover">
                          Salvar
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} className="min-h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-surface-2">
                          Cancelar
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[14px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-ink">{renderBody(comment.body)}</p>
                  )}

                  {editing !== comment.id && (mine || canModerate) ? (
                    <div className="mt-2 flex gap-1">
                      {mine ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setEditing(comment.id);
                            setDraft(comment.body);
                          }}
                          aria-label="Editar comentário"
                          className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-md text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink"
                        >
                          <Pencil className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                        </button>
                      ) : null}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => remove(comment.id)}
                        aria-label="Apagar comentário"
                        className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-md text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-danger"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      {canComment ? (
        <form ref={commentFormRef} action={formAction} className="grid gap-2">
          <input type="hidden" name="workspaceId" value={workspaceId} />
          <input type="hidden" name="entityType" value={entityType} />
          <input type="hidden" name="entityId" value={entityId} />
          <label htmlFor="new-comment" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
            Novo comentário
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <FileMentionTextarea
              id="new-comment"
              name="body"
              workspaceId={workspaceId}
              value={newBody}
              onChange={setNewBody}
              rows={3}
              required
              maxLength={MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH}
              placeholder={files.length ? "Escreva ou digite @ para mencionar qualquer arquivo do espaço…" : "Escreva para quem acompanha este item…"}
              className="min-h-24"
            />
          </div>
          {state.status === "error" ? <FormMessage status="error" message={state.message} /> : null}
          <div>
            <SubmitButton pending={pending} pendingLabel="Enviando…">
              Comentar
            </SubmitButton>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Seu papel neste espaço não permite comentar.</p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState, useMemo } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Crosshair } from "lucide-react";

import {
  CheckboxField,
  TextField,
} from "@/components/forms/field";
import { FormMessage } from "@/components/auth/form-message";
import { PriorityField } from "@/components/forms/priority-field";

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Download, Eye, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { restoreItemAction, trashItemAction } from "@/lib/actions/mvp";
import { isInlinePreviewable } from "@/modules/files/domain";

const base =
  "grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface text-muted no-underline transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink hover:no-underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand";

export function FileActions({
  fileId,
  fileName,
  mime,
  ready,
  canManage = true,
}: {
  fileId: string;
  fileName: string;
  mime: string;
  ready: boolean;
  canManage?: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();

  async function trash() {
    const result = await trashItemAction("files", fileId);
    if (result.status === "error") {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível excluir o arquivo.");
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
    toast("Arquivo movido para a lixeira.", {
      description: fileName,
      duration: 8000,
      action: {
        label: "Desfazer",
        onClick: () => {
          void restoreItemAction("files", fileId).then(() => router.refresh());
        },
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-none gap-1.5">
      {ready && isInlinePreviewable(mime) ? (
        <a
          href={`/api/files/${fileId}/url`}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className={base}
          aria-label={`Visualizar ${fileName}`}
          title="Visualizar"
        >
          <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </a>
      ) : null}
      {ready ? (
        <a
          href={`/api/files/${fileId}/url?baixar=1`}
          className={base}
          aria-label={`Baixar ${fileName}`}
          title="Baixar"
        >
          <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </a>
      ) : null}
      {canManage ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={trash} className={base} aria-label={`Excluir ${fileName}`} title="Excluir">
          <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type MentionFile = { id: string; fileName: string };

export function FileMentionText({ workspaceId, text }: { workspaceId: string; text: string }) {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<MentionFile[]>([]);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch("/api/files/mentions?workspaceId=" + encodeURIComponent(workspaceId))
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : { files: [] })
      .then((data) => { if (active) { setFiles(data.files ?? []); setLoaded(true); } })
      .catch(() => { if (active) { setFiles([]); setLoaded(true); } });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [workspaceId]);

  const parts = text.split(/(\[\[arquivo:[0-9a-f-]{36}\]\])/gi);
  return (
    <>
      {parts.map((part, index) => {
        const match = /^\[\[arquivo:([0-9a-f-]{36})\]\]$/i.exec(part);
        if (!match) return <span key={index}>{part}</span>;
        const file = files.find((item) => item.id === match[1]);
        if (!file) return <span key={index} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-background">{loaded ? "📎 Arquivo indisponível" : "📎 Carregando arquivo…"}</span>;
        return (
          <a key={index} href={"/api/files/" + file.id + "/url"} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-background underline underline-offset-2">
            <span aria-hidden="true">📎</span>{file.fileName}
          </a>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\files\file-mention-textarea.tsx
==================================================
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { FileText } from "lucide-react";

type MentionFile = { id: string; fileName: string };

function escapeHtml(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

function toHtml(value: string, files: MentionFile[]) {
  const escaped = escapeHtml(value);
  return escaped.replace(/\[\[arquivo:([0-9a-f-]{36})\]\]/gi, (_token, id: string) => {
    const file = files.find((item) => item.id === id);
    return '<span contenteditable="false" data-file-mention="' + id + '" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-background text-[12px] font-semibold align-baseline"><span>📎</span>' + escapeHtml(file?.fileName ?? "Arquivo indisponível") + '</span>';
  }).replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
}

function serialize(node: Node): string {
  if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) return node.textContent ?? "";
  if (node instanceof HTMLElement && node.dataset.fileMention) return "[[arquivo:" + node.dataset.fileMention + "]]";
  if (node instanceof HTMLBRElement) return "\n";
  if (node instanceof HTMLElement && node.tagName === "DIV") return Array.from(node.childNodes).map(serialize).join("") + "\n";
  return Array.from(node.childNodes).map(serialize).join("");
}

export function FileMentionTextarea({
  id, name, workspaceId, defaultValue = "", value, onChange, placeholder, maxLength, rows = 4, required = false, className,
}: {
  id: string; name?: string; workspaceId: string; defaultValue?: string; value?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void; placeholder?: string; maxLength?: number; rows?: number; required?: boolean; className?: string;
}) {
  const editor = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<MentionFile[]>([]);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [internalValue, setInternalValue] = useState(defaultValue);
  const current = value ?? internalValue;

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch("/api/files/mentions?workspaceId=" + encodeURIComponent(workspaceId))
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : { files: [] })
      .then((data) => { if (active) setFiles(data.files ?? []); })
      .catch(() => { if (active) setFiles([]); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [workspaceId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editor.current && (editor.current.dataset.initialized !== "true" || document.activeElement !== editor.current || editor.current.dataset.dirty !== "true")) {
      editor.current.innerHTML = toHtml(current, files);
      editor.current.dataset.initialized = "true";
    }
  }, [current, files]);

  function readValue() {
    const next = editor.current ? serialize(editor.current).replace(/\n$/, "") : "";
    if (value === undefined) setInternalValue(next);
    onChange?.(next);
    return next;
  }

  function handleInput() {
    if (editor.current) editor.current.dataset.dirty = "true";
    const next = readValue();
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    const cursor = selection?.anchorOffset ?? 0;
    const textBefore = selection?.anchorNode?.textContent?.slice(0, cursor) ?? "";
    const at = textBefore.lastIndexOf("@");
    const previous = at > 0 ? textBefore[at - 1] : " ";
    const term = at >= 0 ? textBefore.slice(at + 1) : "";
    if (at >= 0 && /\s/.test(previous) && !/[\s@]/.test(term) && term.length <= 60) {
      setQuery(term.toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR"));
    } else {
      setQuery(null);
    }
    if (maxLength && next.length > maxLength) {
      const trimmed = next.slice(0, maxLength);
      if (editor.current) editor.current.innerText = trimmed;
      if (value === undefined) setInternalValue(trimmed);
      onChange?.(trimmed);
    }
  }

  function insert(file: MentionFile) {
    const node = editor.current;
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    if (!node || !selection || !selection.rangeCount) return;
    const range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
    const textNode = range.startContainer;
    if (textNode.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE || !textNode.parentNode?.isSameNode(node) && !node.contains(textNode)) return;
    const text = textNode.textContent ?? "";
    const cursor = range.startOffset;
    const at = text.lastIndexOf("@", cursor);
    if (at < 0) return;
    range.setStart(textNode, at);
    range.setEnd(textNode, cursor);
    range.deleteContents();
    const chip = document.createElement("span");
    chip.contentEditable = "false";
    chip.dataset.fileMention = file.id;
    chip.className = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-foreground px-1.5 py-0.5 text-background text-[12px] font-semibold align-baseline";
    chip.textContent = "📎 " + file.fileName;
    node.dataset.dirty = "true";
    range.insertNode(chip);
    const space = document.createTextNode(" ");
    chip.after(space);
    range.setStartAfter(space);
    range.collapse(true);
    selection.removeAllRanges();
    selection.addRange(range);
    setQuery(null);
    readValue();
    node.focus();
  }

  const matches = useMemo(() => files.filter((file) => file.fileName.toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR").includes(query ?? "")).slice(0, 10), [files, query]);

  return (
    <div className="relative grid gap-1.5">
      {name ? <input type="hidden" name={name} value={current} /> : null}
      <div
        ref={editor}
        id={id}
        contentEditable
        suppressContentEditableWarning
        role="textbox"
        aria-multiline="true"
        aria-label={placeholder ?? "Texto com menções a arquivos"}
        aria-required={required}
        data-placeholder={placeholder}
        onInput={handleInput}
        onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") setQuery(null); }}
        className={"min-h-24 w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-md border border-input bg-surface px-3 py-2.5 text-[15px] text-ink outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 empty:before:pointer-events-none empty:before:text-muted empty:before:content-[attr(data-placeholder)] md:text-sm " + (className ?? "")}
        style={{ minHeight: Math.max(96, rows * 24) }}
      />
      {query !== null ? (
        <div role="listbox" aria-label="Arquivos do espaço" className="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-30 mb-1 max-h-56 w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-1 text-ink shadow-xl">
          {matches.map((file) => (
            <button key={file.id} type="button" role="option" aria-selected="false" onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()} onClick={() => insert(file)} className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded px-3 text-left text-[13px] hover:bg-surface-2">
              <FileText className="size-4 flex-none text-brand" />
              <span className="truncate">{file.fileName}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
          {matches.length === 0 ? <p className="px-3 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Nenhum arquivo encontrado no espaço atual.</p> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Loader2, RotateCcw, Upload, X } from "lucide-react";

import { abortUploadAction } from "@/lib/actions/mvp";
import {
  ALLOWED_TYPES,
  formatBytes,
  validateUploadRequest,
} from "@/modules/files/domain";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Phase = "signing" | "uploading" | "verifying" | "ready" | "quarantined" | "error" | "cancelled";

type Upload = {
  key: string;
  file: File;
  phase: Phase;
  progress: number;
  message?: string;
  fileId?: string;
};

const ACCEPT = [
  ...Object.keys(ALLOWED_TYPES),
  ...Object.values(ALLOWED_TYPES).flatMap((rule) => rule.extensions.map((ext) => `.${ext}`)),
].join(",");

const PHASE_LABEL: Record<Phase, string> = {
  signing: "Preparando…",
  uploading: "Enviando",
  verifying: "Conferindo o arquivo…",
  ready: "Pronto",
  quarantined: "Em análise",
  error: "Falhou",
  cancelled: "Cancelado",
};

const ACTIVE: Phase[] = ["signing", "uploading", "verifying"];

export function FileUploader({ workspaceId, projectId }: { workspaceId: string; projectId?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [uploads, setUploads] = useState<Upload[]>([]);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const xhrs = useRef(new Map<string, XMLHttpRequest>());
  const cancelled = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const patch = (key: string, change: Partial<Upload>) =>
    setUploads((current) => current.map((item) => (item.key === key ? { ...item, ...change } : item)));

  async function run(key: string, file: File) {
    patch(key, { phase: "signing", progress: 0, message: undefined });

    const check = validateUploadRequest({ name: file.name, size: file.size, mime: file.type });
    if (!check.ok) return patch(key, { phase: "error", message: check.message });

    let fileId: string | undefined;
    try {
      const signRes = await fetch("/api/files/sign", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ workspaceId, name: file.name, size: file.size, mime: file.type, ...(projectId ? { entityType: "project", entityId: projectId } : {}) }),
      });
      const sign = await signRes.json();
      if (!signRes.ok) {
        return patch(key, { phase: "error", message: sign.message ?? "Não foi possível iniciar o envio." });
      }
      fileId = sign.fileId as string;
      patch(key, { fileId, phase: "uploading" });

      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhrs.current.set(key, xhr);
        xhr.open("PUT", sign.signedUrl as string);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("x-upsert", "false");
        xhr.upload.onprogress = (event) => {
          if (event.lengthComputable) patch(key, { progress: Math.round((event.loaded / event.total) * 100) });
        };
        xhr.onload = () => (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("upload_failed")));
        xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("network"));
        xhr.onabort = () => reject(new Error("aborted"));
        const body = new FormData();
        body.append("cacheControl", "3600");
        body.append("", file);
        xhr.send(body);
      });
      xhrs.current.delete(key);

      patch(key, { phase: "verifying", progress: 100 });
      const doneRes = await fetch(`/api/files/${fileId}/complete`, { method: "POST" });
      const done = await doneRes.json();
      if (!doneRes.ok) return patch(key, { phase: "error", message: "Não foi possível concluir o envio." });

      patch(key, done.status === "ready" ? { phase: "ready" } : { phase: "quarantined", message: done.message });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      xhrs.current.delete(key);
      if (fileId) void abortUploadAction(fileId);
      if (cancelled.current.has(key) || (error instanceof Error && error.message === "aborted")) {
        patch(key, { phase: "cancelled", message: "Envio cancelado." });
      } else {
        patch(key, { phase: "error", message: "A conexão falhou. Tente de novo." });
      }
      router.refresh();
    }
  }

  async function start(files: FileList | File[]) {
    const list = Array.from(files);
    const added = list.map((file) => ({
      key: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
      file,
      phase: "signing" as Phase,
      progress: 0,
    }));
    setUploads((current) => [...added, ...current].slice(0, 8));
    for (const item of added) await run(item.key, item.file);
  }

  function cancel(item: Upload) {
    cancelled.current.add(item.key);
    const xhr = xhrs.current.get(item.key);
    if (xhr) xhr.abort();
  }

  function retry(item: Upload) {
    cancelled.current.delete(item.key);
    void run(item.key, item.file);
  }

  function onDrop(event: DragEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setDragging(false);
    if (event.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) void start(event.dataTransfer.files);
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      <div
        onDragOver={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={onDrop}
        className={cn(
          "rounded-lg border border-dashed border-border-strong p-5 text-center",
          dragging && "border-brand bg-brand-soft",
        )}
      >
        <Upload className="mx-auto size-6 text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-muted">
          Arraste arquivos aqui ou escolha no aparelho. Até 25 MB cada.
        </p>
        <label htmlFor="file-input" className="sr-only">
          Escolher arquivos para enviar
        </label>
        <input
          ref={input}
          id="file-input"
          type="file"
          multiple
          accept={ACCEPT}
          className="sr-only"
          onChange={(event) => {
            if (event.target.files?.length) void start(event.target.files);
            event.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-brand px-4 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand"
        >
          <Upload className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Escolher arquivos
        </button>
      </div>

      {uploads.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="grid gap-2" aria-live="polite">
          {uploads.map((item) => {
            const active = ACTIVE.includes(item.phase);
            return (
              <li key={item.key} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{item.file.name}</p>
                  <span className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">{formatBytes(item.file.size)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  {active ? (
                    <progress
                      className="h-2 min-w-0 flex-1"
                      max={100}
                      value={item.phase === "signing" ? undefined : item.progress}
                      aria-label={`Progresso do envio de ${item.file.name}`}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex-1" />
                  )}
                  <span className="text-[12px] font-medium">
                    {item.phase === "uploading" ? `${item.progress}%` : PHASE_LABEL[item.phase]}
                  </span>
                  {active && item.phase !== "verifying" ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => cancel(item)}
                      aria-label={`Cancelar envio de ${item.file.name}`}
                      className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2"
                    >
                      <X className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </button>
                  ) : null}
                  {item.phase === "verifying" ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                  {item.phase === "error" || item.phase === "cancelled" ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => retry(item)}
                      aria-label={`Tentar de novo: ${item.file.name}`}
                      className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-surface-2"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                      Tentar de novo
                    </button>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                {item.message ? <p className="mt-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted">{item.message}</p> : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRightLeft, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { setPrimaryFocusAction } from "@/lib/actions/focus";
import { initialFormState, type FormActionState } from "@/lib/actions/state";
import { focusChangePrompt, type FocusKind } from "@/modules/focus/domain";

export function SetFocusButton({
  workspaceId,
  kind,
  targetId,
  targetTitle,
  currentTitle,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  kind: FocusKind;
  targetId: string;
  targetTitle: string;
  currentTitle: string | null;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (previous: FormActionState, formData: FormData) => {
      const next = await setPrimaryFocusAction(previous, formData);

      if (next.status === "success") {
        setOpen(false);
        toast.success(next.message ?? "Foco atualizado.");
      } else if (next.status === "error") {
        toast.error(next.message ?? "Não foi possível mudar o foco.");
      }

      return next;
    },
    initialFormState,
  );

  const isChange = Boolean(currentTitle);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant={isChange ? "outline" : "default"}
          size="sm"
          className={
            isChange
              ? "border-border-strong"
              : "bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand-hover"
          }
        >
          {isChange ? (
            <>
              <ArrowRightLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              Trocar foco
            </>
          ) : (
            "Definir como principal"
          )}
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>

      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>
            {isChange ? "Trocar o foco principal?" : "Definir foco principal?"}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {focusChangePrompt(kind, currentTitle, targetTitle)}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <ul className="grid gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3.5 py-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
          <li>Nada é arquivado ou apagado.</li>
          <li>O item anterior continua disponível na lista.</li>
          <li>A troca fica registrada no histórico do espaço.</li>
        </ul>

        {state.status === "error" ? (
          <p role="alert" className="text-[13px] font-medium text-danger">
            {state.message}
          </p>
        ) : null}

        <DialogFooter>
          <form action={formAction} className="flex w-full justify-end gap-2">
            <input type="hidden" name="workspaceId" value={workspaceId} />
            <input type="hidden" name="kind" value={kind} />
            <input type="hidden" name="targetId" value={targetId} />
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="min-h-10">
                Cancelar
              </Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={pending}
              className="min-h-10 bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand-hover"
            >
              {pending ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                  Salvando…
                </>
              ) : (
                "Confirmar troca"
              )}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import type { ComponentProps, ReactNode } from "react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { FileMentionTextarea } from "@/components/files/file-mention-textarea";

type FieldChrome = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  className?: string;
};

function describedBy(id: string, hint?: string, error?: string) {
  return (
    [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, error ? `${id}-error` : null]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ") || undefined
  );
}

function FieldMessages({
  id,
  hint,
  error,
}: {
  id: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {hint ? (
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-faint">
          {hint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="text-[12.5px] font-medium text-danger">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

export function TextField({
  id,
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  required = true,
  className,
  ...props
}: FieldChrome & Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Input>, "id" | "className">) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-1.5", className)}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        {label}
        {!required ? (
          <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
        ) : null}
      </Label>
      <Input
        id={id}
        required={required}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy(id, hint, error)}
        className="h-11 bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
        {...props}
      />
      <FieldMessages id={id} hint={hint} error={error} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function TextAreaField({
  id,
  label,
  workspaceId,
  hint,
  error,
  required = false,
  className,
  ...props
}: FieldChrome & Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Textarea>, "id" | "className"> & { workspaceId?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-1.5", className)}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        {label}
        {!required ? (
          <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
        ) : null}
      </Label>
      {workspaceId ? (
        <FileMentionTextarea
          id={id}
          name={props.name}
          workspaceId={workspaceId}
          defaultValue={typeof props.defaultValue === "string" ? props.defaultValue : ""}
          placeholder={props.placeholder}
          maxLength={props.maxLength}
          rows={props.rows}
          required={required}
          className="min-h-24 bg-surface"
        />
      ) : (
        <Textarea
          id={id}
          required={required}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={describedBy(id, hint, error)}
          className="min-h-24 bg-surface px-3 py-2.5 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
          {...props}
        />
      )}
      <FieldMessages id={id} hint={hint} error={error} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function SelectField({
  id,
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  required = false,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: FieldChrome &
  Omit<ComponentProps<"select">, "id" | "className"> & {
    children: ReactNode;
  }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-1.5", className)}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        {label}
        {!required ? (
          <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
        ) : null}
      </Label>
      <select
        id={id}

        aria-describedby={describedBy(id, hint, error)}

        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </select>
      <FieldMessages id={id} hint={hint} error={error} />
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\ideas\idea-actions.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowRight, Loader2, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  convertIdeaAction,
  restoreItemAction,
  setIdeaStateAction,
  trashItemAction,
} from "@/lib/actions/mvp";
import { IDEA_STATE_LABELS, IDEA_STATES } from "@/modules/ideas/domain";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const button =
  "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand disabled:opacity-50";

export function IdeaActions({
  ideaId,
  title,
  state,
}: {
  ideaId: string;
  title: string;
  state: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const converted = state === "converted";

  async function convert() {
    setBusy(true);
    const result = await convertIdeaAction(ideaId);
    setBusy(false);
    if (result.status === "error" || !result.projectId) {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível converter a ideia.");
      return;
    }
    toast.success("Ideia convertida em projeto.", { description: title });
    router.push(`/projetos/${result.projectId}`);
  }

  async function changeState(next: string) {
    const result = await setIdeaStateAction(
      ideaId,
      next as (typeof IDEA_STATES)[number],
    );
    if (result.status === "error") toast.error(result.message ?? "Erro.");
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function trash() {
    const result = await trashItemAction("ideas", ideaId);
    if (result.status === "error") {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível excluir.");
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
    toast("Ideia movida para a lixeira.", {
      description: title,
      duration: 8000,
      action: {
        label: "Desfazer",
        onClick: () => {
          void restoreItemAction("ideas", ideaId).then(() => router.refresh());
        },
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
      {!converted ? (
        <>
          <button type="button" className={cn(button, "border-brand text-brand")} onClick={convert} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? (
              <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
            Converter em projeto
          </button>
          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span>Estado</span>
            <select
              className="min-h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-2 text-[12.5px] text-ink"
              value={state}
              onChange={(event) => changeState(event.target.value)}
            >
              {IDEA_STATES.filter((value) => value !== "converted").map((value) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>
                  {IDEA_STATE_LABELS[value]}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </>
      ) : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        className={cn(button, "ml-auto")}
        onClick={trash}
        aria-label={`Excluir ideia: ${title}`}
      >
        <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        Excluir
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

import { MobileNav } from "@/components/layout/mobile-nav";
import { OnboardingTour } from "@/components/onboarding/onboarding-tour";
import { InstallPrompt } from "@/components/pwa/install-prompt";
import { PaletteProvider, type OrbitaPalette } from "@/components/providers/palette-provider";
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent } from "@/components/layout/sidebar";
import type {
  SidebarViewer,
  SidebarWorkspace,
} from "@/components/layout/sidebar";
import { Topbar, type TopbarWorkspace } from "@/components/layout/topbar";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";

export function AppShell({
  viewer,
  workspace,
  unread = 0,
  workspaces = [],
  activeWorkspaceId = null,
  initialPalette,
  children,
}: {
  viewer: SidebarViewer;
  workspace: SidebarWorkspace;
  unread?: number;
  workspaces?: TopbarWorkspace[];
  activeWorkspaceId?: string | null;
  initialPalette: OrbitaPalette;

          <SidebarContent

          />

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Crosshair,
  FolderKanban,
  Home,
  ListChecks,
  MoreHorizontal,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const ITEMS: {
  href: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  exact?: boolean;
}[] = [
  { href: "/", label: "Início", icon: Home, exact: true },
  { href: "/foco", label: "Foco", icon: Crosshair },
  { href: "/projetos", label: "Projetos", icon: FolderKanban },
  { href: "/tarefas", label: "Tarefas", icon: ListChecks },
];

export function MobileNav({ onOpenMore }: { onOpenMore: () => void }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Navegação principal"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-[calc(0.75rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] z-40 mx-auto max-w-[520px] rounded-2xl border border-border/90 bg-surface/95 pb-1 shadow-[0_14px_45px_-18px_rgba(0,0,0,.42)] backdrop-blur-2xl lg:hidden"
    >
      <ul className="grid grid-cols-5 px-1.5">
        {ITEMS.map((item) => {
          const active = item.exact
            ? pathname === item.href
            : pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);
          const Icon = item.icon;

          return (
            <li key={item.href}>
              <Link
                href={item.href}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                className={cn(
                  "relative flex min-h-[64px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1 text-[11px] font-semibold no-underline transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-[-3px] focus-visible:outline-brand",
                  active ? "text-brand" : "text-muted hover:text-ink",
                )}
              >
                <span className={cn(
                  "grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-xl transition-[background-color,transform] duration-200",
                  active && "bg-brand-soft",
                )}>
                  <Icon
                    className={cn("size-5", active && "stroke-[2.3]")}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                </span>
                <span className="leading-none">{item.label}</span>
                {active ? <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 h-0.5 w-5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-brand" /> : null}
              </Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
        <li>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenMore}
            className="flex min-h-[64px] w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted transition-colors hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-[-3px] focus-visible:outline-brand"
            aria-label="Mais opções de navegação"
          >
            <span className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-xl">
              <MoreHorizontal className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </span>
            <span className="leading-none">Mais</span>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}

import {
  Crosshair,
  FolderKanban,
  FolderOpen,
  Globe2,
  GraduationCap,
  History,
  Home,
  Lightbulb,
  ListChecks,
  Search,
  Settings,
  Trash2,
  Users,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

export type NavItem = {
  href: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  exact?: boolean;
};

export const PRIMARY_NAV: NavItem[] = [
  { href: "/", label: "Visão geral", icon: Home, exact: true },
  { href: "/foco", label: "Meu foco", icon: Crosshair },
  { href: "/projetos", label: "Projetos", icon: FolderKanban },
  { href: "/tarefas", label: "Tarefas", icon: ListChecks },
  { href: "/cursos", label: "Cursos", icon: GraduationCap },
  { href: "/arquivos", label: "Arquivos", icon: FolderOpen },
  { href: "/portfolio", label: "Portfólio", icon: Globe2 },
];

export const SECONDARY_NAV: NavItem[] = [
  { href: "/backlog", label: "Ideias e backlog", icon: Lightbulb },
  { href: "/busca", label: "Busca", icon: Search },
  { href: "/historico", label: "Histórico", icon: History },
  { href: "/lixeira", label: "Lixeira", icon: Trash2 },
  { href: "/espacos", label: "Espaços e pessoas", icon: Users },
];

export const SETTINGS_NAV: NavItem = {
  href: "/configuracoes",
  label: "Configurações",
  icon: Settings,
};

export const ALL_NAV = [...PRIMARY_NAV, ...SECONDARY_NAV, SETTINGS_NAV];

export function isActivePath(pathname: string, item: NavItem): boolean {
  if (item.exact) return pathname === item.href;
  return pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);
}

export function currentPageLabel(pathname: string): string {
  const item = ALL_NAV.find((entry) => isActivePath(pathname, entry));
  return item?.label ?? "ÓRBITA";
}

  isActivePath,

function NavLink({
  item,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  item: NavItem;
  onNavigate?: () => void;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const active = isActivePath(pathname, item);
  const Icon = item.icon;

  return (
    <Link
      href={item.href}
      onClick={onNavigate}
      aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
      className={cn(
        "group relative flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium no-underline transition-all duration-150",
        "text-sidebar-foreground/75 hover:bg-sidebar-accent/80 hover:text-white hover:no-underline",
        "focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand",
        active && "bg-sidebar-accent text-white shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,.035)]",
      )}
    >
      {active ? (
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="absolute top-2.5 bottom-2.5 left-0 w-[3px] rounded-r-full bg-brand"
        />
      ) : null}
      <Icon
        className={cn(
          "size-[17px] flex-none transition-colors",
          active ? "text-brand" : "text-sidebar-foreground/55 group-hover:text-sidebar-foreground",
        )}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
      {active ? (
        <span className="size-1.5 flex-none rounded-full bg-brand shadow-[0_0_10px_var(--brand)]" />
      ) : null}
    </Link>
  );
}

function NavSection({
  title,
  items,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  title: string;
  items: NavItem[];

      <h2 className="px-3 pb-1 pt-4 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-[.18em] text-sidebar-foreground/35 uppercase">
        {title}
      </h2>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <NavLink key={item.href} item={item} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

  return (

"use client";

import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";

export function ThemeToggle({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const isDark = resolvedTheme === "dark";

  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          className={className}
          onClick={() => setTheme(isDark ? "light" : "dark")}
          aria-label="Alternar tema"
        >
          <Sun className="size-4 dark:hidden" aria-hidden="true" />
          <Moon className="hidden size-4 dark:block" aria-hidden="true" />
        </Button>
      </TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent>Alternar tema</TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

import { LogoMark } from "@/components/brand/logo";
import { WorkspaceAvatar } from "@/components/brand/workspace-avatar";
import { currentPageLabel } from "@/components/layout/nav-items";
import { ThemeToggle } from "@/components/layout/theme-toggle";

import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { signOutAction } from "@/lib/auth/actions";
import { switchWorkspaceAction } from "@/lib/actions/collab";
import { unreadBadge } from "@/modules/collab/domain";
import type { SidebarViewer, SidebarWorkspace } from "@/components/layout/sidebar";

export type TopbarWorkspace = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  kind: string;
  brandColor: string;
  coverUrl: string | null;
};

export function Topbar({
  viewer,
  workspace,
  unread = 0,
  workspaces = [],
  activeWorkspaceId = null,
  onOpenNav,
}: {
  viewer: SidebarViewer;
  workspace: SidebarWorkspace;
  unread?: number;
  workspaces?: TopbarWorkspace[];
  activeWorkspaceId?: string | null;
  onOpenNav: () => void;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const title = currentPageLabel(pathname);
  const activeWorkspace = workspaces.find((item) => item.id === activeWorkspaceId);
  const workspaceColor = activeWorkspace?.brandColor ?? workspace?.brandColor ?? "#d6a64b";

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-[68px] items-center gap-3 border-b border-border/80 bg-surface/85 px-4 backdrop-blur-xl sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

        onClick={onOpenNav}
        aria-label="Abrir menu de navegação"
      >
        <Menu className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </Button>

      <Link
        href="/"
        className="inline-flex shrink-0 text-brand no-underline lg:hidden"
        aria-label="ÓRBITA — visão geral"
      >
        <LogoMark className="size-6" />
      </Link>

      <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-1">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          <span
            className="inline-flex max-w-[min(42vw,220px)] items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-[.08em]"
            style={{
              borderColor: `${workspaceColor}45`,
              backgroundColor: `${workspaceColor}12`,
              color: workspaceColor,
            }}
            aria-label={`Espaço atual: ${workspace?.name ?? "Órbita"}`}
          >
            <WorkspaceAvatar
              name={workspace?.name ?? "Órbita"}
              brandColor={workspaceColor}
              coverUrl={activeWorkspace?.coverUrl ?? workspace?.coverUrl}
              size="sm"
              className="size-4 rounded-[5px]"
            />
            <span className="truncate">{workspace?.name ?? "ÓRBITA"}</span>
          </span>
          <span className="hidden text-[9px] font-semibold tracking-[.14em] text-faint uppercase sm:inline">
            / ÓRBITA
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="truncate text-[14px] leading-none font-semibold tracking-[-.02em] text-ink sm:text-[15px]" aria-live="polite">
          {title}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2">
        <Link
          href="/notificacoes"
          className="relative inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-muted no-underline transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-ink hover:no-underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand"
          aria-label={
            unread > 0
              ? `Notificações, ${unread} não lida${unread > 1 ? "s" : ""}`
              : "Notificações"
          }
        >
          <Bell className="size-[18px]" aria-hidden="true" />
          {unread > 0 ? (
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="absolute top-1 right-1 grid min-w-[17px] place-items-center rounded-full bg-brand px-1 text-[9px] leading-[17px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm"
            >
              {unreadBadge(unread)}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </Link>

        <ThemeToggle className="size-11 rounded-xl text-muted hover:bg-accent hover:text-ink" />

        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="ml-0.5 inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border/80 bg-surface-2 transition-colors hover:border-brand/40 hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand"
              aria-label={`Menu da conta de ${viewer.name}`}
            >
