                <DropdownMenuLabel className="px-3 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[.12em] text-faint uppercase">
                  Trocar de espaço
                </DropdownMenuLabel>
                {workspaces.map((item) => (
                  <form key={item.id} action={switchWorkspaceAction}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="workspaceId" value={item.id} />
                    <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                      <button
                        type="submit"
                        className="min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer justify-between rounded-xl"
                        aria-current={item.id === activeWorkspaceId ? "true" : undefined}
                      >
                        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 truncate">
                          <WorkspaceAvatar
                            name={item.name}
                            brandColor={item.brandColor}
                            coverUrl={item.coverUrl}
                            size="sm"
                          />
                          {item.name}
                        </span>
                        {item.id === activeWorkspaceId ? (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-brand">ATUAL</span>
                        ) : null}
                      </button>
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  </form>
                ))}
              </>
            ) : null}
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
              <Link href="/configuracoes" className="min-h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-xl">
                Perfil e aparência
              </Link>
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
              <Link href="/espacos" className="min-h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-xl">
                Espaço e pessoas
              </Link>
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <form action={signOutAction}>
              <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl text-danger"
                >
                  Sair da conta
                </button>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </form>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const STORAGE_KEY = "orbita:tour:v1";
const OPEN_EVENT = "orbita:open-tour";

const steps = [
  {
    icon: Compass,

  },

    title: "Seu espa?o, suas regras",
    description:
      "Em Configura??es, personalize a apar?ncia, confira seus dados e ajuste as prefer?ncias de acessibilidade.",
    detail: "Pronto! Voc? pode reabrir este guia quando quiser, pelas Configura??es.",
  },
];

function readSavedStep() {
  try {
    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!saved || !saved.startsWith("paused:")) return 0;
    const value = Number(saved.slice("paused:".length));
    return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value < steps.length
      ? value
      : 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

export function OnboardingTour() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let saved = null;

    try {
      saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch {
      saved = "completed";
    }

    function handleOpen() {
      setStepIndex(readSavedStep());
      setOpen(true);
    }

    window.addEventListener(OPEN_EVENT, handleOpen);

    if (!saved) {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, "paused:0");
      } catch {}
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(OPEN_EVENT));
    }

    return () => window.removeEventListener(OPEN_EVENT, handleOpen);
  }, []);

  function pauseTour() {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, "paused:" + stepIndex);
    } catch {}
    setOpen(false);
  }

  function skipTour() {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, "completed");
    } catch {}
    setOpen(false);
  }

  function nextStep() {
    if (stepIndex === steps.length - 1) {
      skipTour();
      return;
    }

    const next = stepIndex + 1;
    setStepIndex(next);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, "paused:" + next);
    } catch {}
  }

  function previousStep() {
    const previous = Math.max(0, stepIndex - 1);
    setStepIndex(previous);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, "paused:" + previous);
    } catch {}
  }

  const current = steps[stepIndex];
  const StepIcon = current.icon;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
        if (!nextOpen) pauseTour();
        else setOpen(true);
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[85dvh] overflow-y-auto rounded-[24px] border-brand/25 bg-[linear-gradient(145deg,var(--surface),var(--surface-2))] p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] sm:p-7">
        <DialogHeader className="gap-3 pr-7 text-left">
          <div className="flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-brand/25 bg-brand/10 text-brand">
            <StepIcon className="size-6" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-brand">
              Guia do ?rbita
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted">
              Etapa {stepIndex + 1} de {steps.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div
            className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5"
            aria-label={"Progresso: etapa " + (stepIndex + 1) + " de " + steps.length}
          >
            {steps.map((item, index) => (
              <span
                key={item.title}
                className={
                  "h-1.5 rounded-full " +
                  (index <= stepIndex ? "bg-brand" : "bg-border")
                }
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          <DialogTitle className="pt-2 text-xl leading-tight sm:text-2xl">
            {current.title}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">
            {current.description}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface/80 p-4">
          <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink">Dica r?pida</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
            {current.detail}
          </p>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="gap-2 sm:items-center">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            className="min-h-11 sm:mr-auto"
            onClick={skipTour}
          >
            Pular tour
          </Button>
          {stepIndex > 0 ? (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              className="min-h-11"
              onClick={previousStep}
            >
              <ArrowLeft aria-hidden="true" />
              Voltar
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <Button
            type="button"
            className="min-h-11"
            onClick={nextStep}
          >
            {stepIndex === steps.length - 1 ? (
              <>
                Concluir
                <CheckCircle2 aria-hidden="true" />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                Pr?xima etapa
                <ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" />
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function ProgressLine({
  progress,
  className,
  label,
}: {
  progress: Progress;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const text = label ?? progress.label;

  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-1.5", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <span className="text-[12.5px] font-medium text-muted">{text}</span>
        {progress.totalWeight > 0 ? (
          <span className="text-[12px] tabular-nums text-faint">
            {progress.percent}%
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-label={text}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
        aria-valuenow={progress.percent}
        className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-border"
      >
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-[width]"
          style={{ width: `${progress.percent}%` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  Minus,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { DueDateState } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { DUE_DATE_LABELS } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";

type Tone = "danger" | "warning" | "brand" | "success" | "neutral";

const TONES: Record<Tone, string> = {
  danger: "border-danger/25 bg-danger-soft text-[var(--danger-700)]",
  warning: "border-warning/35 bg-warning-soft text-[var(--warning-700)]",
  brand: "border-brand/20 bg-brand-soft text-[var(--brand-700)]",
  success: "border-success/25 bg-success-soft text-[var(--success-700)]",
  neutral: "border-border bg-surface-2 text-muted",
};

const DUE_TONES: Record<DueDateState, Tone> = {
  overdue: "danger",
  today: "warning",
  upcoming: "brand",
  none: "neutral",
};

const DUE_ICONS: Record<DueDateState, LucideIcon> = {
  overdue: AlertTriangle,
  today: Clock3,
  upcoming: CalendarDays,
  none: Minus,
};

export function StatusChip({
  label,
  tone = "neutral",
  icon: Icon,
  className,
}: {
  label: string;
  tone?: Tone;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap",
        TONES[tone],
        className,
      )}
    >
      {Icon ? <Icon className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function DueDateChip({
  state,
  className,
}: {
  state: DueDateState;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <StatusChip
      label={DUE_DATE_LABELS[state]}
      tone={DUE_TONES[state]}
      icon={DUE_ICONS[state]}
      className={className}
    />
  );
}

export function CompletedChip({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <StatusChip
      label="Concluída"
      tone="success"
      icon={CheckCircle2}
      className={className}
    />
  );
}

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="min-h-11 rounded-md bg-danger px-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white hover:opacity-90"
            >
              Confirmar revogação
            </button>
          </form>
        </details>
      </div>

      {state.status === "error" ? <FormMessage status="error" message={state.message} /> : null}
      {state.status === "success" && state.link ? (
        <LinkBox link={state.link} message={state.message} />

import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";

export function LinkBox({ link, message }: { link: string; message?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      setCopied(false); // o campo continua selecionável
    }
  }

  return (
    <div role="status" className="grid gap-2 rounded-md border border-success/30 bg-success-soft p-3">
      {message ? <p className="text-[13px] font-medium">{message}</p> : null}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <input
          readOnly
          value={link}
          aria-label="Link do portfólio"
          onFocus={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()}
          className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[13px]"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={copy}
          className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-surface-2"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
          {copied ? "Copiado" : "Copiar"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { Globe2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormMessage } from "@/components/auth/form-message";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/forms/submit-button";
import { LinkBox } from "@/components/portfolio/link-box";
import { publishPortfolioAction, type PortfolioLinkState } from "@/lib/actions/portfolio";
import { MAX_PORTFOLIO_SUMMARY } from "@/modules/portfolio/domain";

const initial: PortfolioLinkState = { status: "idle" };

export function PublishForm({ projects }: { projects: { id: string; title: string }[] }) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(publishPortfolioAction, initial);

  if (projects.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
        Todos os projetos já têm link ativo, ou você ainda não criou nenhum projeto.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <form action={formAction} className="grid gap-3">
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="pf-project" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
            Projeto
          </label>
          <select
            id="pf-project"
            name="projectId"
            required
            aria-invalid={state.fieldErrors?.projectId ? true : undefined}
            className="h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
          >
            {projects.map((project) => (
              <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                {project.title}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {state.fieldErrors?.projectId?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-danger">{state.fieldErrors.projectId[0]}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor="pf-summary" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
            Resumo público <span className="font-normal text-faint">(opcional)</span>
          </label>
          <textarea
            id="pf-summary"
            name="summary"
            rows={3}
            maxLength={MAX_PORTFOLIO_SUMMARY}
            aria-describedby="pf-summary-hint"
            className="rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
          />
          <p id="pf-summary-hint" className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-faint">
            Aparece para quem abrir o link, junto com título, objetivo, descrição, etapa e
            contagem de tarefas concluídas. Riscos, próximo passo, tarefas, arquivos e pessoas
            nunca são exibidos.
          </p>
        </div>

        {state.status === "error" ? <FormMessage status="error" message={state.message} /> : null}

        <div>
          <SubmitButton pending={pending} pendingLabel="Criando…">
            <Globe2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            Criar link não listado
          </SubmitButton>
        </div>
      </form>

      {state.status === "success" && state.link ? (
        <LinkBox link={state.link} message={state.message} />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import Image from "next/image";

import { projectStageLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import type { DueDateState, Progress } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";

/** Shared shape for the full project list and the dashboard summary. */
type ProjectCardData = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  emoji?: string;
  coverUrl?: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  stage: string;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  progress: Progress;
};

export function ProjectCard({ project }: { project: ProjectCardData }) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={`/projetos/${project.id}`}
      className="group flex min-w-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 text-ink no-underline shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition-[transform,border-color,background-color,box-shadow] duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-brand/35 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] hover:no-underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand sm:p-5"

          <span

            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            {project.coverUrl ? <Image src={project.coverUrl} alt="" width={44} height={44} sizes="44px" className="size-full object-cover" /> : project.emoji ?? "🚀"}
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 pt-0.5">
            <h3 className="line-clamp-2 text-[14px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-[-0.015em] sm:text-[15px]">
              {project.title}
            </h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[10.5px] font-medium tracking-[.04em] text-faint uppercase">
              {projectStageLabel(project.stage)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className="grid size-8 flex-none place-items-center rounded-full text-muted transition-colors group-hover:bg-brand-soft group-hover:text-brand">
          <ArrowUpRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
      </div>

      {project.objective ? (
        <p className="mt-3 line-clamp-2 min-h-9 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
          {project.objective}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-3 min-h-9 text-[12px] text-faint">Adicione um objetivo para orientar este projeto.</p>
      )}

      <div className="mt-auto border-t border-border pt-4">
        <ProgressLine progress={project.progress} />
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          {project.dueDate ? (
            <DueDateChip state={project.dueState} />
          ) : (

          )}
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-brand opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:opacity-100">
            Abrir projeto
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";
import { Pencil, X } from "lucide-react";

import { FormMessage } from "@/components/auth/form-message";
import { TextAreaField, TextField } from "@/components/forms/field";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/forms/submit-button";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { initialFormState } from "@/lib/actions/state";
import { updateProjectDetailsAction } from "@/lib/actions/projects";

export function ProjectDetailsEditor({
  project,
  workspaceId,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  project: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    objective: string | null;
    description: string | null;
    nextStep: string | null;
    risks: string | null;
  };
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    updateProjectDetailsAction,
    initialFormState,
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full basis-full gap-3">
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        className="min-h-9 gap-2"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        aria-expanded={open}
      >
        {open ? <X className="size-4" /> : <Pencil className="size-4" />}
        {open ? "Fechar edição" : "Editar projeto"}
      </Button>

      {open ? (
        <form action={formAction} className="grid gap-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 p-4">
          <input type="hidden" name="projectId" value={project.id} />
          <FormMessage
            status={state.status === "error" ? "error" : "success"}
            message={state.message}
          />
          <TextField
            id="project-edit-title"
            name="title"
            label="Nome do projeto"
            defaultValue={project.title}
            required
            maxLength={160}
            error={state.fieldErrors?.title?.[0]}
          />
          <TextAreaField
            id="project-edit-objective"
            workspaceId={workspaceId}
            name="objective"
            label="Objetivo"
            defaultValue={project.objective ?? ""}
            maxLength={500}
            required={false}
            error={state.fieldErrors?.objective?.[0]}
          />
          <TextAreaField
            id="project-edit-description"
            workspaceId={workspaceId}
            name="description"
            label="Descrição"
            defaultValue={project.description ?? ""}
            maxLength={4000}
            required={false}
            error={state.fieldErrors?.description?.[0]}
          />
          <TextAreaField
            id="project-edit-next-step"
            workspaceId={workspaceId}
            name="nextStep"
            label="Próximo passo"
            defaultValue={project.nextStep ?? ""}
            maxLength={300}
            required={false}
            error={state.fieldErrors?.nextStep?.[0]}
          />
          <TextAreaField
            id="project-edit-risks"
            workspaceId={workspaceId}
            name="risks"
            label="Riscos e bloqueios"
            defaultValue={project.risks ?? ""}
            maxLength={2000}
            required={false}
            error={state.fieldErrors?.risks?.[0]}
          />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <SubmitButton pending={pending} pendingLabel="Salvando…">
              Salvar alterações
            </SubmitButton>
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Cancelar
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProjectEmojiEditor({
  projectId,
  currentEmoji,
  currentImage,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  currentEmoji: string;
  currentImage: string | null;
}) {
  const [emoji, setEmoji] = useState(currentEmoji || "🚀");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("all");
  const [libraryOpen, setLibraryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(currentImage);
  const [emojiState, emojiAction, emojiPending] = useActionState(updateProjectEmojiAction, initialFormState);
  const [imageMessage, setImageMessage] = useState<{ status: "error" | "success"; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [imagePending, startImageTransition] = useTransition();
  const router = useRouter();
  const emojis = useMemo(() => {
    const unique = [...new Set(PROJECT_EMOJIS)];
    const selected = PROJECT_EMOJI_CATEGORIES.find((item) => item.id === category);
    const source = query.trim() || category === "all"
      ? unique
      : unique.filter((item) => selected?.items.includes(item));
    return source.filter((item) => item.includes(query.trim()));
  }, [category, query]);
  const customEmoji = query.trim();
  const canUseCustomEmoji = customEmoji.length > 0 && customEmoji.length <= 8 && /[\p{Extended_Pictographic}\u{1F1E6}-\u{1F1FF}]/u.test(customEmoji);
  const quickEmojis = ["🚀", "💡", "🎯"];

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">Escolha como identificar este projeto</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {quickEmojis.map((item) => (
            <button key={item} type="button" onClick={() => { setEmoji(item); setPreview(null); }} aria-pressed={emoji === item && !preview} className={`grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl border text-2xl transition-colors ${emoji === item && !preview ? "border-brand bg-brand-soft ring-1 ring-brand" : "border-border bg-surface hover:bg-surface-2"}`}>
              {item}
            </button>
          ))}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setLibraryOpen((open) => !open)} aria-expanded={libraryOpen} aria-label="Abrir biblioteca de emojis" className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface text-xl text-muted hover:bg-surface-2">
            {libraryOpen ? <X className="size-4" /> : "…"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {libraryOpen ? (
          <div role="dialog" aria-label="Biblioteca de emojis" className="grid gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)]">
            <label className="relative block">
              <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-faint" aria-hidden="true" />
              <input value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Buscar ou colar um emoji" className="h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-surface-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-brand" />
            </label>
            <div className="-mx-1 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-1" role="group" aria-label="Categorias de emojis">
              {PROJECT_EMOJI_CATEGORIES.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCategory(item.id)}
                  aria-pressed={category === item.id}
                  className={`min-h-8 shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${category === item.id ? "border-brand bg-brand-soft text-brand" : "border-border bg-surface text-muted hover:bg-surface-2"}`}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="grid max-h-52 grid-cols-8 gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto sm:grid-cols-10 md:grid-cols-12" role="group" aria-label="Emojis disponíveis">
              {emojis.map((item) => (
                <button key={item} type="button" onClick={() => { setEmoji(item); setPreview(null); setLibraryOpen(false); }} aria-label={`Usar ${item}`} aria-pressed={emoji === item && !preview} className={`grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border text-xl ${emoji === item && !preview ? "border-brand bg-brand-soft" : "border-transparent hover:bg-surface-2"}`}>
                  {item}
                </button>
              ))}
              {emojis.length === 0 ? <p className="col-span-full py-3 text-center text-xs text-muted">Não encontrei na lista. Você pode colar o emoji e selecioná-lo abaixo.</p> : null}
            </div>
            {canUseCustomEmoji ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { setEmoji(customEmoji); setPreview(null); setLibraryOpen(false); }} className="min-h-9 justify-self-start rounded-md border border-border px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-brand hover:bg-surface-2">Usar {customEmoji}</button> : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <form action={emojiAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <input type="hidden" name="projectId" value={projectId} />
          <input type="hidden" name="emoji" value={emoji} />
          <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 text-2xl" aria-label="Prévia do emoji">{preview ? "🖼️" : emoji}</span>
          <SubmitButton pending={emojiPending} pendingLabel="Salvando…">Usar emoji</SubmitButton>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">A imagem e o emoji são alternativas.</span>
        </form>
        <FormMessage status={emojiState.status === "error" ? "error" : "success"} message={emojiState.message} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink"><ImagePlus className="size-4 text-brand" /> Ou envie uma imagem</div>
        {preview ? <Image src={preview} alt="Prévia da imagem do projeto" width={64} height={64} sizes="64px" unoptimized={preview.startsWith("blob:")} className="size-16 rounded-xl border border-border object-cover" /> : null}
        <form
          className="grid gap-2"
          onSubmit={(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            const input = event.currentTarget.elements.namedItem("icon");
            const file = input instanceof HTMLInputElement ? input.files?.[0] : undefined;
            if (!file) {
              setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "Selecione uma imagem antes de enviar." });
              return;
            }
            const extensions: Record<string, string> = {
              "image/png": "png",
              "image/jpeg": "jpg",
              "image/webp": "webp",
              "image/gif": "gif",
            };
            const extension = extensions[file.type];
            if (!extension) {
              setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "Use uma imagem PNG, JPG, WEBP ou GIF." });
              return;
            }
            if (file.size > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
              setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "A imagem deve ter no máximo 4 MB." });
              return;
            }
            setImageMessage(null);
            startImageTransition(async () => {
              let uploadedPath: string | null = null;
              try {
                const supabase = createBrowserClient();
                const { data: authData, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
                if (authError || !authData.user) {
                  setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "Sua sessão expirou. Entre novamente e tente." });
                  return;
                }
                uploadedPath = `${authData.user.id}/${projectId}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${extension}`;
                const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
                  .from("project-icons")
                  .upload(uploadedPath, file, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false });
                if (uploadError) {
                  setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "Não foi possível enviar a imagem. Confira as permissões do armazenamento no Supabase." });
                  return;
                }
                const result = await saveProjectIconAction(projectId, uploadedPath);
                if (result.status !== "success") {
                  await supabase.storage.from("project-icons").remove([uploadedPath]);
                  setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: result.message || "Não foi possível salvar a imagem." });
                  return;
                }
                setImageMessage({ status: "success", message: result.message || "Imagem atualizada." });
                router.refresh();
              } catch {
                if (uploadedPath) {
                  try {
                    const supabase = createBrowserClient();
                    await supabase.storage.from("project-icons").remove([uploadedPath]);
                  } catch {
                    // A falha de limpeza não deve ocultar a mensagem principal.
                  }
                }
                setImageMessage({ status: "error", message: "Ocorreu um erro ao enviar a imagem. Tente novamente." });
              }
            });
          }}
        >
          <input name="icon" type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" required onChange={(event) => { const file = event.target.files?.[0]; if (file) setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file)); }} className="block w-full text-xs text-muted file:mr-3 file:min-h-10 file:rounded-lg file:border file:border-border file:bg-surface file:px-3 file:text-xs file:font-semibold file:text-ink" />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">PNG, JPG, WEBP ou GIF · até 4 MB.</p>
          <div><SubmitButton pending={imagePending} pendingLabel="Enviando…">Salvar imagem</SubmitButton></div>
        </form>
        {imageMessage ? <FormMessage status={imageMessage.status} message={imageMessage.message} /> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronDown, FolderKanban } from "lucide-react";

type ProjectOption = { id: string; title: string; emoji: string; coverUrl?: string | null; status: string };

export function ProjectSwitcher({
  currentProjectId,
  projects,
}: {
  currentProjectId: string;
  projects: ProjectOption[];
}) {
  const current = projects.find((project) => project.id === currentProjectId);
  const others = projects.filter((project) => project.id !== currentProjectId);

  return (
    <details className="group relative">
      <summary className="inline-flex min-h-9 cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink transition-colors hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
        <FolderKanban className="size-4 text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="max-w-[min(42vw,180px)] truncate">{current?.coverUrl ? <Image src={current.coverUrl} alt="" width={20} height={20} sizes="20px" className="size-5 rounded-md object-cover" /> : current?.emoji ?? "🚀"} {current?.title ?? "Projeto atual"}</span>
        <ChevronDown className="size-3.5 text-muted transition-transform group-open:rotate-180" aria-hidden="true" />
      </summary>
      <div className="absolute left-0 z-40 mt-2 w-[min(340px,92vw)] max-h-80 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-2 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)]">
        <p className="px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.08em] text-faint uppercase">Projeto atual</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-brand-soft px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">
          {current?.coverUrl ? <Image src={current.coverUrl} alt="" width={28} height={28} sizes="28px" className="size-7 rounded-md object-cover" /> : <span className="text-lg">{current?.emoji ?? "🚀"}</span>}
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{current?.title ?? "Projeto atual"}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-brand">ATUAL</span>
        </div>
        <p className="px-2 pt-3 pb-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.08em] text-faint uppercase">Outros projetos · {others.length}</p>
        {others.length ? (
          <div className="grid gap-1">
            {others.map((project) => (
              <Link
                key={project.id}
                href={`/projetos/${project.id}`}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] text-ink no-underline transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:no-underline"
              >
                {project.coverUrl ? <Image src={project.coverUrl} alt="" width={28} height={28} sizes="28px" className="size-7 rounded-md object-cover" /> : <span className="text-lg">{project.emoji || "🚀"}</span>}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{project.title}</span>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="px-2 py-3 text-[12px] text-muted">Não há outros projetos neste espaço.</p>
        )}
        <Link href="/projetos" className="mt-2 block border-t border-border px-2.5 pt-2.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-brand no-underline hover:underline">
          Ver todos os projetos
        </Link>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\providers\motion-preference.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type MotionLevel = "completo" | "leve" | "minimo";

const STORAGE_KEY = "orbita-motion-preference";

function detectMotionLevel(): MotionLevel {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "completo";

  const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  if (reduced) return "minimo";

  const nav = navigator as Navigator & {
    deviceMemory?: number;
    connection?: { saveData?: boolean };
  };

  const lowHardware =
    (typeof nav.hardwareConcurrency === "number" && nav.hardwareConcurrency <= 4) ||
    (typeof nav.deviceMemory === "number" && nav.deviceMemory <= 4) ||
    nav.connection?.saveData === true;

  return lowHardware ? "leve" : "completo";
}

export function MotionPreferenceProvider() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;

    const apply = () => {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const valid = saved === "completo" || saved === "leve" || saved === "minimo";
      const level = valid ? (saved as MotionLevel) : detectMotionLevel();

      root.dataset.motion = level;
    };

    apply();

    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    media.addEventListener("change", apply);

    return () => media.removeEventListener("change", apply);
  }, []);

  return null;
}

"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";

import { updatePaletteAction } from "@/lib/actions/preferences";

export const ORBITA_PALETTES = [
  { id: "amber", label: "Dourado", color: "#D6A64B" },
  { id: "orange", label: "Laranja", color: "#F07835" },
  { id: "blue", label: "Azul", color: "#438FF5" },
  { id: "green", label: "Verde", color: "#2FB887" },
  { id: "purple", label: "Roxo", color: "#A477F5" },
  { id: "red", label: "Vermelho", color: "#E45C65" },
] as const;

export type OrbitaPalette = (typeof ORBITA_PALETTES)[number]["id"];

type PaletteContextValue = {
  palette: OrbitaPalette;
  setPalette: (palette: OrbitaPalette) => void;
};

const PaletteContext = createContext<PaletteContextValue | null>(null);

export function PaletteProvider({
  initialPalette,
  children,
}: {
  initialPalette: OrbitaPalette;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const [palette, setPaletteState] = useState<OrbitaPalette>(initialPalette);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.palette = palette;
  }, [palette]);

  const setPalette = useCallback((next: OrbitaPalette) => {
    setPaletteState(next);
    void updatePaletteAction(next);
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ palette, setPalette }), [palette, setPalette]);

  return (
    <PaletteContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </PaletteContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useOrbitaPalette() {
  const context = useContext(PaletteContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useOrbitaPalette must be used within PaletteProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

ARQUIVO: components\pwa\install-prompt.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Download, Share2, X } from "lucide-react";

interface InstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{
    outcome: "accepted" | "dismissed";
    platform: string;
  }>;
}

const DISMISSED_KEY = "orbita:pwa-install-dismissed:v1";
const INSTALLED_KEY = "orbita:pwa-installed:v1";
const COOLDOWN_MS = 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export function InstallPrompt() {
  const [installEvent, setInstallEvent] = useState<InstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [showIosHint, setShowIosHint] = useState(false);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);
  const [installed, setInstalled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isStandalone =
      window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches ||
      (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;

    let coolingDown = false;
    let alreadyInstalled = false;

    try {
      const dismissedAt = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(DISMISSED_KEY) || 0);
      coolingDown = dismissedAt > 0 && Date.now() - dismissedAt < COOLDOWN_MS;
      alreadyInstalled = window.localStorage.getItem(INSTALLED_KEY) === "true";
    } catch {
      // O aviso continua funcionando mesmo sem acesso ao armazenamento.
    }

    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (isStandalone || alreadyInstalled) setInstalled(true);
      if (coolingDown) setDismissed(true);

      const agent = navigator.userAgent;
      const isIos =
        /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(agent) ||
        (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
      const isSafari =
        /Safari/.test(agent) &&
        !/CriOS|FxiOS|EdgiOS|OPiOS/.test(agent);

      if (!isStandalone && !alreadyInstalled && !coolingDown && isIos && isSafari) {
        setShowIosHint(true);
      }
    });

    function handleBeforeInstall(event: Event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      setShowIosHint(false);
      setInstallEvent(event as InstallPromptEvent);
    }

    function handleInstalled() {
      setInstalled(true);
      setInstallEvent(null);
      setShowIosHint(false);

      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(INSTALLED_KEY, "true");
      } catch {
        // A instala??o j? foi conclu?da pelo navegador.
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleBeforeInstall);
    window.addEventListener("appinstalled", handleInstalled);

    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleBeforeInstall);
      window.removeEventListener("appinstalled", handleInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  function dismissPrompt() {
    setDismissed(true);

    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(DISMISSED_KEY, String(Date.now()));
    } catch {
      // A prefer?ncia permanece v?lida durante esta sess?o.
    }
  }

  async function installApp() {
    if (!installEvent) return;

    await installEvent.prompt();
    const choice = await installEvent.userChoice;
    setInstallEvent(null);

    if (choice.outcome === "accepted") {
      setInstalled(true);
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(INSTALLED_KEY, "true");
      } catch {
        // O navegador confirmou a escolha.
      }
    } else {
      dismissPrompt();
    }
  }

  if (installed || dismissed || (!installEvent && !showIosHint)) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <aside
      role="region"
      aria-label="Instalar aplicativo ?rbita"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-[calc(5.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] z-40 mx-auto flex max-w-lg items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-brand/30 bg-surface/95 p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] backdrop-blur-md lg:inset-x-auto lg:right-5 lg:bottom-5"
    >
      <div className="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-brand/15 text-brand">
        {showIosHint ? (
          <Share2 className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : (
          <Download className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          {showIosHint ? "Leve o ?rbita com voc?" : "Instale o ?rbita"}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          {showIosHint
            ? "No Safari, toque em Compartilhar e depois em Adicionar ? Tela de In?cio."
            : "Acesse seus projetos e tarefas como um aplicativo."}
        </p>
      </div>

      {installEvent && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void installApp()}
          className="min-h-11 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-brand px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
        >
          Instalar
        </button>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={dismissPrompt}
        aria-label="Fechar aviso de instala??o"

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function PwaSplash() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isStandalone =
      window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches ||
      (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;

    if (!isStandalone) return;

    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => setVisible(true));
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), 900);

    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <div className="orbita-pwa-splash" aria-hidden="true">
      <div className="orbita-pwa-splash-mark">
        <span />
      </div>
      <span className="orbita-pwa-splash-name">?RBITA</span>
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\pwa\service-worker-registration.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

/**
 * Registers the foundation service worker. Disabled in development so hot
 * reloading never serves stale shell files.
 */
export function ServiceWorkerRegistration() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") return;
    if (typeof navigator === "undefined" || !("serviceWorker" in navigator)) {
      return;
    }

    const register = () => {
      void navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch(() => {
        // Registration is best-effort: the app works without it.
      });
    };

    if (document.readyState === "complete") {
      register();
      return;
    }

    window.addEventListener("load", register, { once: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("load", register);
  }, []);

  return null;
}

type MotionChoice = "automatico" | "completo" | "leve" | "minimo";

const MOTION_OPTIONS: { value: MotionChoice; label: string; description: string }[] = [
  { value: "automatico", label: "Autom?tico", description: "Adapta os efeitos ao desempenho do dispositivo." },
  { value: "completo", label: "Completo", description: "Mant?m todas as anima??es e efeitos visuais." },
  { value: "leve", label: "Leve", description: "Reduz efeitos para economizar bateria e processamento." },
  { value: "minimo", label: "M?nimo", description: "Reduz anima??es ao essencial." },
];

const MOTION_STORAGE_KEY = "orbita-motion-preference";
const MOTION_CHANGE_EVENT = "orbita-motion-change";

function getMotionSnapshot(): MotionChoice {
  const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(MOTION_STORAGE_KEY);
  return saved === "completo" || saved === "leve" || saved === "minimo"
    ? saved
    : "automatico";
}

function getMotionServerSnapshot(): MotionChoice {
  return "automatico";
}

function subscribeMotion(callback: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener("storage", callback);
  window.addEventListener(MOTION_CHANGE_EVENT, callback);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("storage", callback);
    window.removeEventListener(MOTION_CHANGE_EVENT, callback);
  };
}

function applyMotionPreference(value: MotionChoice) {
  const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  if (reduced || value === "minimo") {
    document.documentElement.dataset.motion = "minimo";
    return;
  }

  if (value === "completo" || value === "leve") {
    document.documentElement.dataset.motion = value;
    return;
  }

  const nav = navigator as Navigator & {
    deviceMemory?: number;
    connection?: { saveData?: boolean };
  };

  const lowHardware =
    (typeof nav.hardwareConcurrency === "number" && nav.hardwareConcurrency <= 4) ||
    (typeof nav.deviceMemory === "number" && nav.deviceMemory <= 4) ||
    nav.connection?.saveData === true;

  document.documentElement.dataset.motion = lowHardware ? "leve" : "completo";
}

function saveMotionPreference(value: MotionChoice) {
  if (value === "automatico") {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(MOTION_STORAGE_KEY);
  } else {
    window.localStorage.setItem(MOTION_STORAGE_KEY, value);
  }

  applyMotionPreference(value);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(MOTION_CHANGE_EVENT));
}

export function ThemePreference() {
  const motion = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeMotion,
    getMotionSnapshot,
    getMotionServerSnapshot,
  );

  function changeMotion(value: MotionChoice) {
    saveMotionPreference(value);
  }
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const { palette, setPalette } = useOrbitaPalette();
  const mounted = useMounted();
  const current = mounted ? theme ?? "system" : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <fieldset>
        <legend className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Paleta de cores</legend>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-xl text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted">
          Personalize os destaques, botões, seleções e elementos da marca.
          Prioridades, alertas e estados continuam com suas cores próprias.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {ORBITA_PALETTES.map((option) => {
            const checked = palette === option.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={option.id}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={checked}
                onClick={() => setPalette(option.id)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex min-h-[68px] items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3 py-3 text-left transition-all",
                  checked
                    ? "border-brand bg-brand/5 ring-2 ring-brand/20"
                    : "border-border bg-surface hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2",
                )}
              >
                <span
                  className="grid size-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-full"

                >
                  {checked ? <Check className="size-4 text-white" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { assignTaskAction } from "@/lib/actions/collab";

export type AssigneeOption = { id: string; name: string };

export function AssigneeSelect({
  taskId,
  current,
  options,
}: {
  taskId: string;
  current: string | null;
  options: AssigneeOption[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(current ?? "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  async function change(next: string) {
    const previous = value;
    setValue(next);
    setSaving(true);
    const result = await assignTaskAction({ taskId, assigneeId: next || null });
    setSaving(false);
    if (result.status === "error") {
      setValue(previous);
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível atribuir.");
      return;
    }
    toast.success(next ? "Responsável atualizado." : "Tarefa sem responsável.");
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-1.5">
      <label htmlFor="assignee" className="text-[13px] font-medium">
        Responsável
      </label>
      <select
        id="assignee"
        value={value}
        disabled={saving}
        onChange={(event) => change(event.target.value)}
        className="h-11 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] md:text-sm"
      >
        <option value="">Sem responsável</option>
        {options.map((option) => (
          <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>
            {option.name}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      <p className="text-xs text-faint">Leitores não aparecem: eles não podem receber tarefas.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\tasks\kanban-board.tsx

"use client";

import { useMemo, useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import {
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUp,
  CalendarDays,
  GripVertical,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { UserAvatar } from "@/components/layout/user-avatar";
import { StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";
import {
  moveTaskAction,
  reorderColumnAction,
  restoreItemAction,
  trashItemAction,
} from "@/lib/actions/mvp";
import type { KanbanTask } from "@/lib/data/tasks";
import { priorityLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import {
  adjacentStatus,
  KANBAN_COLUMNS,
  positionForIndex,
  rebalancePositions,
  type KanbanStatus,
} from "@/modules/tasks/kanban";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const byPosition = (a: KanbanTask, b: KanbanTask) => a.position - b.position;

const COLUMN_STYLES: Record<KanbanStatus, { marker: string; count: string; drop: string }> = {
  todo: {
    marker: "bg-slate-400",
    count: "bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300",
    drop: "border-slate-400/50 bg-slate-400/5",
  },
  in_progress: {
    marker: "bg-brand",
    count: "bg-brand/10 text-brand",
    drop: "border-brand/60 bg-brand/5",
  },
  done: {
    marker: "bg-success",
    count: "bg-success/10 text-success",
    drop: "border-success/50 bg-success/5",
  },
};

function formatDueDate(value: string): string {
  const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
  }).format(new Date(year, month - 1, day, 12));
}

export function KanbanBoard({ tasks }: { tasks: KanbanTask[] }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(tasks);
  const [previousTasks, setPreviousTasks] = useState(tasks);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");
  const [draggedTaskId, setDraggedTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverStatus, setDragOverStatus] = useState<KanbanStatus | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);

  if (tasks !== previousTasks) {
    setPreviousTasks(tasks);
    setItems(tasks);
  }

  const columns = useMemo(() => {
    const grouped: Record<KanbanStatus, KanbanTask[]> = {
      todo: [],
      in_progress: [],
      done: [],
    };

    for (const task of items) {
      grouped[task.status].push(task);
    }

    for (const tasksInColumn of Object.values(grouped)) {
      tasksInColumn.sort(byPosition);
    }

    return grouped;
  }, [items]);

  const column = (status: KanbanStatus) => columns[status];

  async function persist(
    task: KanbanTask,
    status: KanbanStatus,
    position: number,
    rebalanceIds: string[] | null,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const result = rebalanceIds
      ? await reorderColumnAction({ status, orderedIds: rebalanceIds })
      : await moveTaskAction({ taskId: task.id, status, position });
    if (result.status === "error") {
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível mover a tarefa.");
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  async function move(task: KanbanTask, status: KanbanStatus, index: number) {
    if (busyRef.current) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    const before = items;
    const others = column(status).filter((entry) => entry.id !== task.id);
    const safeIndex = Math.min(Math.max(index, 0), others.length);
    const { position, rebalance } = positionForIndex(
      others.map((entry) => entry.position),
      safeIndex,
    );
    const ordered = [
      ...others.slice(0, safeIndex),
      task,
      ...others.slice(safeIndex),
    ];
    const renumbered = rebalance ? rebalancePositions(ordered.length) : [];
    const orderedIndexById = new Map(
      ordered.map((entry, index) => [entry.id, index]),
    );

    const next = before.map((entry) => {
      const at = orderedIndexById.get(entry.id);
      if (rebalance && at !== undefined) {
        return { ...entry, status, position: renumbered[at] };
      }
      return entry.id === task.id ? { ...entry, status, position } : entry;
    });

    setItems(next);
    const label = KANBAN_COLUMNS.find((entry) => entry.status === status)?.label;
    setAnnouncement(
      `${task.title} movida para ${label}, posição ${safeIndex + 1} de ${ordered.length}.`,
    );

    try {
      const saved = await persist(
        task,
        status,
        position,
        rebalance ? ordered.map((entry) => entry.id) : null,
      );
      if (!saved) {
        setItems(before);
        return;
      }

      if (status === "done" && task.status !== "done") {
        toast.success("Tarefa concluída.", {
          description: task.title,
          duration: 6000,
          action: {
            label: "Desfazer",
            onClick: () => {
              if (busyRef.current) return;
              busyRef.current = true;
              setBusy(true);
              void persist(task, task.status, task.position, null)
                .then((saved) => {
                  if (saved) setItems(before);
                })
                .finally(() => {
                  busyRef.current = false;
                  setBusy(false);
                });
            },
          },
        });
      }
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function dropOnColumn(event: DragEvent<HTMLElement>, status: KanbanStatus) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    setDragOverStatus(null);
    const id = event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain") || draggedTaskId;
    const dragged = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
    if (!dragged) return;
    if (dragged.id === id && dragged.status === status && column(status).length === 1) return;
    void move(dragged, status, column(status).filter((entry) => entry.id !== dragged.id).length);
    setDraggedTaskId(null);
  }

  function dropOnCard(
    event: DragEvent<HTMLElement>,
    status: KanbanStatus,
    targetId: string,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    setDragOverStatus(null);
    const id = event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain") || draggedTaskId;
    const dragged = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
    if (!dragged || dragged.id === targetId) {
      setDraggedTaskId(null);
      return;
    }
    const target = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const after = event.clientY > target.top + target.height / 2;
    const targetIndex = column(status).findIndex((entry) => entry.id === targetId);
    const insertAt = targetIndex + (after ? 1 : 0);
    const adjusted = dragged.status === status && column(status).findIndex((entry) => entry.id === dragged.id) < insertAt
      ? insertAt - 1
      : insertAt;
    void move(dragged, status, adjusted);
    setDraggedTaskId(null);
  }

  async function trash(task: KanbanTask) {
    if (busyRef.current) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    const before = items;
    setBusy(true);
    setItems(items.filter((entry) => entry.id !== task.id));
    try {
      const result = await trashItemAction("tasks", task.id);
      if (result.status === "error") {
        setItems(before);
        toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível excluir.");
        return;
      }
      toast("Tarefa movida para a lixeira.", {
        description: task.title,
        duration: 8000,
        action: {
          label: "Desfazer",
          onClick: () => {
            if (busyRef.current) return;
            busyRef.current = true;
            setBusy(true);
            void restoreItemAction("tasks", task.id)
              .then(() => setItems(before))
              .finally(() => {
                busyRef.current = false;
                setBusy(false);
              });
          },
        },
      });
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <p className="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">{announcement}</p>
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] text-muted">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <GripVertical className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          No computador, arraste os cartões. No celular, use os controles do cartão.
        </span>
        <span className="hidden shrink-0 sm:inline">{items.length} no total</span>
      </div>

      <div
        className="-mx-4 grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-[minmax(280px,86vw)] gap-3 overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain px-4 pb-4 snap-x snap-mandatory sm:auto-cols-[minmax(300px,44vw)] lg:mx-0 lg:grid-flow-row lg:grid-cols-3 lg:auto-cols-auto lg:overflow-visible lg:px-0"
        aria-label="Colunas do quadro; deslize horizontalmente para ver as próximas"
      >
        {KANBAN_COLUMNS.map(({ status, label }) => {
          const cards = column(status);
          const style = COLUMN_STYLES[status];
          const isDropTarget = dragOverStatus === status;
          return (
            <section
              key={status}
              aria-labelledby={`col-${status}`}
              onDragOver={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
                setDragOverStatus(status);
              }}
              onDragLeave={(event) => {
                if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
                  setDragOverStatus(null);
                }
              }}
              onDrop={(event) => dropOnColumn(event, status)}
              className={cn(
                "flex min-h-[400px] min-w-0 snap-start flex-col rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/80 p-3.5 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition-colors sm:p-4",
                isDropTarget && style.drop,
              )}
            >
              <header className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
                  <span className={cn("size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", style.marker)} />
                  <h2 id={`col-${status}`} className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink">
                    {label}
                  </h2>
                  <span className={cn("rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold tabular-nums", style.count)}>
                    {cards.length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-faint">#{KANBAN_COLUMNS.findIndex((entry) => entry.status === status) + 1}</span>
              </header>

              <div className="grid flex-1 content-start gap-2.5">
                {cards.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className={cn(
                    "grid min-h-36 flex-1 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border-strong px-4 py-6 text-center transition-colors",
                    isDropTarget && style.drop,
                  )}>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[12px] font-medium text-muted">Solte uma tarefa aqui</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-faint">Esta coluna está vazia.</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  cards.map((task, index) => {
                    const left = adjacentStatus(task.status, "left");
                    const right = adjacentStatus(task.status, "right");
                    const priorityTone = task.priority === "urgent" || task.priority === "high"
                      ? "danger"
                      : task.priority === "medium"
                        ? "warning"
                        : "neutral";
                    return (
                      <article
                        key={task.id}
                        draggable={!busy}
                        onDragStart={(event) => {
                          event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", task.id);
                          event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
                          setDraggedTaskId(task.id);
                        }}
                        onDragEnd={() => {
                          setDraggedTaskId(null);
                          setDragOverStatus(null);
                        }}
                        onDragOver={(event) => {
                          event.preventDefault();
                          event.stopPropagation();
                          event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
                          setDragOverStatus(status);
                        }}
                        onDrop={(event) => dropOnCard(event, status, task.id)}
                        className={cn(
                          "list-none rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface/95 p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-1)] transition-[opacity,border-color,box-shadow,transform] hover:border-brand/35 hover:shadow-[var(--shadow-2)] active:cursor-grabbing",
                          draggedTaskId === task.id && "opacity-40",
                          "cursor-grab",
                        )}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <Link
                            href={`/tarefas/${task.id}`}
                            className={cn(
                              "min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13.5px] leading-snug font-semibold text-ink no-underline hover:text-brand hover:underline sm:text-sm",
                              task.status === "done" && "line-through text-muted",
                            )}
                          >
                            {task.title}
                          </Link>
                          <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[10px] text-faint" aria-hidden="true">
                            <GripVertical className="size-4" />
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                          <StatusChip label={priorityLabel(task.priority)} tone={priorityTone} />
                          {task.dueDate ? (
                            <span className={cn(
                              "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium",
                              task.dueState === "overdue"
                                ? "border-danger/25 bg-danger-soft text-[var(--danger-700)]"
                                : task.dueState === "today"
                                  ? "border-warning/35 bg-warning-soft text-[var(--warning-700)]"
                                  : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-muted",
                            )}>
                              <CalendarDays className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                              {formatDueDate(task.dueDate)}
                              {task.dueState === "overdue" ? " · Atrasada" : task.dueState === "today" ? " · Hoje" : ""}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[10.5px] text-faint">Sem prazo</span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-3 flex min-w-0 items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border/80 pt-3">
                          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                            {task.assigneeName ? (
                              <>
                                <UserAvatar name={task.assigneeName} size="sm" />
                                <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-muted">{task.assigneeName}</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">Sem responsável</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <span className="max-w-[42%] truncate text-right text-[10.5px] text-faint">
                            {task.projectTitle ?? "Sem projeto"}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div
                          role="group"
                          aria-label={`Mover ou excluir ${task.title}`}
                          className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1 border-t border-border/80 pt-2.5"
                        >
                          <CardButton label={`Mover ${task.title} para a coluna anterior`} disabled={busy || !left} onClick={() => left && move(task, left, column(left).length)}>
                            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </CardButton>
                          <CardButton label={`Subir ${task.title} na coluna`} disabled={busy || index === 0} onClick={() => move(task, status, index - 1)}>
                            <ArrowUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </CardButton>
                          <CardButton label={`Descer ${task.title} na coluna`} disabled={busy || index === cards.length - 1} onClick={() => move(task, status, index + 1)}>
                            <ArrowDown className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </CardButton>
                          <CardButton label={`Mover ${task.title} para a próxima coluna`} disabled={busy || !right} onClick={() => right && move(task, right, 0)}>
                            <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </CardButton>
                          <CardButton label={`Excluir ${task.title}`} className="ml-auto" onClick={() => trash(task)} disabled={busy}>
                            <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </CardButton>
                        </div>
                      </article>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CardButton({
  label,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 text-muted transition-colors hover:border-brand/40 hover:bg-brand/10 hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30 sm:size-8",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { setTaskDoneAction } from "@/lib/actions/tasks";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function TaskCheckbox({
  taskId,
  title,
  done = false,
  className,
}: {
  taskId: string;
  title: string;
  done?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState(done);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  async function persist(next: boolean) {
    const result = await setTaskDoneAction(taskId, next);
    router.refresh();

    if (result.status === "error") {
      setChecked(!next);
      toast.error(result.message ?? "Não foi possível atualizar a tarefa.");
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  async function toggle() {
    if (saving) return;

    const next = !checked;
    setChecked(next);
    setSaving(true);

    const ok = await persist(next);

    if (ok && next) {
      toast.success("Tarefa concluída.", {
        description: title,
        duration: 6000,
        action: {
          label: "Desfazer",
          onClick: () => {
            setChecked(false);
            void persist(false);
          },
        },
      });
    }

    setSaving(false);
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggle}
      aria-pressed={checked}
      aria-label={checked ? `Reabrir: ${title}` : `Concluir: ${title}`}
      className={cn(
        "group grid size-11 flex-none place-items-center rounded-full text-muted transition-colors hover:text-success focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={cn(
          "grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-border-strong bg-surface transition-colors group-hover:border-success",
          checked && "border-success bg-success text-white",
        )}
      >
        {saving ? (
          <Loader2 className="size-3 animate-spin" />
        ) : checked ? (
          <Check className="size-3.5" strokeWidth={3} />
        ) : null}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

import { TaskCheckbox } from "@/components/tasks/task-checkbox";
import { DueDateChip, StatusChip } from "@/components/patterns/status-chip";
import { UserAvatar } from "@/components/layout/user-avatar";
import { priorityLabel } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import type { TaskListItem } from "@/lib/data/tasks";
import type { DueDateState } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * The row only needs what it renders. Both the full task list and the lighter
 * dashboard payload fit this shape.
 */
type TaskRowData = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  priority: string;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  status?: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";
  projectTitle?: string | null;
  assigneeName?: string | null;
};

export function TaskRow({
  task,
  className,
  showProject = true,
}: {
  task: TaskRowData;
  className?: string;
  showProject?: boolean;
}) {
  const done = task.status === "done";
  const highPriority =
    task.priority === "high" || task.priority === "urgent";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3 px-3 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2/65 sm:px-4",
        done && "opacity-65",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="pt-0.5">
        <TaskCheckbox taskId={task.id} title={task.title} done={done} />
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p
          className={cn(
            "text-[13px] leading-snug font-medium text-ink sm:text-[13.5px]",
            done && "line-through decoration-1",
          )}
        >
          {task.title}
        </p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1.5">
          {showProject ? (
            <span className="max-w-full truncate text-[11px] text-faint">
              {task.projectTitle ?? "Sem projeto"}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {!done ? <DueDateChip state={task.dueState} /> : null}
          <StatusChip
            label={priorityLabel(task.priority)}
            tone={highPriority ? "danger" : "neutral"}
          />
          {task.assigneeName ? (
            <span className="ml-auto inline-flex flex-none items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-faint">
              <UserAvatar name={task.assigneeName} size="sm" />
              <span className="sr-only">Responsável: {task.assigneeName}</span>
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function TaskRowLink({
  task,
  className,
}: {
  task: TaskListItem;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={`/tarefas/${task.id}`}
      className={cn(
        "block rounded-xl no-underline transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <TaskRow task={task} />
    </Link>
  );
}

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const alertVariants = cva(
  "relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] items-start gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&>svg]:text-current",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-card text-card-foreground",
        destructive:
          "bg-card text-destructive *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90 [&>svg]:text-current",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Alert({
  className,
  variant,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert"
      role="alert"
      className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-title"
      className={cn(
        "col-start-2 line-clamp-1 min-h-4 font-medium tracking-tight",

      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (

      data-slot="alert-description"

      )}

}

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription }

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-transparent px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[0.01em] whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary/12 text-primary [a&]:hover:bg-primary/18",
        secondary: "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-secondary/90",
        destructive: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 [a&]:hover:bg-destructive/15",

        ghost: "bg-transparent text-muted-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-foreground",
        link: "bg-transparent px-0 text-primary underline-offset-4 [a&]:hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span"> &
  VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "span"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}
