import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { DueDateState } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { classifyDueDate } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";

export type CourseListItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  platform: string | null;
  url: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  status: "planned" | "in_progress" | "paused" | "completed";
  progress: number;
  nextLesson: string | null;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  moduleCount: number;
  doneModules: number;
};

type CourseRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  platform: string | null;
  url: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  status: "planned" | "in_progress" | "paused" | "completed";
  progress: number;
  next_lesson: string | null;
  due_date: string | null;
  course_modules: { id: string; done_at: string | null }[] | null;
};

export async function listCourses({
  workspaceId,
  today,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  today: string;
}): Promise<CourseListItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("courses")
    .select(
      "id, title, platform, url, objective, status, progress, next_lesson, due_date, course_modules(id, done_at)",
    )
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .is("archived_at", null)
    .order("status", { ascending: true })
    .order("updated_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);

  if (error) return [];

  return ((data ?? []) as unknown as CourseRow[]).map((row) => {
    const modules = row.course_modules ?? [];
    return {
      id: row.id,
      title: row.title,
      platform: row.platform,
      url: row.url,
      objective: row.objective,
      status: row.status,
      progress: row.progress,
      nextLesson: row.next_lesson,
      dueDate: row.due_date,
      dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
      moduleCount: modules.length,
      doneModules: modules.filter((module) => module.done_at).length,
    };
  });
}

ARQUIVO: lib\data\dashboard.ts

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { startOfWeekIso } from "@/lib/dates";
import type { DueDateState, Progress } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { calculateProgress, classifyDueDate } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { projectStagePosition } from "@/modules/projects/domain";
import type { FocusScope } from "@/modules/focus/domain";
import { progressByProject, type ProgressRow } from "@/lib/data/progress";

export type DashboardTask = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  priority: string;
  projectTitle: string | null;
};

export type DashboardProject = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  emoji: string;
  coverUrl: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  nextStep: string | null;
  stage: string;
  stagePosition: number;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  progress: Progress;
};

export type DashboardCourse = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  platform: string | null;
  progress: number;
  nextLesson: string | null;
  dueDate: string | null;
};

export type UpcomingDeadline = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  date: string;
  context: string | null;
  kind: "task" | "project" | "course";
};

export type ActivityItem = {
  id: string;
  verb: string;
  entityType: string;
  actorName: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

export type DashboardData = {
  focusProject: DashboardProject | null;
  focusCourse: DashboardCourse | null;
  todayTasks: DashboardTask[];
  overdueTasks: DashboardTask[];
  upcomingTasks: DashboardTask[];
  projects: DashboardProject[];
  deadlines: UpcomingDeadline[];
  activity: ActivityItem[];
  stats: {
    openCount: number;
    overdueCount: number;
    completedThisWeek: number;
    createdThisWeek: number;
  };
};

type TaskRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  due_date: string | null;
  priority: string;
  status: string;
  project_id: string | null;
  projects: { title: string } | null;
};

type ProjectRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  emoji: string;
  cover_url: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  next_step: string | null;
  stage: string;
  due_date: string | null;
};

function toDashboardTask(
  row: TaskRow,
  today: string,
): DashboardTask {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    dueDate: row.due_date,
    dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
    priority: row.priority,
    projectTitle: row.projects?.title ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Everything the overview needs, in a fixed number of queries. Missing tables
 * (before migrations run) degrade to empty states instead of crashing.
 */
export async function getDashboardData({
  workspaceId,
  userId,
  today,
  focusScope,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  userId: string;
  today: string;
  focusScope: FocusScope;
}): Promise<DashboardData> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const weekStart = startOfWeekIso(today);
  const weekStartIso = `${weekStart}T00:00:00.000Z`;

  const [tasksResult, projectsResult, focusResult, completedResult, createdResult, activityResult] =
    await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from("tasks")
        .select(
          "id, title, due_date, priority, status, project_id, projects(title)",
        )
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .neq("status", "done")
        .is("deleted_at", null)
        .order("due_date", { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false })
        .limit(80),
      supabase
        .from("projects")
        .select("id, title, emoji, cover_url, objective, next_step, stage, due_date")
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .eq("status", "active")
        .is("deleted_at", null)
        .order("updated_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(6),
      supabase
        .from("focus_assignments")
        .select("kind, target_id, scope_key")
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId),
      supabase
        .from("tasks")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .eq("status", "done")
        .gte("completed_at", weekStartIso)
        .is("deleted_at", null),
      supabase
        .from("tasks")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .gte("created_at", weekStartIso)
        .is("deleted_at", null),
      supabase
        .from("activity_events")
        .select("id, verb, entity_type, created_at, actor:profiles(full_name)")
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(5),
    ]);

  const taskRows = (tasksResult.data ?? []) as unknown as TaskRow[];
  const projectRows = (projectsResult.data ?? []) as unknown as ProjectRow[];
  const scopeKey = focusScope === "user" ? userId : "workspace";
  const focusRows = (focusResult.data ?? []) as {
    kind: "project" | "course";
    target_id: string;
    scope_key: string;
  }[];
  const focusProjectId =
    focusRows.find(
      (row) => row.kind === "project" && row.scope_key === scopeKey,
    )?.target_id ?? null;
  const focusCourseId =
    focusRows.find(
      (row) => row.kind === "course" && row.scope_key === scopeKey,
    )?.target_id ?? null;

  const projectIds = projectRows.map((project) => project.id);
  if (focusProjectId && !projectIds.includes(focusProjectId)) {
    projectIds.push(focusProjectId);
  }

  const [progressResult, focusProjectResult, focusCourseResult] = await Promise.all([
    projectIds.length
      ? supabase
          .from("tasks")
          .select("project_id, weight, status, parent_task_id")
          .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
          .in("project_id", projectIds)
          .is("deleted_at", null)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as ProgressRow[] }),
    focusProjectId && !projectRows.some((row) => row.id === focusProjectId)
      ? supabase
          .from("projects")
          .select("id, title, emoji, cover_url, objective, next_step, stage, due_date")
          .eq("id", focusProjectId)
          .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
          .maybeSingle<ProjectRow>()
      : Promise.resolve({ data: null as ProjectRow | null }),
    focusCourseId
      ? supabase
          .from("courses")
          .select("id, title, platform, progress, next_lesson, due_date")
          .eq("id", focusCourseId)
          .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
          .is("deleted_at", null)
          .maybeSingle<{
            id: string;
            title: string;
            platform: string | null;
            progress: number;
            next_lesson: string | null;
            due_date: string | null;
          }>()
      : Promise.resolve({ data: null }),
  ]);

  const progress = progressByProject(
    (progressResult.data ?? []) as ProgressRow[],
  );

  const projectById = new Map(projectRows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  if (focusProjectResult.data) {
    projectById.set(focusProjectResult.data.id, focusProjectResult.data);
  }

  const toProject = (row: ProjectRow): DashboardProject => ({
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    emoji: row.emoji || "🚀",
    coverUrl: row.cover_url,
    objective: row.objective,
    nextStep: row.next_step,
    stage: row.stage,
    stagePosition: projectStagePosition(row.stage),
    dueDate: row.due_date,
    dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
    progress: progress.get(row.id) ?? calculateProgress([]),
  });

  const projects = projectRows.map(toProject);
  const focusProjectRow = focusProjectId
    ? projectById.get(focusProjectId) ?? null
    : null;

  const focusCourse: DashboardCourse | null = focusCourseResult.data
    ? {
        id: focusCourseResult.data.id,
        title: focusCourseResult.data.title,
        platform: focusCourseResult.data.platform,
        progress: focusCourseResult.data.progress,
        nextLesson: focusCourseResult.data.next_lesson,
        dueDate: focusCourseResult.data.due_date,
      }
    : null;

  const tasks = taskRows.map((row) => toDashboardTask(row, today));
  const todayTasks = tasks.filter((task) => task.dueState === "today");
  const overdueTasks = tasks.filter((task) => task.dueState === "overdue");
  const upcomingTasks = tasks.filter((task) => task.dueState === "upcoming");

  const deadlines: UpcomingDeadline[] = [
    ...tasks
      .filter((task) => task.dueDate)
      .map((task) => ({
        id: `task-${task.id}`,
        title: task.title,
        date: task.dueDate as string,
        context: task.projectTitle,
        kind: "task" as const,
      })),
    ...projectRows
      .filter((project) => project.due_date)
      .map((project) => ({
        id: `project-${project.id}`,
        title: project.title,
        date: project.due_date as string,
        context: "Projeto",
        kind: "project" as const,
      })),
  ]
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
    .slice(0, 5);

  const activity = (
    (activityResult.data ?? []) as unknown as {
      id: string;
      verb: string;
      entity_type: string;
      created_at: string;
      actor: { full_name: string } | null;
    }[]
  ).map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    verb: item.verb,
    entityType: item.entity_type,
    actorName: item.actor?.full_name ?? null,
    createdAt: item.created_at,
  }));

  return {
    focusProject: focusProjectRow ? toProject(focusProjectRow) : null,
    focusCourse,
    todayTasks,
    overdueTasks,
    upcomingTasks,
    projects,
    deadlines,
    activity,
    stats: {
      openCount: tasks.length,
      overdueCount: overdueTasks.length,
      completedThisWeek: completedResult.count ?? 0,
      createdThisWeek: createdResult.count ?? 0,
    },
  };
}

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export type FileListItem = {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  mime: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  status: "pending" | "ready" | "quarantined" | "deleted";
  context: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

export type FileUsage = {
  usedBytes: number;
  limitBytes: number;
  count: number;
};

import { WORKSPACE_LIMIT_BYTES } from "@/modules/files/domain";

export const WORKSPACE_STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = WORKSPACE_LIMIT_BYTES;

export async function listFiles(
  workspaceId: string,
): Promise<{ files: FileListItem[]; usage: FileUsage }> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const rows: {
    id: string;
    file_name: string;
    mime: string;
    size_bytes: number;
    status: FileListItem["status"];
    entity_type: string | null;
    created_at: string;
  }[] = [];

  for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 1000) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("files_metadata")
      .select("id, file_name, mime, size_bytes, status, entity_type, created_at")
      .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
      .in("status", ["pending", "ready", "quarantined"])
      .is("deleted_at", null)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .range(offset, offset + 999);

    if (error) {
      return {
        files: [],
        usage: { usedBytes: 0, limitBytes: WORKSPACE_STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES, count: 0 },
      };
    }

    const batch = (data ?? []) as typeof rows;
    rows.push(...batch);
    if (batch.length < 1000) break;
  }

  return {
    files: rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      fileName: row.file_name,
      mime: row.mime,
      sizeBytes: row.size_bytes,
      status: row.status,
      context: row.entity_type,
      createdAt: row.created_at,
    })),
    usage: {
      usedBytes: rows
        .filter((row) => row.status !== "quarantined")
        .reduce((sum, row) => sum + Number(row.size_bytes), 0),
      limitBytes: WORKSPACE_STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES,
      count: rows.length,
    },
  };
}

export type ProjectFileItem = {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  mime: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  status: "pending" | "ready" | "quarantined";
  createdAt: string;
  authorName: string;
};

export async function listProjectFiles(input: {
  workspaceId: string;
  projectId: string;
}): Promise<ProjectFileItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("files_metadata")
    .select("id, file_name, mime, size_bytes, status, created_at, profiles!files_metadata_created_by_fkey(full_name)")
    .eq("workspace_id", input.workspaceId)
    .eq("entity_type", "project")
    .eq("entity_id", input.projectId)
    .in("status", ["pending", "ready", "quarantined"])
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);

  if (error) return [];
  const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as {
    id: string;
    file_name: string;
    mime: string;
    size_bytes: number;
    status: ProjectFileItem["status"];
    created_at: string;
    profiles: { full_name: string } | null;
  }[];
  return rows.map((row) => {
    const profile = row.profiles;
    return {
      id: row.id,
      fileName: row.file_name,
      mime: row.mime,
      sizeBytes: Number(row.size_bytes),
      status: row.status as ProjectFileItem["status"],
      createdAt: row.created_at,
      authorName: profile?.full_name || "Pessoa do espaço",
    };
  });
}

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { FocusScope } from "@/modules/focus/domain";

export type FocusState = {
  projectId: string | null;
  courseId: string | null;
  scopeKey: string;
};

export async function getFocusState({
  workspaceId,
  userId,
  focusScope,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  userId: string;
  focusScope: FocusScope;
}): Promise<FocusState> {
  const scopeKey = focusScope === "user" ? userId : "workspace";
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("focus_assignments")
    .select("kind, target_id, scope_key")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId);

  if (error) {
    return { projectId: null, courseId: null, scopeKey };
  }

  const rows = (data ?? []) as {
    kind: "project" | "course";
    target_id: string;
    scope_key: string;
  }[];

  return {
    projectId:
      rows.find(
        (row) => row.kind === "project" && row.scope_key === scopeKey,
      )?.target_id ?? null,
    courseId:
      rows.find((row) => row.kind === "course" && row.scope_key === scopeKey)
        ?.target_id ?? null,
    scopeKey,
  };
}

/** Convites ainda utilizáveis (RLS: só proprietário/admin enxergam). */
export async function listPendingInvitations(

): Promise<PendingInvitation[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("invitations")
    .select("id, role, email, expires_at, created_at")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .is("accepted_at", null)
    .is("revoked_at", null)
    .gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString())
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(30);

  if (error) return [];
  return (
    (data ?? []) as {
      id: string;
      role: WorkspaceRole;
      email: string | null;
      expires_at: string;
      created_at: string;
    }[]
  ).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    role: row.role,
    email: row.email,
    expiresAt: row.expires_at,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  }));
}

export type InvitationPreview = {
  workspaceName: string;
  role: WorkspaceRole;
  emailBound: boolean;
  emailMatches: boolean;
  state: "valid" | "used" | "revoked" | "expired";
  invitedByName: string | null;
};

export async function previewInvitation(
  tokenHash: string,
): Promise<InvitationPreview | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("preview_invitation", {
    p_token_hash: tokenHash,
  });

  const row = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data) as
    | {
        workspace_name: string;
        role: WorkspaceRole;
        email_bound: boolean;
        email_matches: boolean;
        state: InvitationPreview["state"];
        invited_by_name: string | null;
      }
    | undefined;

  if (error || !row) return null;
  return {
    workspaceName: row.workspace_name,
    role: row.role,
    emailBound: row.email_bound,
    emailMatches: row.email_matches,
    state: row.state,
    invitedByName: row.invited_by_name,
  };
}

import "server-only";

import { cache } from "react";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import {
  describeNotification,
  type NotificationView,
} from "@/modules/collab/domain";

export type NotificationItem = NotificationView & {
  id: string;
  read: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
};

export const countUnreadNotifications = cache(async (): Promise<number> => {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { count, error } = await supabase
    .from("notifications")
    .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .is("read_at", null);

  return error ? 0 : (count ?? 0);
});

export async function listNotifications(limit = 50): Promise<NotificationItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("notifications")
    .select("id, type, payload, read_at, created_at")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);

  if (error) return [];
  return (
    (data ?? []) as {
      id: string;
      type: string;
      payload: unknown;
      read_at: string | null;
      created_at: string;
    }[]
  ).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    read: row.read_at !== null,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    ...describeNotification(row.type, row.payload),
  }));
}

ARQUIVO: lib\data\portfolio-public.ts

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import {
  hashPortfolioToken,
  isValidPortfolioLink,
} from "@/modules/portfolio/domain";

export type PublicPortfolio = {
  title: string;
  objective: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  stage: string;
  summary: string | null;
  tasksTotal: number;
  tasksDone: number;
  publishedAt: string | null;
};

/** Devolve null para qualquer falha: link inválido, revogado, errado ou erro de banco. */
export async function getPublicPortfolio(
  slug: string,
  token: string,
): Promise<PublicPortfolio | null> {
  if (!isValidPortfolioLink(slug, token)) return null;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("get_public_portfolio", {
    p_slug: slug,
    p_token_hash: hashPortfolioToken(token),
  });
  if (error || !Array.isArray(data) || data.length !== 1) return null;

  const row = data[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    title: String(row.title),
    objective: (row.objective as string | null) ?? null,
    description: (row.description as string | null) ?? null,
    stage: String(row.stage),
    summary: (row.summary as string | null) ?? null,
    tasksTotal: Number(row.tasks_total ?? 0),
    tasksDone: Number(row.tasks_done ?? 0),
    publishedAt: (row.published_at as string | null) ?? null,
  };
}

import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { PalettePreference } from "@/lib/actions/preferences";

const DEFAULT_PALETTE: PalettePreference = "amber";
const VALID_PALETTES = new Set<PalettePreference>([
  "amber",
  "orange",
  "blue",
  "green",
  "purple",
  "red",
]);

export async function getUserPalette(userId?: string): Promise<PalettePreference> {
  const user = userId ? { id: userId } : await requireUser();
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("user_preferences")
    .select("palette")
    .eq("user_id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  const value = data?.palette as PalettePreference | undefined;
  return value && VALID_PALETTES.has(value) ? value : DEFAULT_PALETTE;
}

ARQUIVO: lib\data\progress.ts
==================================================
import type { Progress } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { calculateProgress } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";

export type ProgressRow = {
  project_id: string | null;
  weight: number;
  status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";
  parent_task_id: string | null;
};

/** Groups task rows by project and returns transparent weighted progress. */
export function progressByProject(
  rows: ProgressRow[],
): Map<string, Progress> {
  const grouped = new Map<string, ProgressRow[]>();

  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row.project_id) continue;
    const list = grouped.get(row.project_id) ?? [];
    list.push(row);
    grouped.set(row.project_id, list);
  }

  const result = new Map<string, Progress>();
  for (const [projectId, tasks] of grouped) {
    result.set(
      projectId,
      calculateProgress(
        tasks.map((task) => ({
          weight: task.weight,
          status: task.status,
          parentTaskId: task.parent_task_id,
        })),
      ),
    );
  }

  return result;
}

ARQUIVO: lib\data\projects.ts

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { progressByProject, type ProgressRow } from "@/lib/data/progress";
import { calculateProgress, classifyDueDate } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import type { DueDateState } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";
import { projectStagePosition } from "@/modules/projects/domain";

export type ProjectListItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  emoji: string;
  coverUrl: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  nextStep: string | null;
  stage: string;
  stagePosition: number;
  status: "active" | "paused" | "completed";
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  progress: ReturnType<typeof calculateProgress>;
};

type ProjectRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  emoji: string;
  cover_url: string | null;
  objective: string | null;
  next_step: string | null;
  stage: string;
  status: "active" | "paused" | "completed";
  due_date: string | null;
};

const PROJECT_SELECT =
  "id, title, emoji, cover_url, objective, next_step, stage, status, due_date";

function toProject(
  row: ProjectRow,
  progress: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof calculateProgress>>,
  today: string,
): ProjectListItem {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    emoji: row.emoji || "🚀",
    coverUrl: row.cover_url,
    objective: row.objective,
    nextStep: row.next_step,
    stage: row.stage,
    stagePosition: projectStagePosition(row.stage),
    status: row.status,
    dueDate: row.due_date,
    dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
    progress: progress.get(row.id) ?? calculateProgress([]),
  };
}

export async function listProjects({
  workspaceId,
  today,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  today: string;
}): Promise<ProjectListItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("projects")
    .select(PROJECT_SELECT)
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .is("archived_at", null)
    .order("status", { ascending: true })
    .order("updated_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);

  if (error) return [];

  const rows = (data ?? []) as ProjectRow[];
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const { data: progressRows } = await supabase
    .from("tasks")
    .select("project_id, weight, status, parent_task_id")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .in(
      "project_id",
      rows.map((row) => row.id),
    )
    .is("deleted_at", null);

  const progress = progressByProject((progressRows ?? []) as ProgressRow[]);
  return rows.map((row) => toProject(row, progress, today));
}

export type ProjectDetail = ProjectListItem & {
  ownerId: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  risks: string | null;
  startDate: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

export async function getProjectDetail({
  workspaceId,
  projectId,
  today,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  projectId: string;
  today: string;
}): Promise<ProjectDetail | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("projects")
    .select(
      "id, title, emoji, cover_url, objective, next_step, stage, status, due_date, description, risks, start_date, created_at, owner_id, created_by",
    )
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .eq("id", projectId)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .maybeSingle<ProjectRow & {
      description: string | null;
      risks: string | null;
      start_date: string | null;
      created_at: string;
      owner_id: string | null;
      created_by: string | null;
    }>();

  if (error || !data) return null;

  const { data: progressRows } = await supabase
    .from("tasks")
    .select("project_id, weight, status, parent_task_id")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .eq("project_id", projectId)
    .is("deleted_at", null);

  const progress = progressByProject((progressRows ?? []) as ProgressRow[]);

  return {
    ...toProject(data, progress, today),
    ownerId: data.owner_id ?? data.created_by,
    description: data.description,
    risks: data.risks,
    startDate: data.start_date,
    createdAt: data.created_at,
  };
}

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { normalizeSearchQuery } from "@/modules/tasks/kanban";

export type SearchHit = {
  entityType: "idea" | "project" | "task" | "course";
  id: string;
  title: string;
  snippet: string;
};

export async function searchWorkspace(
  workspaceId: string,
  rawQuery: string,
): Promise<SearchHit[]> {
  const query = normalizeSearchQuery(rawQuery);
  if (!query) return [];

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("search_workspace", {
    p_workspace: workspaceId,
    p_query: query,
    p_limit: 30,
  });

  if (error) return [];
  return (
    (data ?? []) as {
      entity_type: SearchHit["entityType"];
      id: string;
      title: string;
      snippet: string | null;
    }[]
  ).map((row) => ({
    entityType: row.entity_type,
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    snippet: row.snippet ?? "",
  }));
}

export type TrashedItem = {
  kind: "projects" | "tasks" | "ideas" | "courses" | "files";
  id: string;
  title: string;
  deletedAt: string;
};

const TRASH_TABLES = ["projects", "tasks", "ideas", "courses", "files"] as const;

export async function listTrash(workspaceId: string): Promise<TrashedItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const lists = await Promise.all(
    TRASH_TABLES.map(async (kind) => {
      const table = kind === "files" ? "files_metadata" : kind;
      const columns = kind === "files" ? "id, title:file_name, deleted_at" : "id, title, deleted_at";
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from(table)
        .select(columns)
        .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
        .not("deleted_at", "is", null)
        .order("deleted_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(50);
      return ((data ?? []) as unknown as { id: string; title: string; deleted_at: string }[]).map(
        (row): TrashedItem => ({
          kind,
          id: row.id,
          title: row.title,
          deletedAt: row.deleted_at,
        }),
      );
    }),
  );
  return lists
    .flat()
    .sort((a, b) => b.deletedAt.localeCompare(a.deletedAt))
    .slice(0, 80);
}

import "server-only";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { DueDateState } from "@/modules/tasks/domain";

export type TaskListItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  priority: string;
  status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";
  projectId: string | null;
  projectTitle: string | null;
  assigneeName: string | null;
  completedAt: string | null;

type TaskRow = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  due_date: string | null;
  priority: string;
  status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";
  project_id: string | null;
  completed_at: string | null;
  projects: { title: string } | null;
  assignee: { full_name: string } | null;
};

const TASK_SELECT =
  "id, title, description, due_date, priority, status, project_id, completed_at, projects(title), assignee:profiles!tasks_assignee_id_fkey(full_name)";

function toTask(row: TaskRow, today: string): TaskListItem {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    description: row.description,
    dueDate: row.due_date,
    dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
    priority: row.priority,
    status: row.status,
    projectId: row.project_id,
    projectTitle: row.projects?.title ?? null,
    assigneeName: row.assignee?.full_name ?? null,
    completedAt: row.completed_at,
  };
}

export async function listTasks({
  workspaceId,
  today,
  includeDone = false,
  projectId,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  today: string;
  includeDone?: boolean;
  projectId?: string;
}): Promise<TaskListItem[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let query = supabase
    .from("tasks")
    .select(TASK_SELECT)
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .is("deleted_at", null);

  if (projectId) query = query.eq("project_id", projectId);
  if (!includeDone) query = query.neq("status", "done");

  const { data, error } = await query
    .order("status", { ascending: true })
    .order("due_date", { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(200);

  if (error) return [];
  return ((data ?? []) as unknown as TaskRow[]).map((row) =>
    toTask(row, today),
  );
}

export async function getTaskById({
  workspaceId,
  taskId,
  today,
}: {

  taskId: string;
  today: string;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("tasks")
    .select(TASK_SELECT)
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .eq("id", taskId)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .maybeSingle<TaskRow>();

  if (error || !data) return null;
  return toTask(data, today);
}

export type KanbanTask = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";
  position: number;
  priority: string;
  dueDate: string | null;
  dueState: DueDateState;
  projectTitle: string | null;
  assigneeName: string | null;
};

/** Quadro: abertas + concluídas nos últimos 14 dias, já ordenadas por posição. */
export async function listKanbanTasks({
  workspaceId,
  today,
  projectId,
}: {
  workspaceId: string;
  today: string;
  projectId?: string;
}): Promise<KanbanTask[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const since = new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  let query = supabase
    .from("tasks")
    .select("id, title, status, position, priority, due_date, projects(title), assignee:profiles!tasks_assignee_id_fkey(full_name)")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .is("deleted_at", null)
    .is("archived_at", null)
    .or(`status.neq.done,completed_at.gte.${since}`);

  if (projectId) query = query.eq("project_id", projectId);

  const { data, error } = await query
    .order("position", { ascending: true })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
    .limit(300);

  if (error) return [];
  return (
    (data ?? []) as unknown as {
      id: string;
      title: string;
      status: KanbanTask["status"];
      position: number | string;
      priority: string;
      due_date: string | null;
      projects: { title: string } | null;
      assignee: { full_name: string } | null;
    }[]
  ).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    title: row.title,
    status: row.status,
    position: Number(row.position),
    priority: row.priority,
    dueDate: row.due_date,
    dueState: classifyDueDate(row.due_date, today),
    projectTitle: row.projects?.title ?? null,
    assigneeName: row.assignee?.full_name ?? null,
  }));
}

ARQUIVO: lib\data\workspaces.ts

import { cache } from "react";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

import type { WorkspaceRole } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";
import { getSupabaseConfig } from "@/lib/env";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export const WORKSPACE_COOKIE = "orbita_workspace";

export type WorkspaceSummary = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  kind: "personal" | "team" | "client";
  focus_scope: "workspace" | "user";
  role: WorkspaceRole;
  brandColor: string;
  coverUrl: string | null;
};


const DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_COLOR = "#d6a64b";

function readWorkspaceSettings(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
    : {};
}

function readWorkspaceColor(value: unknown): string {
  const color = readWorkspaceSettings(value).brand_color;
  return typeof color === "string" && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(color)
    ? color.toLowerCase()
    : DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_COLOR;
}

function readWorkspaceCover(value: unknown): string | null {
  const cover = readWorkspaceSettings(value).cover_url;
  if (typeof cover !== "string" || cover.length > 2048) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(cover);
    return url.protocol === "https:" && !url.username && !url.password ? cover : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

type MembershipRow = {
  role: WorkspaceRole;
  workspaces: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    slug: string;
    kind: WorkspaceSummary["kind"];
    focus_scope: WorkspaceSummary["focus_scope"];
    settings: unknown;
    created_at: string;
  };
};

/** Todos os espaços ativos da pessoa, do mais antigo para o mais novo. */
export const listMyWorkspaces = cache(
  async (userId: string): Promise<WorkspaceSummary[]> => {
    if (!getSupabaseConfig()) return [];

    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("workspace_members")
      .select(
        "role, workspaces!inner(id, name, slug, kind, focus_scope, settings, created_at, deleted_at)",
      )
      .eq("user_id", userId)
      .eq("status", "active")
      .is("workspaces.deleted_at", null)
      .limit(50);

    if (error || !data) return [];

    return (data as unknown as MembershipRow[])
      .sort((a, b) => a.workspaces.created_at.localeCompare(b.workspaces.created_at))
      .map((row) => ({
        id: row.workspaces.id,
        name: row.workspaces.name,
        slug: row.workspaces.slug,
        kind: row.workspaces.kind,
        focus_scope: row.workspaces.focus_scope,
        role: row.role,
        brandColor: readWorkspaceColor(row.workspaces.settings),
        coverUrl: readWorkspaceCover(row.workspaces.settings),
      }));
  },
);

/**
 * O espaço escolhido (cookie) se a pessoa ainda for membro ativo dele; senão o
 * mais antigo. O cookie é só uma preferência: a permissão vem sempre do banco.
 */
export async function getCurrentWorkspace(
  userId: string,
): Promise<WorkspaceSummary | null> {
  const workspaces = await listMyWorkspaces(userId);
  if (workspaces.length === 0) return null;

  const wanted = (await cookies()).get(WORKSPACE_COOKIE)?.value;
  return workspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === wanted) ?? workspaces[0];
}

ARQUIVO: lib\files\http.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export const BUCKET = "workspace-files";

export function json(body: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json(body, {
    status,
    headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
  });
}

/** Rotas POST só aceitam requisições feitas pelo próprio site (defesa contra CSRF). */
export function isSameOrigin(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return false;
  try {
    return new URL(origin).host === request.nextUrl.host;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Devolve o cliente Supabase da sessão, ou uma resposta 401/403 pronta. */
export async function authorize(request: NextRequest, { mutating }: { mutating: boolean }) {
  if (mutating && !isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return { error: json({ error: "origem_invalida" }, 403) } as const;
  }
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return { error: json({ error: "nao_autenticado" }, 401) } as const;
  return { user, supabase: await createClient() } as const;
}

"use client";

import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";

import { getSupabaseConfig } from "@/lib/env";

let client: ReturnType<typeof createBrowserClient> | null = null;

/**
 * Browser client for interactive widgets only. Feature code should call
 * server actions/repositories; direct table access stays behind RLS as a
 * second line of defence.
 */
export function createClient() {
  const config = getSupabaseConfig();

  if (!config) {
    throw new Error("Supabase não configurado no cliente.");
  }

  client ??= createBrowserClient(config.url, config.anonKey);
  return client;
}

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";

const PUBLIC_PREFIXES = [
  "/login",
  "/criar-conta",
  "/recuperar-senha",
  "/redefinir-senha",
  "/auth",
  "/convite",
  "/p",
  "/offline",
  "/manifest.webmanifest",
  "/privacidade",
  "/termos",
];

function isPublicPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  return PUBLIC_PREFIXES.some(
    (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`),
  );
}

/**
 * Refreshes the Supabase session cookie and enforces the auth gate.
 * Runs in the Next.js proxy (formerly middleware) on every app route.
 */
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  const config = getSupabaseConfig();

  // Setup mode: the UI explains what is missing. Guarding happens again in
  // the authenticated layout, so no private data is ever rendered.
  if (!config) {
    return NextResponse.next({ request });
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });

  const supabase = createServerClient(config.url, config.anonKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return request.cookies.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => {
          request.cookies.set(name, value);
        });
        response = NextResponse.next({ request });
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
        });
      },
    },
  });

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;
  const isAuthScreen = pathname === "/login" || pathname === "/criar-conta";

  if (!user && !isPublicPath(pathname)) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = "/login";
    url.search = "";
    if (pathname !== "/") {
      url.searchParams.set("proximo", `${pathname}${search}`);
    }
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  if (user && isAuthScreen) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = "/";
    url.search = "";
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  return response;
}

ARQUIVO: lib\supabase\server.ts

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

import { getSupabaseConfig } from "@/lib/env";

/**
 * Supabase client for Server Components, Server Actions and Route Handlers.
 * Always create a new instance per request; never cache it globally.
 */
export async function createClient() {
  const config = getSupabaseConfig();

  if (!config) {
    throw new Error(
      "Supabase não configurado. Defina NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.",
    );
  }

  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  return createServerClient(config.url, config.anonKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return cookieStore.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        try {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
            cookieStore.set(name, value, options);
          });
        } catch {
          // Server Components cannot write cookies. The proxy refreshes the
          // session, so this is safe to ignore here.
        }
      },
    },
  });
}

import { z } from "zod";

const email = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, "Informe seu e-mail.")
  .email("Digite um e-mail válido.")
  .max(254, "E-mail muito longo.")
  .toLowerCase();

const password = z
  .string()
  .min(8, "Use pelo menos 8 caracteres.")
  .max(72, "A senha pode ter no máximo 72 caracteres.");

export const loginSchema = z.object({
  email,
  password: z.string().min(1, "Informe sua senha."),
});

export const signUpSchema = z
  .object({
    fullName: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(2, "Informe seu nome.")
      .max(120, "Nome muito longo."),
    email,
    password,
    confirmPassword: z.string().min(1, "Confirme a senha."),
  })
  .refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
    path: ["confirmPassword"],
    message: "As senhas não são iguais.",
  });

export const recoverySchema = z.object({ email });

export const resetPasswordSchema = z
  .object({
    password,
    confirmPassword: z.string().min(1, "Confirme a senha."),
  })
  .refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
    path: ["confirmPassword"],
    message: "As senhas não são iguais.",
  });

export const profileSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(2, "Informe seu nome.")
    .max(120, "Nome muito longo."),
  timezone: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, "Informe o fuso horário.")
    .max(64, "Fuso horário inválido."),
});

export type LoginInput = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;
export type SignUpInput = z.infer<typeof signUpSchema>;
export type RecoveryInput = z.infer<typeof recoverySchema>;
export type ResetPasswordInput = z.infer<typeof resetPasswordSchema>;
export type ProfileInput = z.infer<typeof profileSchema>;

export type ActionState = {
  status: "idle" | "error" | "success";
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>;
};

export const initialActionState: ActionState = { status: "idle" };

export function toFieldErrors(
  error: z.ZodError,
): Record<string, string[]> | undefined {
  const flattened = z.flattenError(error);
  return Object.keys(flattened.fieldErrors).length > 0
    ? flattened.fieldErrors
    : undefined;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {

describe("token de convite", () => {
  it("32 bytes em base64url e hash SHA-256 de 64 hex", () => {
    const { token, hash } = generateInviteToken();
    expect(token).toHaveLength(43);
    expect(isValidInviteToken(token)).toBe(true);
    expect(hash).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(hash)).toBe(true);
    expect(hashInviteToken(token)).toBe(hash);
    expect(hash === token).toBe(false);
  });
  it("não repete e rejeita formatos inválidos", () => {
    const seen = new Set(Array.from({ length: 200 }, () => generateInviteToken().token));
    expect(seen.size).toBe(200);
    for (const bad of ["", "curto", "a".repeat(42), "a".repeat(44), "a".repeat(42) + "=", "a".repeat(42) + "/", "../../etc/passwd"]) {
      expect(isValidInviteToken(bad)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
  it("hash conhecido (SHA-256 de 'abc')", () => {
    expect(hashInviteToken("abc")).toBe("ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad");
  });
});

describe("papéis", () => {
  it("quem pode conceder o quê", () => {
    expect(grantableRoles("owner")).toEqual(["admin", "editor", "collaborator", "reader"]);
    expect(grantableRoles("admin")).toEqual(["editor", "collaborator", "reader"]);
    expect(grantableRoles("editor")).toEqual([]);
    expect(grantableRoles("reader")).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("gerenciar membros espelha o banco", () => {
    const base = { isSelf: false };
    expect(canManageMember({ ...base, actor: "owner", target: "admin" })).toBe(true);
    expect(canManageMember({ ...base, actor: "admin", target: "admin" })).toBe(false);
    expect(canManageMember({ ...base, actor: "admin", target: "editor" })).toBe(true);
    expect(canManageMember({ ...base, actor: "admin", target: "owner" })).toBe(false);
    expect(canManageMember({ ...base, actor: "editor", target: "reader" })).toBe(false);
    expect(canManageMember({ isSelf: true, actor: "owner", target: "editor" })).toBe(false);
  });
  it("convidar e sair", () => {
    expect(canInviteInto("team", "admin")).toBe(true);
    expect(canInviteInto("personal", "owner")).toBe(false);
    expect(canInviteInto("client", "editor")).toBe(false);
    expect(canLeaveWorkspace("editor", "team")).toBe(true);
    expect(canLeaveWorkspace("owner", "team")).toBe(false);
    expect(canLeaveWorkspace("editor", "personal")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("mensagens e notificações", () => {
  it("traduz erros do banco e cai num texto genérico", () => {
    expect(collabErrorMessage("invitation_expired")).toContain("expirou");
    expect(collabErrorMessage("invitation_used")).toContain("já foi usado");
    expect(collabErrorMessage("algo_estranho")).toBe("Não foi possível concluir. Tente novamente.");
    expect(collabErrorMessage(undefined)).toBe("Não foi possível concluir. Tente novamente.");
  });
  it("descreve cada tipo com o destino certo", () => {
    expect(describeNotification("comment", { title: "Copy", entity_type: "task", entity_id: "abc", excerpt: "Combinado" })).toEqual({
      text: "Novo comentário em “Copy”: Combinado",
      href: "/tarefas/abc",
    });
    expect(describeNotification("comment", { entity_type: "project", entity_id: "p1" }).href).toBe("/projetos/p1");
    expect(describeNotification("task_assigned", { title: "Revisar", task_id: "t1" })).toEqual({
      text: "Uma tarefa foi atribuída a você: “Revisar”",
      href: "/tarefas/t1",
    });
    expect(describeNotification("invitation_accepted", { by_name: "Ana", role: "editor" }).text).toBe("Ana aceitou seu convite como editor");
    expect(describeNotification("role_changed", { role: "admin" }).text).toBe("Seu papel no espaço agora é administrador");
    expect(describeNotification("removed_from_workspace", {}).href).toBeNull();
  });
  it("tolera payload estranho sem quebrar", () => {
    expect(describeNotification("comment", null).text).toBe("Novo comentário");
    expect(describeNotification("comment", "texto").href).toBeNull();
    expect(describeNotification("comment", { entity_type: "hack", entity_id: "x" }).href).toBeNull();
    expect(describeNotification("tipo_novo", {}).text).toBe("Nova atividade");
  });
  it("selo de não lidas", () => {
    expect(unreadBadge(0)).toBeNull();
    expect(unreadBadge(-3)).toBeNull();
    expect(unreadBadge(7)).toBe("7");
    expect(unreadBadge(250)).toBe("99+");
    expect(unreadBadge(Number.NaN)).toBeNull();
  });
  it("normaliza comentário", () => {
    expect(normalizeComment("  oi \r\n tudo bem  ")).toBe("oi \n tudo bem");
    expect(normalizeComment("   ")).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeComment("x".repeat(5001))).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeComment("x".repeat(5000))).toHaveLength(5000);
  });
});

import { ROLE_LABELS, isWorkspaceRole, type WorkspaceRole } from "@/modules/workspaces/domain";

export const INVITE_TTL_DAYS = 7;
export const MAX_PENDING_INVITATIONS = 20;

/** 32 bytes aleatórios em base64url = 43 caracteres. */
export const INVITE_TOKEN_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/;

export function isValidInviteToken(value: string): boolean {
  return INVITE_TOKEN_PATTERN.test(value);
}

const RANK: Record<WorkspaceRole, number> = {
  owner: 5,
  admin: 4,
  editor: 3,
  collaborator: 2,
  reader: 1,
};

/** Papéis que `actor` pode conceder em convites e mudanças (espelha o banco). */
export function grantableRoles(actor: WorkspaceRole): WorkspaceRole[] {
  if (actor === "owner") return ["admin", "editor", "collaborator", "reader"];
  if (actor === "admin") return ["editor", "collaborator", "reader"];
  return [];
}

/** Espelha as regras de change_member_role/remove_member do banco. */
export function canManageMember(input: {
  actor: WorkspaceRole;
  target: WorkspaceRole;
  isSelf: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (input.isSelf) return false;
  if (RANK[input.actor] < RANK.admin) return false;
  if (input.target === "owner") return false;
  if (input.target === "admin" && input.actor !== "owner") return false;
  return true;
}

export function canLeaveWorkspace(role: WorkspaceRole, kind: "personal" | "team" | "client") {
  return role !== "owner" && kind !== "personal";
}

export function canInviteInto(kind: "personal" | "team" | "client", role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return kind !== "personal" && RANK[role] >= RANK.admin;
}

const INVITE_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {

  personal_workspace: "Espaços pessoais não recebem convites. Crie um espaço de equipe.",
  too_many_invitations: "Há convites pendentes demais. Cancele alguns antes de criar outro.",
  only_owner_grants_admin: "Só o proprietário pode conceder ou alterar o papel de administrador.",
  only_owner_manages_admin: "Só o proprietário pode alterar ou remover administradores.",
  forbidden: "Você não tem permissão para fazer isso.",
  cannot_change_self: "Você não pode alterar o seu próprio papel.",
  use_leave_workspace: "Para sair do espaço, use “Sair do espaço”.",

  owner_not_assignable: "O papel de proprietário não pode ser atribuído.",
  member_not_found: "Essa pessoa não está mais no espaço.",
  assignee_not_member: "A pessoa escolhida não participa deste espaço.",
  assignee_cannot_work: "Leitores não podem receber tarefas. Mude o papel antes.",

export function collabErrorMessage(code: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (code && INVITE_ERROR_MESSAGES[code]) return INVITE_ERROR_MESSAGES[code];
  return "Não foi possível concluir. Tente novamente.";
}

/** Códigos de erro conhecidos (para decidir se a mensagem do banco é segura de mostrar). */
export function isKnownCollabError(code: string | undefined | null): boolean {
  return !!code && code in INVITE_ERROR_MESSAGES;
}

export type NotificationView = { text: string; href: string | null };

const ENTITY_HREF: Record<string, (id: string) => string> = {
  project: (id) => `/projetos/${id}`,
  task: (id) => `/tarefas/${id}`,
  idea: () => "/backlog",
  course: () => "/cursos",
  file: () => "/arquivos",
};

const str = (value: unknown): string | null =>
  typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value : null;

export function describeNotification(type: string, payload: unknown): NotificationView {
  const p = (payload && typeof payload === "object" ? payload : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

  switch (type) {
    case "comment": {
      const title = str(p.title);
      const entityType = str(p.entity_type);
      const entityId = str(p.entity_id);
      const excerpt = str(p.excerpt);
      return {
        text: `Novo comentário${title ? ` em “${title}”` : ""}${excerpt ? `: ${excerpt}` : ""}`,
        href: entityType && entityId && ENTITY_HREF[entityType] ? ENTITY_HREF[entityType](entityId) : null,
      };
    }
    case "task_assigned": {
      const title = str(p.title);
      const id = str(p.task_id);
      return {
        text: `Uma tarefa foi atribuída a você${title ? `: “${title}”` : ""}`,
        href: id ? `/tarefas/${id}` : null,
      };
    }
    case "invitation_accepted": {
      const who = str(p.by_name) ?? "Alguém";
      const role = isWorkspaceRole(p.role) ? ROLE_LABELS[p.role].toLowerCase() : null;
      return {
        text: `${who} aceitou seu convite${role ? ` como ${role}` : ""}`,
        href: "/espacos",
      };
    }
    case "role_changed": {
      const role = isWorkspaceRole(p.role) ? ROLE_LABELS[p.role].toLowerCase() : null;
      return { text: role ? `Seu papel no espaço agora é ${role}` : "Seu papel no espaço mudou", href: "/espacos" };
    }
    case "removed_from_workspace":
      return { text: "Você foi removido de um espaço", href: null };
    default:
      return { text: "Nova atividade", href: null };
  }
}

export function unreadBadge(count: number): string | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(count) || count <= 0) return null;
  return count > 99 ? "99+" : String(Math.floor(count));
}

export const MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH = 5000;

export function normalizeComment(raw: string): string | null {
  const text = raw.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  if (text.length < 1 || text.length > MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH) return null;
  return text;
}

import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

/** Gera um token de convite de 32 bytes. Só o hash vai para o banco. */
export function generateInviteToken(): { token: string; hash: string } {
  const token = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  return { token, hash: hashInviteToken(token) };
}

export function hashInviteToken(token: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(token, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS,
  formatBytes,
  isInlinePreviewable,
  looksLikeText,
  quotaState,
  sniffMime,
  validateUploadRequest,
  verifyUploadedObject,
} from "./domain";

const bytes = (...values: number[]) => new Uint8Array(values);
const PNG = bytes(0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0, 0);
const PDF = new TextEncoder().encode("%PDF-1.7\n");
const ZIP = bytes(0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04, 0, 0);
const EXE = bytes(0x4d, 0x5a, 0x90, 0x00);

describe("validateUploadRequest", () => {
  const ok = { name: "contrato.pdf", size: 20 * 1024 * 1024, mime: "application/pdf" };
  it("aceita 20 MB de PDF", () => expect(validateUploadRequest(ok).ok).toBe(true));
  it("recusa acima de 25 MB e vazio", () => {
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, size: 25 * 1024 * 1024 + 1 })).toMatchObject({ code: "too_large" });
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, size: 0 })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_size" });
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, size: 1.5 })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_size" });
  });
  it("aceita exatamente 25 MB", () => {
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, size: 25 * 1024 * 1024 }).ok).toBe(true);
  });
  it("recusa extensões bloqueadas mesmo com mime permitido", () => {
    for (const name of ["a.exe", "a.HTML", "a.svg", "a.sh", "a.js"]) {
      expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, name })).toMatchObject({ code: "blocked_type" });
    }
  });
  it("recusa tipo fora da lista e extensão que não combina", () => {
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, mime: "application/x-msdownload" })).toMatchObject({ code: "unsupported_type" });
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, name: "foto.png" })).toMatchObject({ code: "extension_mismatch" });
  });
  it("recusa nome inválido e limpa controles", () => {
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, name: "a/b.pdf" })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_name" });
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, name: "   " })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_name" });
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ ...ok, name: "rel\u0000  final.pdf" })).toMatchObject({ ok: true, name: "rel final.pdf" });
  });
  it("aceita OOXML e jpeg com extensões alternativas", () => {
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ name: "a.docx", size: 10, mime: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(validateUploadRequest({ name: "a.JPEG", size: 10, mime: "image/jpeg" }).ok).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("assinatura real do arquivo", () => {
  it("reconhece os formatos", () => {
    expect(sniffMime(PNG)).toBe("image/png");
    expect(sniffMime(bytes(0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0))).toBe("image/jpeg");
    expect(sniffMime(new TextEncoder().encode("GIF89a.."))).toBe("image/gif");
    expect(sniffMime(new TextEncoder().encode("RIFF\0\0\0\0WEBPVP8 "))).toBe("image/webp");
    expect(sniffMime(PDF)).toBe("application/pdf");
    expect(sniffMime(ZIP)).toBe("application/zip");
    expect(sniffMime(EXE)).toBeNull();
    expect(sniffMime(new Uint8Array())).toBeNull();
  });
  it("aprova quando tamanho e assinatura batem", () => {
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "image/png", declaredSize: 10, actualSize: 10, head: PNG })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", declaredSize: 5, actualSize: 5, head: ZIP })).toEqual({ ok: true });
  });
  it("manda para quarentena: executável disfarçado, tipo trocado e tamanho divergente", () => {
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "image/png", declaredSize: 4, actualSize: 4, head: EXE })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "application/pdf", declaredSize: 10, actualSize: 10, head: PNG })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "image/png", declaredSize: 10, actualSize: 11, head: PNG })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, reason: "tamanho divergente do declarado" });
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "application/zip", declaredSize: 4, actualSize: 4, head: PNG })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
  });
  it("texto: aceita UTF-8 e recusa binário", () => {
    const txt = new TextEncoder().encode("olá, mundo — ação");
    expect(looksLikeText(txt)).toBe(true);
    expect(looksLikeText(bytes(0x41, 0x00, 0x42))).toBe(false);
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "text/csv", declaredSize: txt.length, actualSize: txt.length, head: txt })).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "text/plain", declaredSize: 4, actualSize: 4, head: bytes(0, 1, 2, 3) })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
  });
  it("não aprova o que não está na lista de permissão", () => {
    expect(verifyUploadedObject({ declaredMime: "text/html", declaredSize: 1, actualSize: 1, head: bytes(60) })).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
  });
});

describe("download e cota", () => {
  it("só imagens e PDF têm preview inline", () => {
    expect(isInlinePreviewable("image/png")).toBe(true);
    expect(isInlinePreviewable("application/zip")).toBe(false);
  });
  it("estado da cota", () => {
    expect(quotaState(0)).toMatchObject({ percent: 0, level: "ok" });
    expect(quotaState(0.8 * 1024 ** 3)).toMatchObject({ level: "warning" });
    expect(quotaState(1024 ** 3)).toMatchObject({ level: "full", remainingBytes: 0, percent: 100 });
    expect(quotaState(2 * 1024 ** 3).percent).toBe(100);
    expect(quotaState(512 * 1024 ** 2).label).toBe("512 MB de 1 GB usados (50%)");
  });
  it("formata bytes em pt-BR", () => {
    expect(formatBytes(512)).toBe("512 B");
    expect(formatBytes(1536)).toBe("1,5 KB");
    expect(formatBytes(25 * 1024 * 1024)).toBe("25 MB");
  });
});

describe("sincronia com o banco", () => {
  it("a lista de extensões bloqueadas é a mesma da migração", () => {
    const sql = readFileSync("supabase/migrations/20261115000300_files.sql", "utf8");
    const block = /array\[([^\]]+)\]/.exec(sql)?.[1] ?? "";
    const fromSql = [...block.matchAll(/'([a-z0-9]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]).sort();
    expect(fromSql).toEqual([...BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS].sort());
  });
});

ARQUIVO: modules\files\domain.ts

export const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
export const WORKSPACE_LIMIT_BYTES = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
export const SIGNED_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS = 600;
export const SIGNED_READ_TTL_SECONDS = 300;

type FileKind = "image" | "pdf" | "document" | "archive" | "text";

type TypeRule = { kind: FileKind; extensions: string[]; inline: boolean };

const DOCX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document";
const XLSX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet";
const PPTX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation";

/** Lista de permissão. Tudo que não está aqui é recusado. */
export const ALLOWED_TYPES: Record<string, TypeRule> = {
  "image/png": { kind: "image", extensions: ["png"], inline: true },
  "image/jpeg": { kind: "image", extensions: ["jpg", "jpeg"], inline: true },
  "image/gif": { kind: "image", extensions: ["gif"], inline: true },
  "image/webp": { kind: "image", extensions: ["webp"], inline: true },
  "application/pdf": { kind: "pdf", extensions: ["pdf"], inline: true },
  "application/zip": { kind: "archive", extensions: ["zip"], inline: false },
  [DOCX]: { kind: "document", extensions: ["docx"], inline: false },
  [XLSX]: { kind: "document", extensions: ["xlsx"], inline: false },
  [PPTX]: { kind: "document", extensions: ["pptx"], inline: false },
  "text/plain": { kind: "text", extensions: ["txt"], inline: false },
  "text/csv": { kind: "text", extensions: ["csv"], inline: false },
  "text/markdown": { kind: "text", extensions: ["md"], inline: false },
};

/** Espelha a lista da migração 0003 (um teste garante que não divergem). */
export const BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS = [
  "exe", "bat", "cmd", "com", "scr", "msi", "dll", "js", "mjs", "cjs", "vbs",
  "ps1", "sh", "jar", "apk", "html", "htm", "xhtml", "svg", "php", "py", "rb",
  "pl", "swf",
] as const;

const OOXML = new Set([DOCX, XLSX, PPTX]);

export type UploadErrorCode =
  | "invalid_name"
  | "invalid_size"
  | "too_large"
  | "blocked_type"
  | "unsupported_type"
  | "extension_mismatch";

export const UPLOAD_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<UploadErrorCode, string> = {
  invalid_name: "O nome do arquivo é inválido.",
  invalid_size: "O arquivo está vazio.",
  too_large: "O arquivo passa de 25 MB.",
  blocked_type: "Este tipo de arquivo não é permitido por segurança.",
  unsupported_type: "Este tipo de arquivo não é aceito ainda.",
  extension_mismatch: "A extensão não combina com o tipo do arquivo.",
};

export type ValidationResult =
  | { ok: true; name: string; mime: string; extension: string }
  | { ok: false; code: UploadErrorCode; message: string };

const fail = (code: UploadErrorCode): ValidationResult => ({
  ok: false,
  code,
  message: UPLOAD_ERROR_MESSAGES[code],
});

export function sanitizeDisplayName(raw: string): string {
  return raw
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

export function fileExtension(name: string): string {
  const match = /\.([^.]+)$/.exec(name);
  return match ? match[1].toLowerCase() : "";
}

export function validateUploadRequest(input: {
  name: string;
  size: number;
  mime: string;
}): ValidationResult {
  const name = sanitizeDisplayName(input.name);
  if (name.length < 1 || name.length > 255 || /[/\\]/.test(name)) {
    return fail("invalid_name");
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.size) || input.size <= 0) return fail("invalid_size");
  if (input.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) return fail("too_large");

  const extension = fileExtension(name);
  if ((BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS as readonly string[]).includes(extension)) {
    return fail("blocked_type");
  }

  const mime = input.mime.trim().toLowerCase();
  const rule = ALLOWED_TYPES[mime];
  if (!rule) return fail("unsupported_type");
  if (!rule.extensions.includes(extension)) return fail("extension_mismatch");

  return { ok: true, name, mime, extension };
}

const startsWith = (bytes: Uint8Array, signature: number[], offset = 0) =>
  signature.every((value, index) => bytes[offset + index] === value);

/** Detecta o tipo pelos primeiros bytes. Retorna null quando não reconhece. */
export function sniffMime(bytes: Uint8Array): string | null {
  if (startsWith(bytes, [0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a])) return "image/png";
  if (startsWith(bytes, [0xff, 0xd8, 0xff])) return "image/jpeg";
  if (startsWith(bytes, [0x47, 0x49, 0x46, 0x38, 0x37, 0x61]) || startsWith(bytes, [0x47, 0x49, 0x46, 0x38, 0x39, 0x61])) return "image/gif";
  if (startsWith(bytes, [0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46]) && startsWith(bytes, [0x57, 0x45, 0x42, 0x50], 8)) return "image/webp";
  if (startsWith(bytes, [0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46, 0x2d])) return "application/pdf";
  if (
    startsWith(bytes, [0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04]) ||
    startsWith(bytes, [0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06]) ||
    startsWith(bytes, [0x50, 0x4b, 0x07, 0x08])
  ) {
    return "application/zip";
  }
  return null;
}

/** Texto simples: sem byte nulo e sem sequência UTF-8 inválida na amostra. */
export function looksLikeText(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
  if (bytes.includes(0)) return false;
  try {
    new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
    return true;
  } catch {
    // A amostra pode cortar um caractere multibyte ao meio no fim.
    try {
      new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes.subarray(0, Math.max(bytes.length - 3, 0)));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

export type VerifyResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: string };

/** Decisão do servidor ao concluir o upload (HEAD + primeiros bytes). */
export function verifyUploadedObject(input: {
  declaredMime: string;
  declaredSize: number;
  actualSize: number;
  head: Uint8Array;
}): VerifyResult {
  if (input.actualSize !== input.declaredSize) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "tamanho divergente do declarado" };
  }
  const rule = ALLOWED_TYPES[input.declaredMime];
  if (!rule) return { ok: false, reason: "tipo não permitido" };

  if (rule.kind === "text") {
    return looksLikeText(input.head)
      ? { ok: true }
      : { ok: false, reason: "conteúdo binário em arquivo de texto" };
  }

  const sniffed = sniffMime(input.head);
  const expected = OOXML.has(input.declaredMime) ? "application/zip" : input.declaredMime;
  return sniffed === expected
    ? { ok: true }
    : { ok: false, reason: "assinatura do arquivo diverge do tipo declarado" };
}

export function isInlinePreviewable(mime: string): boolean {
  return ALLOWED_TYPES[mime]?.inline === true;
}

export type QuotaState = {
  percent: number;
  remainingBytes: number;
  level: "ok" | "warning" | "full";
  label: string;
};

export function quotaState(usedBytes: number, limitBytes = WORKSPACE_LIMIT_BYTES): QuotaState {
  const used = Math.max(usedBytes, 0);
  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((used / limitBytes) * 100));
  const remainingBytes = Math.max(limitBytes - used, 0);
  const level = used >= limitBytes ? "full" : percent >= 80 ? "warning" : "ok";
  return {
    percent,
    remainingBytes,
    level,
    label: `${formatBytes(used)} de ${formatBytes(limitBytes)} usados (${percent}%)`,
  };
}

export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB"];
  let value = bytes / 1024;
  let unit = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    unit += 1;
  }
  const rounded = value >= 10 || Number.isInteger(value) ? Math.round(value) : Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
  return `${String(rounded).replace(".", ",")} ${units[unit]}`;
}

export const FOCUS_KINDS = ["project", "course"] as const;

export type FocusKind = (typeof FOCUS_KINDS)[number];
export type FocusScope = "workspace" | "user";

export const FOCUS_KIND_LABELS: Record<FocusKind, string> = {
  project: "projeto",
  course: "curso",
};

/**
 * The scope key is what makes the unique constraint work for both workspace
 * and per-user focus without a boolean flag.
 */
export function resolveFocusScopeKey(
  scope: FocusScope,
  userId: string,
): string {
  return scope === "user" ? userId : "workspace";
}

export function assertFocusKind(value: string): FocusKind {
  if (!(FOCUS_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(value)) {
    throw new Error(`Tipo de foco inválido: ${value}`);
  }
  return value as FocusKind;
}

export function focusChangePrompt(
  kind: FocusKind,
  currentTitle: string | null,
  nextTitle: string,
): string {
  const noun = FOCUS_KIND_LABELS[kind];

  if (!currentTitle) {
    return `Definir “${nextTitle}” como ${noun} principal? Você poderá trocar depois.`;
  }

  return `Trocar o ${noun} principal de “${currentTitle}” para “${nextTitle}”? Nada será arquivado ou apagado.`;
}

    expect(token).toHaveLength(43);
    expect(hash).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(hashPortfolioToken(token)).toBe(hash);
  });

  it("tokens não se repetem", () => {
    expect(generatePortfolioToken().token === generatePortfolioToken().token).toBe(false);
  });

  it("valida o formato do link e rejeita lixo", () => {
    const { token } = generatePortfolioToken();
    expect(isValidPortfolioLink("abcdef012345abcdef012345", token)).toBe(true);
    expect(isValidPortfolioLink("curto", token)).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPortfolioLink("abcdef012345abcdef012345", "x".repeat(42))).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPortfolioLink("ABC/../etc/passwd", token)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("monta o caminho com o token no path", () => {
    expect(portfolioPath("slug", "tok")).toBe("/p/slug/tok");
  });

  it("não vaza detalhes de erro desconhecido", () => {

      "Não foi possível concluir. Tente de novo.",
    );
  });

  it("progresso público", () => {
    expect(publicProgress(0, 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(publicProgress(1, 3)).toBe(33);
    expect(publicProgress(5, 4)).toBe(100);
  });
});

ARQUIVO: modules\portfolio\domain.ts

import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

/** 32 bytes em base64url = 43 caracteres, igual ao convite. */
export const PORTFOLIO_TOKEN_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/;
/** 24 hex gerados pelo banco; aceitamos o mesmo intervalo da constraint. */
export const PORTFOLIO_SLUG_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9-]{12,80}$/;
export const MAX_PORTFOLIO_SUMMARY = 600;

export function generatePortfolioToken(): { token: string; hash: string } {
  const token = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  return { token, hash: hashPortfolioToken(token) };
}

export function hashPortfolioToken(token: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(token, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

/** O token vai no caminho (não na query) e a página envia Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. */
export function portfolioPath(slug: string, token: string): string {
  return `/p/${slug}/${token}`;
}

export function isValidPortfolioLink(slug: string, token: string): boolean {
  return PORTFOLIO_SLUG_PATTERN.test(slug) && PORTFOLIO_TOKEN_PATTERN.test(token);
}

const ERRORS: Record<string, string> = {
  forbidden: "Você não tem permissão para publicar neste espaço.",
  already_published: "Este projeto já tem um link ativo. Revogue-o ou troque o token.",
  summary_too_long: `O resumo pode ter no máximo ${MAX_PORTFOLIO_SUMMARY} caracteres.`,
  invalid_token_hash: "Não foi possível gerar o link. Tente de novo.",
};

export function portfolioErrorMessage(code: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (code && ERRORS[code]) || "Não foi possível concluir. Tente de novo.";
}

/** Percentual para exibir publicamente; sem tarefas, não inventa progresso. */
export function publicProgress(done: number, total: number): number | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(total) || total <= 0) return null;
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((done / total) * 100)));
}

      expect(TIMEZONE_LABELS[zone]).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });

  it("reconhece apenas fusos suportados", () => {
    expect(isProfileTimezone("America/Sao_Paulo")).toBe(true);
    expect(isProfileTimezone("UTC")).toBe(true);
    expect(isProfileTimezone("America/Atlantida")).toBe(false);
    expect(isProfileTimezone("")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("profileSchema", () => {
  it("aceita nome com espaços nas pontas e fuso válido", () => {
    const parsed = profileSchema.safeParse({
      fullName: "  Ana Clara  ",
      timezone: "America/Recife",
    });

    expect(parsed.success).toBe(true);
    if (parsed.success) {
      expect(parsed.data.fullName).toBe("Ana Clara");
      expect(parsed.data.timezone).toBe("America/Recife");
    }
  });

  it("explica o que corrigir em nome vazio", () => {
    const parsed = profileSchema.safeParse({
      fullName: "   ",
      timezone: "UTC",
    });

    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      expect(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message).toMatch(/como você quer ser chamado/i);
    }
  });

  it("recusa nome longo e fuso desconhecido", () => {
    const longName = profileSchema.safeParse({
      fullName: "a".repeat(121),
      timezone: "UTC",
    });
    const badZone = profileSchema.safeParse({
      fullName: "Ana",
      timezone: "Marte/Olympus",
    });

    expect(longName.success).toBe(false);
    expect(badZone.success).toBe(false);
    if (!badZone.success) {
      expect(badZone.error.issues[0]?.message).toMatch(/fuso válido/i);
    }
  });
});

describe("classifyDueDate", () => {
  it("classifica atrasada, hoje, próxima e sem prazo", () => {
    expect(classifyDueDate("2026-11-13", "2026-11-14")).toBe("overdue");
    expect(classifyDueDate("2026-11-14", "2026-11-14")).toBe("today");
    expect(classifyDueDate("2026-11-15", "2026-11-14")).toBe("upcoming");
    expect(classifyDueDate(null, "2026-11-14")).toBe("none");
  });

  it("compara datas de calendário mesmo perto da virada de ano", () => {
    expect(classifyDueDate("2027-01-01", "2026-12-31")).toBe("upcoming");
    expect(classifyDueDate("2026-12-31", "2027-01-01")).toBe("overdue");
  });

  it("expõe um rótulo por extenso, nunca só cor", () => {
    expect(dueDateLabel("2026-11-13", "2026-11-14")).toBe("Atrasada");
    expect(dueDateLabel("2026-11-14", "2026-11-14")).toBe("Vence hoje");
    expect(dueDateLabel(null, "2026-11-14")).toBe("Sem prazo");
  });
});

describe("calculateProgress", () => {
  it("calcula progresso ponderado das tarefas de primeiro nível", () => {
    const progress = calculateProgress([
      { weight: 1, status: "done" },
      { weight: 1, status: "todo" },
      { weight: 1, status: "in_progress" },
    ]);

    expect(progress.percent).toBe(33);
    expect(progress.completedWeight).toBe(1);
    expect(progress.totalWeight).toBe(3);
    expect(progress.label).toBe("1 de 3 tarefas (33%)");
  });

  it("respeita pesos maiores e nunca usa peso zero", () => {
    const progress = calculateProgress([
      { weight: 2, status: "done" },
      { weight: 0, status: "todo" },
    ]);

    expect(progress.totalWeight).toBe(3);
    expect(progress.percent).toBe(67);
  });

  it("ignora subtarefas e tarefas arquivadas", () => {
    const progress = calculateProgress([
      { weight: 1, status: "done", parentTaskId: "parent" },
      { weight: 1, status: "archived" },
      { weight: 1, status: "todo" },
    ]);

    expect(progress.totalWeight).toBe(1);
    expect(progress.percent).toBe(0);
  });

  it("explica quando ainda não há tarefas", () => {
    const progress = calculateProgress([]);
    expect(progress.percent).toBe(0);
    expect(progress.label).toBe("Sem tarefas ainda");
  });
});

export type DueDateState = "overdue" | "today" | "upcoming" | "none";

export const DUE_DATE_LABELS: Record<DueDateState, string> = {
  overdue: "Atrasada",
  today: "Vence hoje",
  upcoming: "Próxima",
  none: "Sem prazo",
};

function toUtcDay(date: string): number {
  const [year, month, day] = date.split("-").map(Number);
  return Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
}

/**
 * Due dates are calendar dates (not instants) to avoid the "was it due at 9pm
 * yesterday?" problem across time zones. `today` must already be the user's
 * local calendar date in ISO form.
 */
export function classifyDueDate(
  dueDate: string | null,
  today: string,
): DueDateState {
  if (!dueDate) return "none";

  const due = toUtcDay(dueDate);
  const reference = toUtcDay(today);

  if (due < reference) return "overdue";
  if (due === reference) return "today";
  return "upcoming";
}

export function dueDateLabel(dueDate: string | null, today: string): string {
  return DUE_DATE_LABELS[classifyDueDate(dueDate, today)];
}

export type ProgressTask = {
  weight: number;
  status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done" | "archived";
  parentTaskId?: string | null;
};

export type Progress = {
  completedWeight: number;
  totalWeight: number;
  percent: number;
  label: string;
};

/**
 * Transparent progress: weighted leaves only, archived tasks excluded, never a
 * colour-only signal. The UI always renders `label`.
 */
export function calculateProgress(tasks: ProgressTask[]): Progress {
  const active = tasks.filter(
    (task) => task.status !== "archived" && !task.parentTaskId,
  );
  const totalWeight = active.reduce(
    (sum, task) => sum + Math.max(task.weight, 1),
    0,
  );
  const completedWeight = active
    .filter((task) => task.status === "done")
    .reduce((sum, task) => sum + Math.max(task.weight, 1), 0);

  const percent =
    totalWeight === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((completedWeight / totalWeight) * 100);

  return {
    completedWeight,
    totalWeight,
    percent,
    label:
      totalWeight === 0
        ? "Sem tarefas ainda"
        : `${completedWeight} de ${totalWeight} tarefas (${percent}%)`,
  };
}
