import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  adjacentStatus,
  describeActivity,
  normalizeSearchQuery,
  positionBetween,
  positionForIndex,
  rebalancePositions,
  undoRemainingMs,
} from "./kanban";

describe("kanban positions", () => {
  it("coluna vazia começa em 1024", () => {
    expect(positionBetween(null, null)).toEqual({ position: 1024, rebalance: false });
  });
  it("insere no topo, no fim e no meio", () => {
    expect(positionBetween(null, 1024).position).toBe(0);
    expect(positionBetween(1024, null).position).toBe(2048);
    expect(positionBetween(1024, 2048).position).toBe(1536);
  });
  it("posiciona por índice", () => {
    const col = [1024, 2048, 3072];
    expect(positionForIndex(col, 0).position).toBe(0);
    expect(positionForIndex(col, 1).position).toBe(1536);
    expect(positionForIndex(col, 3).position).toBe(4096);
    expect(positionForIndex(col, 99).position).toBe(4096);
    expect(positionForIndex(col, -5).position).toBe(0);
  });
  it("sinaliza rebalanceamento quando o espaço acaba", () => {
    expect(positionBetween(1, 1 + 1e-9).rebalance).toBe(true);
    expect(positionBetween(1, 1).rebalance).toBe(true);
  });
  it("rebalanceia em múltiplos de 1024", () => {
    expect(rebalancePositions(3)).toEqual([1024, 2048, 3072]);
  });
  it("aguenta 40 inserções sucessivas no mesmo vão sem inverter a ordem", () => {
    let prev = 1024;
    const next = 2048;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const r = positionBetween(prev, next);
      if (r.rebalance) break;
      expect(r.position).toBeGreaterThan(prev);
      expect(r.position).toBeLessThan(next);
      prev = r.position;
    }
  });
});

describe("kanban por teclado", () => {
  it("move entre colunas e respeita as bordas", () => {
    expect(adjacentStatus("todo", "right")).toBe("in_progress");
    expect(adjacentStatus("in_progress", "right")).toBe("done");
    expect(adjacentStatus("done", "right")).toBeNull();
    expect(adjacentStatus("todo", "left")).toBeNull();
    expect(adjacentStatus("done", "left")).toBe("in_progress");
  });
});

describe("desfazer em 5 s", () => {
  it("conta o tempo restante", () => {
    expect(undoRemainingMs(0, 0)).toBe(5000);
    expect(undoRemainingMs(0, 3000)).toBe(2000);
    expect(undoRemainingMs(0, 9000)).toBe(0);
  });
});

  it("normaliza a consulta", () => {
    expect(normalizeSearchQuery("  casa   nova ")).toBe("casa nova");
    expect(normalizeSearchQuery("a")).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSearchQuery("   ")).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeSearchQuery("x".repeat(200))).toHaveLength(80);
  });
  it("descreve eventos", () => {
    expect(describeActivity("completed", "Escrever copy")).toBe("Você concluiu “Escrever copy”");
    expect(describeActivity("desconhecido")).toBe("Você atualizou um item");
    expect(describeActivity("created", "X", "Alguém")).toBe("Alguém criou “X”");
  });
});

export type KanbanStatus = "todo" | "in_progress" | "done";

export const KANBAN_COLUMNS: { status: KanbanStatus; label: string }[] = [
  { status: "todo", label: "A fazer" },
  { status: "in_progress", label: "Em andamento" },
  { status: "done", label: "Concluída" },
];

const GAP = 1024;
const MIN_GAP = 1e-6;

export type PositionResult = { position: number; rebalance: boolean };

/**
 * Posição fracionária entre dois vizinhos. `rebalance` indica que o espaço
 * numérico acabou e a coluna precisa ser renumerada (múltiplos de GAP).
 */
export function positionBetween(
  prev: number | null,
  next: number | null,
): PositionResult {
  if (prev === null && next === null) return { position: GAP, rebalance: false };
  if (prev === null) return { position: (next as number) - GAP, rebalance: false };
  if (next === null) return { position: prev + GAP, rebalance: false };
  const position = (prev + next) / 2;
  return {
    position,
    rebalance: next - prev < MIN_GAP || position <= prev || position >= next,
  };
}

/** Posição para inserir no índice `index` de uma coluna já ordenada (sem o item movido). */
export function positionForIndex(positions: number[], index: number): PositionResult {
  const i = Math.min(Math.max(index, 0), positions.length);
  return positionBetween(positions[i - 1] ?? null, positions[i] ?? null);
}

export function rebalancePositions(count: number): number[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => (i + 1) * GAP);
}

/** Movimento por teclado (alternativa acessível ao arrastar). */
export function adjacentStatus(
  status: KanbanStatus,
  direction: "left" | "right",
): KanbanStatus | null {
  const order = KANBAN_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.status);
  const next = order.indexOf(status) + (direction === "right" ? 1 : -1);
  return order[next] ?? null;
}

export const UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 5000;

export function undoRemainingMs(shownAt: number, now: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, UNDO_WINDOW_MS - (now - shownAt));
}

/** Normaliza a consulta como a função SQL `search_workspace` espera. */
export const MIN_SEARCH_LENGTH = 2;

export function normalizeSearchQuery(raw: string): string | null {
  const q = raw.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 80);
  return q.length >= MIN_SEARCH_LENGTH ? q : null;
}

const ACTIVITY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  created: "criou",
  completed: "concluiu",
  reopened: "reabriu",
  trashed: "enviou para a lixeira",
  restored: "restaurou",
  archived: "arquivou",
  unarchived: "desarquivou",
  converted: "converteu em projeto",
  status_changed: "mudou o status de",
  stage_changed: "mudou a etapa de",
  state_changed: "mudou o estado de",
  focus_changed: "mudou o foco para",
};

export function describeActivity(
  verb: string,
  title?: string | null,
  actor = "Você",
): string {
  const label = ACTIVITY_LABELS[verb] ?? "atualizou";
  return title ? `${actor} ${label} “${title}”` : `${actor} ${label} um item`;
}

export const WORKSPACE_ROLES = [
  "owner",
  "admin",
  "editor",
  "collaborator",
  "reader",
] as const;

export type WorkspaceRole = (typeof WORKSPACE_ROLES)[number];

export const ROLE_LABELS: Record<WorkspaceRole, string> = {
  owner: "Proprietário",
  admin: "Administrador",
  editor: "Editor",
  collaborator: "Colaborador",
  reader: "Leitor",
};

export const ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<WorkspaceRole, string> = {
  owner: "Controla tudo, inclusive excluir o espaço.",
  admin: "Gerencia pessoas, convites e configurações.",
  editor: "Cria e edita projetos, tarefas, cursos e arquivos.",
  collaborator: "Move e conclui as próprias tarefas e comenta.",
  reader: "Acompanha o conteúdo, sem editar.",
};

const ROLE_RANK: Record<WorkspaceRole, number> = {
  owner: 5,
  admin: 4,
  editor: 3,
  collaborator: 2,
  reader: 1,
};

export function hasRole(actual: WorkspaceRole, minimum: WorkspaceRole) {
  return ROLE_RANK[actual] >= ROLE_RANK[minimum];
}

export function canManageWorkspace(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "admin");
}

export function canManageMembers(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "admin");
}

export function canEditContent(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "editor");
}

export function canMoveOwnTasks(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "collaborator");
}

export function canComment(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "collaborator");
}

export function canPublishPortfolio(role: WorkspaceRole) {
  return hasRole(role, "editor");
}

export function isWorkspaceRole(value: unknown): value is WorkspaceRole {
  return (
    typeof value === "string" &&
    (WORKSPACE_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(value)
  );
}

/*
 * ÓRBITA — service worker de fundação.
 *
 * Regra de ouro: dados do espaço nunca vão para o cache. Só estáticos
 * (ícones, manifest) e a página /offline são guardados. Navegações são sempre
 * network-first, com fallback para /offline quando não há conexão.
 */
const VERSION = "orbita-v1";
const STATIC_CACHE = `${VERSION}-static`;
const OFFLINE_URL = "/offline";

const PRECACHE = [
  OFFLINE_URL,
  "/icons/icon-192.png",
  "/icons/icon-512.png",
  "/icons/icon-maskable-512.png",
  "/icons/apple-icon.png",
];

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches
      .open(STATIC_CACHE)
      .then((cache) => cache.addAll(PRECACHE))
      .then(() => self.skipWaiting())
      .catch(() => self.skipWaiting()),
  );
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches
      .keys()
      .then((keys) =>
        Promise.all(
          keys
            .filter((key) => key !== STATIC_CACHE)
            .map((key) => caches.delete(key)),
        ),
      )
      .then(() => self.clients.claim()),
  );
});

self.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.data === "SKIP_WAITING") {
    self.skipWaiting();
  }
});

function isStaticAsset(url) {
  return (
    url.pathname.startsWith("/_next/static/") ||
    url.pathname.startsWith("/icons/") ||
    url.pathname === "/manifest.webmanifest" ||
    url.pathname === "/favicon.ico"
  );
}

self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const { request } = event;

  if (request.method !== "GET") return;

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;

  if (request.mode === "navigate") {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request).catch(async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(STATIC_CACHE);
        const offline = await cache.match(OFFLINE_URL);
        return (
          offline ??
          new Response("Sem conexão.", {
            status: 503,
            headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" },
          })
        );
      }),
    );
    return;
  }

  if (isStaticAsset(url)) {
    event.respondWith(
      caches.match(request).then((cached) => {
        if (cached) return cached;
        return fetch(request).then((response) => {
          if (response.ok && response.type === "basic") {
            const copy = response.clone();
            caches.open(STATIC_CACHE).then((cache) => cache.put(request, copy));
          }
          return response;
        });
      }),
    );
  }
});

ARQUIVO: scripts\db-local.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Valida migrações + suítes SQL em um Postgres local descartável (sem Supabase).
# Uso: scripts/db-local.sh   (requer postgresql-16 instalado; roda como usuário não-root)
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
PGBIN=${PGBIN:-$(ls -d /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin | sort -V | tail -1)}
DIR=$(mktemp -d); PORT=${PGPORT:-54329}
if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then id pgtest >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m pgtest; chown pgtest "$DIR"; RUN="su pgtest -c"; else RUN="bash -c"; fi
$RUN "$PGBIN/initdb -D $DIR/data -A trust >/dev/null"
$RUN "$PGBIN/pg_ctl -D $DIR/data -o '-p $PORT -k $DIR' -l $DIR/log -w start >/dev/null"
trap '$RUN "$PGBIN/pg_ctl -D $DIR/data -m immediate stop >/dev/null" || true; rm -rf "$DIR"' EXIT
export PGHOST=$DIR PGPORT=$PORT PGUSER=${PGUSER_OVERRIDE:-pgtest}; [ "$(id -u)" != 0 ] && PGUSER=$(whoami)
$RUN "$PGBIN/createdb -h $DIR -p $PORT orbita_test"
export PGDATABASE=orbita_test
P="$PGBIN/psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q"
$RUN "$P -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -f supabase/tests/00_supabase_shim.sql"
for f in supabase/migrations/*.sql; do echo ">> $f"; $RUN "$P -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -f $f"; done
FAIL=0
for f in supabase/tests/*.sql; do
  case $f in *00_supabase_shim*) continue;; esac
  echo ">> $f"
  if OUT=$($RUN "$P -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -f $PWD/$f" 2>&1); then RC=0; else RC=1; fi
  echo "$OUT" | grep -E "PASS|ERROR|FAIL" || true
  [ "$RC" = 0 ] || { echo "FALHOU: $f"; FAIL=1; }
done
# Concorrência: 16 pessoas aceitando o mesmo convite ao mesmo tempo.
if [ -x "$PGBIN/pgbench" ]; then
  echo ">> concorrência de convites (pgbench)"
  TOK=$(printf 'a%.0s' $(seq 1 64))
  $RUN "$P -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -f $PWD/supabase/tests/concurrency/invite_setup.sql" || FAIL=1
  $RUN "$PGBIN/pgbench -n -h $DIR -p $PORT -f $PWD/supabase/tests/concurrency/invite_accept.pgbench -c 16 -j 4 -t 1 -D tok=$TOK orbita_test" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if OUT=$($RUN "$P -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -f $PWD/supabase/tests/concurrency/invite_verify.sql" 2>&1); then :; else FAIL=1; fi
  echo "$OUT" | grep -E "PASS|ERROR|FAIL" || true
fi
# Backup/restore: dump completo -> banco novo -> mesmas contagens, políticas e funções.
echo ">> backup e restauração (pg_dump/pg_restore)"
$RUN "$PGBIN/pg_dump -h $DIR -p $PORT -Fc -f $DIR/backup.dump orbita_test" || FAIL=1
$RUN "$PGBIN/createdb -h $DIR -p $PORT orbita_restore" || FAIL=1
$RUN "$PGBIN/pg_restore -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_restore --no-owner $DIR/backup.dump" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
SNAP="select (select string_agg(relname||'='||n_live_tup, ',' order by relname) from pg_stat_user_tables where schemaname='public') as _x"
COUNTS="select string_agg(c.relname||'='||(xpath('/row/n/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as n from public.%I', c.relname), false, true, '')))[1]::text, ',' order by c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'"
STRUCT="select (select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname='public')||'/'||(select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public')||'/'||(select count(*) from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal)"
A=$($RUN "$PGBIN/psql -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -Atc \"$COUNTS\"")
B=$($RUN "$PGBIN/psql -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_restore -Atc \"$COUNTS\"")
SA=$($RUN "$PGBIN/psql -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_test -Atc \"$STRUCT\"")
SB=$($RUN "$PGBIN/psql -h $DIR -p $PORT -d orbita_restore -Atc \"$STRUCT\"")
if [ -n "$A" ] && [ "$A" = "$B" ] && [ "$SA" = "$SB" ]; then echo "PASS: restauração idêntica (contagens por tabela e $SA políticas/funções/gatilhos)"; else echo "FAIL: restauração diverge"; echo "orig:  $A"; echo "rest:  $B"; echo "estr:  $SA vs $SB"; FAIL=1; fi
[ "$FAIL" = 0 ] && echo "OK: migrações e suítes SQL concluídas" || { echo "ERRO: há suítes com falha"; exit 1; }

ARQUIVO: scripts\verify-supabase.mjs

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Verificação ponta a ponta no Supabase REAL, usando só a anon key (sem service role).
// Uso: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/verify-supabase.mjs
// Pré-requisito: migrações aplicadas e "Confirm email" DESATIVADO no projeto de DEV
// (Authentication → Providers → Email), para o signUp já devolver sessão.
import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
if (!url || !key) throw new Error("Defina NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY");

const results = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = "") => {
  results.push(ok);
  console.log(`${ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}: ${name}${ok || !detail ? "" : ` — ${detail}`}`);
};
const client = () => createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });

async function signUp(tag) {
  const c = client();
  const email = `orbita.${tag}.${Date.now()}.${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)}@gmail.com`;
  const { data, error } = await c.auth.signUp({ email, password: "Teste-Orbita-12345" });
  if (error || !data.session) throw new Error(`signUp ${tag} falhou (${error?.message ?? "sem sessão: desative Confirm email"})`);
  const { data: m } = await c.from("workspace_members").select("workspace_id").eq("user_id", data.user.id).single();
  return { c, id: data.user.id, ws: m?.workspace_id };
}

// 1. anon não lê nada
const anon = client();
for (const t of ["projects", "tasks", "ideas", "profiles", "workspaces", "activity_events"]) {
  const { data, error } = await anon.from(t).select("id").limit(1);
  check(`anon sem acesso a ${t}`, !!error || (data ?? []).length === 0);
}

// 2. dois usuários, isolamento
const A = await signUp("a");
const B = await signUp("b");
check("signup provisiona espaço pessoal", !!A.ws && !!B.ws);

const { data: proj, error: pErr } = await A.c.from("projects").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, title: "Projeto A", created_by: A.id }).select("id").single();
check("A cria projeto no próprio espaço", !pErr && !!proj, pErr?.message);
const { data: bRead } = await B.c.from("projects").select("id").eq("id", proj?.id ?? "");
check("B não lê projeto de A", (bRead ?? []).length === 0);
const { error: bIns } = await B.c.from("projects").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, title: "Invasão", created_by: B.id });
check("B não cria projeto no espaço de A", !!bIns);
const { data: bUpd } = await B.c.from("projects").update({ title: "hack" }).eq("id", proj.id).select();
check("B não edita projeto de A", (bUpd ?? []).length === 0);

// 3. foco único sob concorrência (duas sessões do mesmo usuário, 30 trocas paralelas)
const { data: p2 } = await A.c.from("projects").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, title: "Projeto A2", created_by: A.id }).select("id").single();
const targets = [proj.id, p2.id];
const runs = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => A.c.rpc("set_primary_focus", { p_workspace: A.ws, p_kind: "project", p_target: targets[i % 2] })));
check("30 trocas concorrentes de foco sem erro", runs.every((r) => !r.error), runs.find((r) => r.error)?.error?.message);
const { data: foc } = await A.c.from("focus_assignments").select("target_id").eq("workspace_id", A.ws).eq("kind", "project");
check("exatamente 1 foco de projeto ao final", (foc ?? []).length === 1);

// 4. Etapa 4: conclusão, histórico, conversão, busca
const { data: task } = await A.c.from("tasks").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, project_id: proj.id, title: "Escrever copy", created_by: A.id, assignee_id: A.id }).select("id").single();
await A.c.from("tasks").update({ status: "done" }).eq("id", task.id);
const { data: done } = await A.c.from("tasks").select("completed_at").eq("id", task.id).single();
check("completed_at definido ao concluir", !!done?.completed_at);
await A.c.from("tasks").update({ status: "todo" }).eq("id", task.id);
const { data: undone } = await A.c.from("tasks").select("completed_at").eq("id", task.id).single();
check("completed_at limpo ao desfazer", undone?.completed_at === null);
const { data: ev } = await A.c.from("activity_events").select("verb").eq("entity_id", task.id);
check("histórico registrou created/completed/reopened", ["created", "completed", "reopened"].every((v) => (ev ?? []).some((e) => e.verb === v)));

const { data: idea } = await A.c.from("ideas").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, title: "Organização da casa", created_by: A.id }).select("id").single();
const conv = await A.c.rpc("convert_idea_to_project", { p_idea: idea.id });
check("converter ideia em projeto", !conv.error && !!conv.data, conv.error?.message);
const conv2 = await A.c.rpc("convert_idea_to_project", { p_idea: idea.id });
check("converter duas vezes é recusado", !!conv2.error);
const found = await A.c.rpc("search_workspace", { p_workspace: A.ws, p_query: "organizacao" });
check("busca sem acento encontra", !found.error && (found.data ?? []).length >= 1, found.error?.message);
const leak = await B.c.rpc("search_workspace", { p_workspace: A.ws, p_query: "organizacao" });
check("busca não vaza para B", (leak.data ?? []).length === 0);

// 5. Etapa 6: colaboração (convite, papéis, isolamento, comentários, notificações)
const mkToken = () => { const t = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"); return { t, h: createHash("sha256").update(t, "utf8").digest("hex") }; };
const C = await signUp("c");
const team = await A.c.rpc("create_workspace", { p_name: "Equipe verificação", p_kind: "team" });
check("A cria espaço de equipe", !team.error && !!team.data, team.error?.message);
const TW = team.data;
const personalInvite = await A.c.rpc("create_invitation", { p_workspace: A.ws, p_role: "editor", p_email: null, p_token_hash: mkToken().h });
check("espaço pessoal não aceita convite", !!personalInvite.error);
const inv = mkToken();
const mk = await A.c.rpc("create_invitation", { p_workspace: TW, p_role: "editor", p_email: null, p_token_hash: inv.h });
check("dono cria convite", !mk.error, mk.error?.message);
const bBefore = await B.c.from("projects").select("id").eq("workspace_id", TW);
check("B sem convite aceito não vê o espaço", (bBefore.data ?? []).length === 0);
const { error: selfJoin } = await B.c.from("workspace_members").insert({ workspace_id: TW, user_id: B.id, role: "owner", status: "active" });
check("ninguém entra sem convite (insert direto recusado)", !!selfJoin);
const acc = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => B.c.rpc("accept_invitation", { p_token_hash: inv.h })));
check("convite aceito por exatamente 1 chamada em paralelo", acc.filter((r) => !r.error).length === 1);
const reuse = await C.c.rpc("accept_invitation", { p_token_hash: inv.h });
check("convite não pode ser reutilizado por outra pessoa", !!reuse.error);
const wrong = await C.c.rpc("accept_invitation", { p_token_hash: mkToken().h });
check("token desconhecido é recusado", !!wrong.error);

const tTask = await A.c.from("tasks").insert({ workspace_id: TW, title: "Tarefa da equipe", created_by: A.id }).select("id").single();
check("A cria tarefa no espaço de equipe", !tTask.error, tTask.error?.message);
const bSees = await B.c.from("tasks").select("id").eq("id", tTask.data?.id ?? "");
check("B (editor) vê tarefa da equipe", (bSees.data ?? []).length === 1);
const cSees = await C.c.from("tasks").select("id").eq("id", tTask.data?.id ?? "");
check("C (fora) não vê tarefa da equipe", (cSees.data ?? []).length === 0);
const asg = await A.c.from("tasks").update({ assignee_id: B.id }).eq("id", tTask.data?.id ?? "");
check("atribuir a membro é aceito", !asg.error, asg.error?.message);
const asgOut = await A.c.from("tasks").update({ assignee_id: C.id }).eq("id", tTask.data?.id ?? "");
check("atribuir a quem é de fora é recusado", !!asgOut.error);
const notif = await B.c.from("notifications").select("type").eq("user_id", B.id);
check("B recebeu notificação de atribuição", (notif.data ?? []).some((n) => n.type === "task_assigned"));

const cm = await B.c.from("comments").insert({ workspace_id: TW, entity_type: "task", entity_id: tTask.data?.id, author_id: B.id, body: "Olá equipe" }).select("id").single();
check("B comenta na tarefa", !cm.error, cm.error?.message);
const cOut = await C.c.from("comments").insert({ workspace_id: TW, entity_type: "task", entity_id: tTask.data?.id, author_id: C.id, body: "invasão" });
check("C não comenta em espaço alheio", !!cOut.error);
const aNotif = await A.c.from("notifications").select("type").eq("user_id", A.id);
check("A recebeu notificação do comentário", (aNotif.data ?? []).some((n) => n.type === "comment"));
const forge = await B.c.from("notifications").update({ payload: { forjado: true } }).eq("user_id", B.id).select();
check("notificação é imutável (exceto leitura)", !!forge.error || (forge.data ?? []).length === 0);

const promote = await B.c.rpc("change_member_role", { p_workspace: TW, p_user: B.id, p_role: "owner" });
check("editor não se promove a dono", !!promote.error);
const rm = await A.c.rpc("remove_member", { p_workspace: TW, p_user: B.id });
check("dono remove membro", !rm.error, rm.error?.message);
const bAfter = await B.c.from("tasks").select("id").eq("id", tTask.data?.id ?? "");
check("membro removido perde acesso", (bAfter.data ?? []).length === 0);
const lastLeave = await A.c.rpc("leave_workspace", { p_workspace: TW });
check("último dono não consegue sair", !!lastLeave.error);

// 6. Etapa 7: portfólio não listado
const pj = await A.c.from("projects").insert({ workspace_id: A.ws, title: "Projeto público", created_by: A.id }).select("id").single();
const ptk = mkToken();
const pub = await A.c.rpc("publish_portfolio", { p_project: pj.data?.id, p_summary: "Resumo", p_token_hash: ptk.h });
check("publicar portfólio", !pub.error, pub.error?.message);
const ent = await A.c.from("portfolio_entries").select("id, slug").eq("project_id", pj.data?.id ?? "").single();
const open1 = await anon.rpc("get_public_portfolio", { p_slug: ent.data?.slug, p_token_hash: ptk.h });
check("visitante anônimo abre com slug + token", (open1.data ?? []).length === 1);
const open2 = await anon.rpc("get_public_portfolio", { p_slug: ent.data?.slug, p_token_hash: mkToken().h });
check("token errado não abre", (open2.data ?? []).length === 0);
const direct = await anon.from("portfolio_entries").select("id");
check("anônimo não lê a tabela", !!direct.error || (direct.data ?? []).length === 0);
const hashCol = await A.c.from("portfolio_entries").select("access_token_hash");
check("membro não lê o hash do token", !!hashCol.error);
const rv = await A.c.rpc("revoke_portfolio", { p_entry: ent.data?.id });
const open3 = await anon.rpc("get_public_portfolio", { p_slug: ent.data?.slug, p_token_hash: ptk.h });
check("link revogado fecha na hora", !rv.error && (open3.data ?? []).length === 0);

console.log(`\n${results.filter(Boolean).length}/${results.length} verificações passaram`);
console.log("Limpeza: apague os usuários orbita.*@example.com em Authentication → Users (cascata remove os dados).");
process.exit(results.every(Boolean) ? 0 : 1);

-- Perfis, espaços, membros, foco único, projetos, tarefas, ideias, cursos,
-- arquivos, notas, colaboração e portfólio. RLS em todas as tabelas expostas.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tipos
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create type public.workspace_kind as enum ('personal', 'team', 'client');
create type public.workspace_role as enum (
  'owner', 'admin', 'editor', 'collaborator', 'reader'
);
create type public.member_status as enum ('active', 'suspended');
create type public.focus_scope as enum ('workspace', 'user');
create type public.focus_kind as enum ('project', 'course');
create type public.project_stage as enum (
  'idea', 'research', 'planning', 'design', 'build',
  'review', 'launch', 'follow_up', 'done'
);
create type public.project_status as enum ('active', 'paused', 'completed');
create type public.priority as enum ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent');
create type public.task_status as enum ('todo', 'in_progress', 'done');
create type public.idea_state as enum (
  'new', 'evaluating', 'validated', 'not_prioritized', 'converted'
);
create type public.idea_potential as enum ('low', 'medium', 'high');
create type public.course_status as enum (
  'planned', 'in_progress', 'paused', 'completed'
);
create type public.file_status as enum (
  'pending', 'ready', 'quarantined', 'deleted'
);
create type public.portfolio_visibility as enum ('private', 'unlisted', 'public');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Perfis e preferências
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  full_name text not null default '',
  avatar_url text,
  timezone text not null default 'America/Sao_Paulo',
  locale text not null default 'pt-BR',
  onboarding_done_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint profiles_full_name_length check (char_length(full_name) <= 120)
);

create table public.user_preferences (
  user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  theme text not null default 'system'
    check (theme in ('system', 'light', 'dark')),
  start_of_week smallint not null default 1
    check (start_of_week between 0 and 6),
  notification_prefs jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Espaços e pessoas
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.workspaces (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  slug text not null unique,
  kind public.workspace_kind not null default 'personal',
  focus_scope public.focus_scope not null default 'workspace',
  settings jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  constraint workspaces_name_length check (
    char_length(name) between 1 and 80
  ),
  constraint workspaces_slug_format check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{3,80}$')
);

create table public.workspace_members (
  workspace_id uuid not null references public.workspaces (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  role public.workspace_role not null default 'collaborator',
  status public.member_status not null default 'active',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (workspace_id, user_id)
);

create table public.invitations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id uuid not null references public.workspaces (id) on delete cascade,
  email text,
  role public.workspace_role not null default 'collaborator'
    check (role <> 'owner'),
  token_hash text not null unique,
  expires_at timestamptz not null default now() + interval '7 days',
  accepted_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  invited_by uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint invitations_email_lowercase check (
    email is null or email = lower(email)
  )
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Foco único (projeto/curso principal)

create table public.focus_assignments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id uuid not null references public.workspaces (id) on delete cascade,
  kind public.focus_kind not null,
  -- 'workspace' ou o id do usuário, derivado de workspaces.focus_scope.
  scope_key text not null,
  target_id uuid not null,
  set_by uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  set_at timestamptz not null default now(),

);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Projetos, tarefas, ideias
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.projects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id uuid not null references public.workspaces (id) on delete cascade,
  title text not null,
  objective text,
  description text,
  stage public.project_stage not null default 'idea',
  status public.project_status not null default 'active',
  priority public.priority not null default 'medium',
  start_date date,
  due_date date,
  owner_id uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null,
  progress_mode text not null default 'tasks'
    check (progress_mode in ('tasks', 'stages')),
  risks text,
  next_step text,
  cover_url text,
  archived_at timestamptz,
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint projects_title_length check (
    char_length(title) between 1 and 160
  ),
  constraint projects_dates_order check (
    start_date is null or due_date is null or start_date <= due_date
  )
);

create table public.tasks (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

  description text,
  assignee_id uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null,
  due_date date,
  priority public.priority not null default 'medium',
  status public.task_status not null default 'todo',
  weight numeric(6, 2) not null default 1 check (weight > 0),
  estimate_min integer check (estimate_min is null or estimate_min >= 0),
  spent_min integer check (spent_min is null or spent_min >= 0),
  position numeric not null default 0,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  archived_at timestamptz,
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint tasks_title_length check (char_length(title) between 1 and 200),
  constraint tasks_not_own_parent check (parent_task_id is null or parent_task_id <> id)
);

create table public.task_checklists (

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Funções auxiliares de permissão (SECURITY DEFINER evita recursão de RLS)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.is_workspace_member(p_workspace uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.workspace_members m
    where m.workspace_id = p_workspace
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.status = 'active'
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.has_workspace_role(
  p_workspace uuid,
  p_minimum public.workspace_role
)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.workspace_members m
    where m.workspace_id = p_workspace
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.status = 'active'
      and array_position(
        array['reader', 'collaborator', 'editor', 'admin', 'owner'],
        m.role::text
      ) >= array_position(
        array['reader', 'collaborator', 'editor', 'admin', 'owner'],
        p_minimum::text
      )
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.shares_workspace_with(p_user uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.workspace_members me
    join public.workspace_members them
      on them.workspace_id = me.workspace_id
    where me.user_id = auth.uid()
      and me.status = 'active'
      and them.user_id = p_user
      and them.status = 'active'
  );
$$;

revoke all on function public.is_workspace_member(uuid) from public;
revoke all on function public.has_workspace_role(uuid, public.workspace_role)
  from public;
revoke all on function public.shares_workspace_with(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.is_workspace_member(uuid) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.has_workspace_role(uuid, public.workspace_role)
  to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.shares_workspace_with(uuid) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- updated_at
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.set_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

do $$
declare
  t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'profiles', 'user_preferences', 'workspaces', 'workspace_members',
    'projects', 'tasks', 'task_checklists', 'ideas', 'courses',
    'course_modules', 'notes', 'folders', 'files_metadata', 'comments',
    'tags', 'portfolio_entries'
  ]
  loop
    execute format(
      'create trigger %I before update on public.%I
       for each row execute function public.set_updated_at()',
      t || '_set_updated_at', t
    );
  end loop;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Provisionamento de novos usuários
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_name text;
  v_slug text;
begin
  v_name := coalesce(
    nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name'), ''),
    split_part(new.email, '@', 1),
    'Você'
  );

  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name)
  values (new.id, v_name)
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.user_preferences (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  -- UUID completo: único por construção, então o cadastro nunca falha por colisão.
  v_slug := 'espaco-' || replace(new.id::text, '-', '');

  insert into public.workspaces (name, slug, kind, owner_id)
  values ('Meu espaço', v_slug, 'personal', new.id);

  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

create or replace function public.handle_new_workspace()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id, role, status)
  values (new.id, new.owner_id, 'owner', 'active')
  on conflict (workspace_id, user_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger on_workspace_created
  after insert on public.workspaces
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_workspace();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Validação do foco único
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.validate_focus_assignment()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_scope public.focus_scope;
  v_target_exists boolean;
begin
  select focus_scope into v_scope
  from public.workspaces
  where id = new.workspace_id and deleted_at is null;

  if v_scope is null then
    raise exception 'workspace_not_found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if v_scope = 'workspace' and new.scope_key <> 'workspace' then
    raise exception 'focus_scope_mismatch' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if v_scope = 'user' and new.scope_key <> new.set_by::text then
    raise exception 'focus_scope_mismatch' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if new.kind = 'project' then
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.projects
      where id = new.target_id
        and workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and deleted_at is null
    ) into v_target_exists;
  else
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.courses
      where id = new.target_id
        and workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and deleted_at is null
    ) into v_target_exists;
  end if;

  if not v_target_exists then
    raise exception 'invalid_focus_target' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger focus_assignments_validate
  before insert or update on public.focus_assignments
  for each row execute function public.validate_focus_assignment();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RPC: definir foco com serialização (duas abas não vencem juntas)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.set_primary_focus(
  p_workspace uuid,
  p_kind public.focus_kind,
  p_target uuid
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_scope public.focus_scope;
  v_scope_key text;
  v_target_title text;
  v_previous_target uuid;
  v_previous_title text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'editor') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  -- Serializa trocas concorrentes no mesmo workspace.
  select focus_scope into v_scope
  from public.workspaces
  where id = p_workspace and deleted_at is null
  for update;

  if v_scope is null then
    raise exception 'workspace_not_found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  v_scope_key := case
    when v_scope = 'user' then v_user::text
    else 'workspace'
  end;

  if p_kind = 'project' then
    select title into v_target_title
    from public.projects
    where id = p_target
      and workspace_id = p_workspace
      and deleted_at is null;

    select fa.target_id, p.title
      into v_previous_target, v_previous_title
    from public.focus_assignments fa
    left join public.projects p on p.id = fa.target_id
    where fa.workspace_id = p_workspace
      and fa.kind = 'project'
      and fa.scope_key = v_scope_key;
  else
    select title into v_target_title
    from public.courses
    where id = p_target
      and workspace_id = p_workspace
      and deleted_at is null;

    select fa.target_id, c.title
      into v_previous_target, v_previous_title
    from public.focus_assignments fa
    left join public.courses c on c.id = fa.target_id
    where fa.workspace_id = p_workspace
      and fa.kind = 'course'
      and fa.scope_key = v_scope_key;
  end if;

  if v_target_title is null then
    raise exception 'invalid_focus_target' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  insert into public.focus_assignments (
    workspace_id, kind, scope_key, target_id, set_by
  )
  values (p_workspace, p_kind, v_scope_key, p_target, v_user)
  on conflict (workspace_id, kind, scope_key)
  do update set
    target_id = excluded.target_id,
    set_by = excluded.set_by,
    set_at = now();

  insert into public.activity_events (
    workspace_id, actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, metadata
  )
  values (
    p_workspace,
    v_user,
    'focus_changed',
    p_kind::text,
    p_target,
    jsonb_build_object('previous_target_id', v_previous_target)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'scope_key', v_scope_key,
    'target_id', p_target,
    'target_title', v_target_title,
    'previous_target_id', v_previous_target,
    'previous_title', v_previous_title
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.set_primary_focus(
  uuid, public.focus_kind, uuid
) from public;
grant execute on function public.set_primary_focus(
  uuid, public.focus_kind, uuid
) to authenticated;

-- ÓRBITA — 0002: MVP pessoal (Etapa 4)
-- Histórico automático, consistência de conclusão, conversão de ideia em
-- projeto e busca textual. Tudo respeita RLS (funções SECURITY INVOKER),
-- exceto o log de atividade, que precisa gravar mesmo para papéis restritos.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. completed_at sempre coerente com o status da tarefa
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.sync_task_completed_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.status = 'done' then
    if tg_op = 'INSERT' or old.status is distinct from 'done' then
      new.completed_at := coalesce(new.completed_at, now());
    end if;
  else
    new.completed_at := null;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger tasks_sync_completed_at
  before insert or update of status on public.tasks
  for each row execute function public.sync_task_completed_at();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Histórico: eventos relevantes de projetos, tarefas, ideias e cursos
--    (edições comuns e mudanças só de posição não geram evento)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.log_entity_activity()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_new jsonb := to_jsonb(new);
  v_old jsonb;
  v_verb text;
  v_from text;
  v_to text;
  v_type text := case tg_table_name
    when 'projects' then 'project' when 'tasks' then 'task'
    when 'ideas' then 'idea' else 'course' end;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    v_verb := 'created';
  else
    v_old := to_jsonb(old);
    if v_old->>'deleted_at' is null and v_new->>'deleted_at' is not null then
      v_verb := 'trashed';
    elsif v_old->>'deleted_at' is not null and v_new->>'deleted_at' is null then
      v_verb := 'restored';
    elsif v_old->>'archived_at' is null and v_new->>'archived_at' is not null then
      v_verb := 'archived';
    elsif v_old->>'archived_at' is not null and v_new->>'archived_at' is null then
      v_verb := 'unarchived';
    elsif tg_table_name = 'tasks' and v_old->>'status' is distinct from v_new->>'status' then
      v_from := v_old->>'status'; v_to := v_new->>'status';
      v_verb := case when v_to = 'done' then 'completed'
                     when v_from = 'done' then 'reopened'
                     else 'status_changed' end;
    elsif tg_table_name = 'ideas' and v_old->>'state' is distinct from v_new->>'state' then
      v_from := v_old->>'state'; v_to := v_new->>'state';
      v_verb := case when v_to = 'converted' then 'converted' else 'state_changed' end;
    elsif tg_table_name = 'projects' and v_old->>'stage' is distinct from v_new->>'stage' then
      v_from := v_old->>'stage'; v_to := v_new->>'stage';
      v_verb := 'stage_changed';
    elsif tg_table_name in ('projects', 'courses') and v_old->>'status' is distinct from v_new->>'status' then
      v_from := v_old->>'status'; v_to := v_new->>'status';
      v_verb := 'status_changed';
    else
      return new;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.activity_events (
    workspace_id, actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, metadata
  )
  values (
    new.workspace_id, auth.uid(), v_verb, v_type, new.id,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'title', v_new->>'title', 'from', v_from, 'to', v_to
    ))
  );
  return new;
end;
$$;

do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array['projects', 'tasks', 'ideas', 'courses'] loop
    execute format(
      'create trigger %I after insert or update on public.%I
       for each row execute function public.log_entity_activity()',
      t || '_log_activity', t
    );
  end loop;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Converter ideia em projeto (atômico; usa as políticas do chamador)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.convert_idea_to_project(p_idea uuid)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_idea public.ideas%rowtype;
  v_project uuid;
begin
  select * into v_idea
  from public.ideas
  where id = p_idea and deleted_at is null
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'idea_not_found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;
  if v_idea.state = 'converted' then
    raise exception 'already_converted' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  insert into public.projects (workspace_id, title, description, stage, created_by, owner_id)
  values (v_idea.workspace_id, v_idea.title, v_idea.body, 'planning', auth.uid(), auth.uid())
  returning id into v_project;

  update public.ideas
  set state = 'converted', converted_project_id = v_project
  where id = p_idea;

  return v_project;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.convert_idea_to_project(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.convert_idea_to_project(uuid) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Busca textual (sem acento, sem diferenciar caixa, curingas literais)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.fold_text(p_text text)
returns text
language sql
immutable
parallel safe
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select lower(translate(
    coalesce(p_text, ''),
    'ÁÀÂÃÄáàâãäÉÈÊËéèêëÍÌÎÏíìîïÓÒÔÕÖóòôõöÚÙÛÜúùûüÇçÑñ',
    'AAAAAaaaaaEEEEeeeeIIIIiiiiOOOOOoooooUUUUuuuuCcNn'
  ))
$$;

create or replace function public.search_workspace(
  p_workspace uuid,
  p_query text,
  p_limit integer default 20
)
returns table (entity_type text, id uuid, title text, snippet text, rank integer)
language sql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
  with q as (
    select '%' || replace(replace(replace(
      public.fold_text(trim(p_query)), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' as pat
  ),
  hits as (
    select 'idea'::text as entity_type, i.id, i.title, i.body as extra,
           i.created_at as ts
    from public.ideas i
    where i.workspace_id = p_workspace and i.deleted_at is null and i.archived_at is null
    union all
    select 'project', p.id, p.title, coalesce(p.objective, p.description), p.created_at
    from public.projects p
    where p.workspace_id = p_workspace and p.deleted_at is null and p.archived_at is null
    union all
    select 'task', t.id, t.title, t.description, t.created_at
    from public.tasks t
    where t.workspace_id = p_workspace and t.deleted_at is null and t.archived_at is null
    union all
    select 'course', c.id, c.title, coalesce(c.objective, c.next_lesson), c.created_at
    from public.courses c
    where c.workspace_id = p_workspace and c.deleted_at is null and c.archived_at is null
  )
  select h.entity_type, h.id, h.title,
         left(coalesce(h.extra, ''), 140) as snippet,
         case when public.fold_text(h.title) like q.pat escape '\' then 0 else 1 end as rank
  from hits h, q
  where char_length(trim(p_query)) >= 2
    and (public.fold_text(h.title) like q.pat escape '\'
         or public.fold_text(h.extra) like q.pat escape '\')
  order by 5, h.ts desc
  limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1), 50)
$$;

revoke all on function public.search_workspace(uuid, text, integer) from public;
grant execute on function public.search_workspace(uuid, text, integer) to authenticated;

-- ============================================================================
-- ÓRBITA — 0003: arquivos (Etapa 5)
-- Cota atômica, ciclo de upload (pending → ready | quarantined), políticas do
-- Storage, expurgo de lixeira (30 dias) e de uploads pendentes (24 h).
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Cota de 1 GiB por espaço, serializada por espaço -------------------------
create or replace function public.enforce_file_quota()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_used bigint;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(new.workspace_id::text, 0));
  select coalesce(sum(size_bytes), 0) into v_used
  from public.files_metadata
  where workspace_id = new.workspace_id
    and deleted_at is null
    and status in ('pending', 'ready');

  if v_used + new.size_bytes > 1073741824 then
    raise exception 'quota_exceeded' using errcode = '53400';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger files_metadata_enforce_quota
  before insert on public.files_metadata
  for each row execute function public.enforce_file_quota();

-- 2. Iniciar upload: valida e cria o registro pendente (sob RLS do chamador) ---
create or replace function public.begin_file_upload(
  p_workspace uuid,
  p_name text,
  p_size bigint,
  p_mime text,
  p_entity_type text default null,
  p_entity_id uuid default null
)
returns table (id uuid, storage_path text)
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_name text := btrim(p_name);
  v_ext text := lower(substring(btrim(p_name) from '\.([^.]+)$'));
begin
  if v_name is null or char_length(v_name) not between 1 and 255
     or v_name ~ '[/\\]' or v_name ~ '[[:cntrl:]]' then
    raise exception 'invalid_file_name' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_size is null or p_size <= 0 or p_size > 26214400 then
    raise exception 'invalid_file_size' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if v_ext = any (array[
    'exe','bat','cmd','com','scr','msi','dll','js','mjs','cjs','vbs','ps1',
    'sh','jar','apk','html','htm','xhtml','svg','php','py','rb','pl','swf'
  ]) then
    raise exception 'blocked_file_type' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  insert into public.files_metadata (
    id, workspace_id, storage_path, file_name, mime, size_bytes,
    entity_type, entity_id, created_by
  )
  values (
    v_id, p_workspace, 'ws/' || p_workspace || '/' || v_id, v_name,
    lower(btrim(p_mime)), p_size, p_entity_type, p_entity_id, auth.uid()
  );

  return query select v_id, 'ws/' || p_workspace || '/' || v_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.begin_file_upload(uuid, text, bigint, text, text, uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.begin_file_upload(uuid, text, bigint, text, text, uuid) to authenticated;

-- 3. Concluir upload: o servidor decide (tamanho/assinatura) e o banco aplica ---
create or replace function public.finalize_file_upload(
  p_file uuid,
  p_ok boolean,
  p_checksum text default null,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns public.file_status
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_file public.files_metadata%rowtype;
  v_status public.file_status;
begin
  select * into v_file
  from public.files_metadata
  where id = p_file and deleted_at is null
  for update;

  if not found or v_file.status <> 'pending' then
    raise exception 'file_not_pending' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  v_status := case when p_ok then 'ready' else 'quarantined' end;
  update public.files_metadata
  set status = v_status, checksum = p_checksum
  where id = p_file;

  insert into public.activity_events (
    workspace_id, actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, metadata
  )
  values (
    v_file.workspace_id, auth.uid(),
    case when p_ok then 'file_uploaded' else 'file_quarantined' end,
    'file', p_file,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('title', v_file.file_name, 'reason', p_reason))
  );

  return v_status;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.finalize_file_upload(uuid, boolean, text, text) from public;
grant execute on function public.finalize_file_upload(uuid, boolean, text, text) to authenticated;

-- 4. Expurgo (somente service_role): duas fases para não deixar objetos órfãos --
create or replace function public.list_expired_files(
  p_trash_days integer default 30,
  p_pending_hours integer default 24
)
returns table (id uuid, storage_path text)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select f.id, f.storage_path
  from public.files_metadata f
  where (f.deleted_at is not null
         and f.deleted_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_trash_days))
     or (f.status = 'pending'
         and f.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => p_pending_hours))
$$;

create or replace function public.delete_purged_files(p_ids uuid[])
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  delete from public.files_metadata where id = any (p_ids);
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.list_expired_files(integer, integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.delete_purged_files(uuid[]) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.list_expired_files(integer, integer) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.delete_purged_files(uuid[]) to service_role;

-- 5. Storage: bucket privado e políticas por espaço -----------------------------
create or replace function public.storage_workspace_id(p_name text)
returns uuid
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select case
    when p_name ~ '^ws/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[0-9a-f-]{36}$'
    then (split_part(p_name, '/', 2))::uuid
  end
$$;

do $$
begin
  if exists (select 1 from pg_namespace where nspname = 'storage') then
    insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit)
    values ('workspace-files', 'workspace-files', false, 26214400)
    on conflict (id) do update
      set public = false, file_size_limit = 26214400;

    drop policy if exists workspace_files_select on storage.objects;
    create policy workspace_files_select on storage.objects
      for select to authenticated
      using (
        bucket_id = 'workspace-files'
        and public.is_workspace_member(public.storage_workspace_id(name))
      );

    drop policy if exists workspace_files_insert on storage.objects;
    create policy workspace_files_insert on storage.objects
      for insert to authenticated
      with check (
        bucket_id = 'workspace-files'
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.files_metadata f
          where f.storage_path = name
            and f.workspace_id = public.storage_workspace_id(name)
            and f.status = 'pending'
            and f.created_by = auth.uid()
        )
      );
    -- Sem políticas de update/delete: remoção de objetos é feita só pelo job com service_role.
  end if;
end;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- ÓRBITA — 0004: colaboração (Etapa 6)
-- Espaços de equipe, convites (hash, 7 dias, uso único), papéis, atribuições,
-- comentários e notificações internas.
-- ============================================================================

-- 0. Aceite registrado ---------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.invitations
  add column accepted_by uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null;

-- 1. Ninguém entra num espaço sem aceitar um convite ----------------------------
-- A política antiga deixava um admin inserir qualquer usuário direto em
-- workspace_members. A entrada passa a existir só por accept_invitation (e pelo
-- gatilho que cria o proprietário).
drop policy if exists workspace_members_insert on public.workspace_members;

create or replace function public.guard_member_change()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    if new.workspace_id <> old.workspace_id or new.user_id <> old.user_id then
      raise exception 'member_identity_immutable' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if new.role = 'admin' and old.role <> 'admin'
       and auth.uid() is not null
       and not public.has_workspace_role(old.workspace_id, 'owner') then
      raise exception 'only_owner_grants_admin' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Só o proprietário altera ou remove administradores (exceto a própria saída).
  if old.role = 'admin'
     and auth.uid() is not null
     and old.user_id <> auth.uid()
     and not public.has_workspace_role(old.workspace_id, 'owner') then
    raise exception 'only_owner_manages_admin' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end;
end;
$$;

create trigger workspace_members_guard
  before update or delete on public.workspace_members
  for each row execute function public.guard_member_change();

-- Quem sai ou é removido deixa de ser responsável por tarefas do espaço.
create or replace function public.unassign_removed_member()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  update public.tasks
  set assignee_id = null
  where workspace_id = old.workspace_id and assignee_id = old.user_id;
  return old;
end;
$$;

create trigger workspace_members_unassign
  after delete on public.workspace_members
  for each row execute function public.unassign_removed_member();

-- 2. Criar espaço de equipe/cliente ------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.create_workspace(
  p_name text,
  p_kind public.workspace_kind default 'team'
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_name text := btrim(coalesce(p_name, ''));
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;
  if p_kind not in ('team', 'client') then
    raise exception 'invalid_workspace_kind' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if char_length(v_name) not between 1 and 80 then
    raise exception 'invalid_workspace_name' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  insert into public.workspaces (id, name, slug, kind, owner_id)
  values (v_id, v_name, 'equipe-' || replace(v_id::text, '-', ''), p_kind, auth.uid());
  -- o gatilho on_workspace_created adiciona o proprietário como membro
  return v_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_workspace(text, public.workspace_kind) from public;
grant execute on function public.create_workspace(text, public.workspace_kind) to authenticated;

-- 3. Convites ------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.create_invitation(
  p_workspace uuid,
  p_role public.workspace_role,
  p_email text,
  p_token_hash text
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_kind public.workspace_kind;
  v_pending integer;
begin
  select kind into v_kind from public.workspaces where id = p_workspace and deleted_at is null;
  if not found or not public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'admin') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if v_kind = 'personal' then
    raise exception 'personal_workspace' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_role = 'admin' and not public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'owner') then
    raise exception 'only_owner_grants_admin' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_token_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'invalid_token_hash' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_pending
  from public.invitations
  where workspace_id = p_workspace
    and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null and expires_at > now();
  if v_pending >= 20 then
    raise exception 'too_many_invitations' using errcode = '53400';
  end if;

  insert into public.invitations (workspace_id, email, role, token_hash, invited_by)
  values (p_workspace, nullif(lower(btrim(p_email)), ''), p_role, p_token_hash, auth.uid())
  returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.revoke_invitation(p_invitation uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  update public.invitations
  set revoked_at = now()
  where id = p_invitation and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'invitation_not_revocable' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
end;
$$;

-- Prévia: mostra espaço e papel ANTES de aceitar. Só para quem está logado.
create or replace function public.preview_invitation(p_token_hash text)
returns table (
  workspace_name text,
  role public.workspace_role,
  email_bound boolean,
  email_matches boolean,
  state text,
  invited_by_name text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select w.name,
         i.role,
         i.email is not null,
         i.email is null
           or i.email = (select lower(u.email) from auth.users u where u.id = auth.uid()),
         case when i.accepted_at is not null then 'used'
              when i.revoked_at is not null then 'revoked'
              when i.expires_at <= now() then 'expired'
              else 'valid' end,
         p.full_name
  from public.invitations i
  join public.workspaces w on w.id = i.workspace_id and w.deleted_at is null
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = i.invited_by
  where i.token_hash = p_token_hash
    and auth.uid() is not null
$$;

-- Aceite atômico: a linha do convite fica travada, então dois aceites simultâneos
-- nunca passam os dois.
create or replace function public.accept_invitation(p_token_hash text)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_inv public.invitations%rowtype;
  v_email text;
  v_member public.workspace_members%rowtype;
  v_name text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select i.* into v_inv
  from public.invitations i
  join public.workspaces w on w.id = i.workspace_id and w.deleted_at is null
  where i.token_hash = p_token_hash
  for update of i;

  if not found then raise exception 'invitation_invalid'; end if;
  if v_inv.accepted_at is not null then raise exception 'invitation_used'; end if;
  if v_inv.revoked_at is not null then raise exception 'invitation_revoked'; end if;
  if v_inv.expires_at <= now() then raise exception 'invitation_expired'; end if;

  if v_inv.email is not null then
    select lower(email) into v_email from auth.users where id = v_user;
    if v_email is distinct from v_inv.email then
      raise exception 'invitation_email_mismatch';
    end if;
  end if;

  select * into v_member
  from public.workspace_members
  where workspace_id = v_inv.workspace_id and user_id = v_user;
  if found then
    raise exception '%', case when v_member.status = 'suspended'
                              then 'membership_suspended' else 'already_member' end;
  end if;

  insert into public.workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id, role, status)
  values (v_inv.workspace_id, v_user, v_inv.role, 'active');

  update public.invitations
  set accepted_at = now(), accepted_by = v_user
  where id = v_inv.id;

  select full_name into v_name from public.profiles where id = v_user;
  insert into public.notifications (workspace_id, user_id, type, payload)
  values (v_inv.workspace_id, v_inv.invited_by, 'invitation_accepted',
          jsonb_build_object('by', v_user, 'by_name', v_name, 'role', v_inv.role));
  insert into public.activity_events (workspace_id, actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
  values (v_inv.workspace_id, v_user, 'member_joined', 'workspace', v_inv.workspace_id,
          jsonb_build_object('title', v_name, 'role', v_inv.role));

  return v_inv.workspace_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_invitation(uuid, public.workspace_role, text, text) from public;
revoke all on function public.revoke_invitation(uuid) from public;
revoke all on function public.preview_invitation(text) from public;
revoke all on function public.accept_invitation(text) from public;
grant execute on function public.create_invitation(uuid, public.workspace_role, text, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.revoke_invitation(uuid) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.preview_invitation(text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.accept_invitation(text) to authenticated;

-- 4. Pessoas: diretório (e-mail só para admin/proprietário), papéis, saída ----------
create or replace function public.list_workspace_members(p_workspace uuid)
returns table (
  user_id uuid, full_name text, email text,
  role public.workspace_role, status public.member_status, joined_at timestamptz
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select m.user_id,
         p.full_name,
         case when public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'admin') then u.email end,
         m.role, m.status, m.created_at
  from public.workspace_members m
  join public.profiles p on p.id = m.user_id
  left join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
  where m.workspace_id = p_workspace
    and public.is_workspace_member(p_workspace)
  order by m.created_at
$$;

create or replace function public.change_member_role(
  p_workspace uuid, p_user uuid, p_role public.workspace_role
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'admin') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_role = 'owner' then
    raise exception 'owner_not_assignable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_user = auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'cannot_change_self' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.workspace_members
  set role = p_role
  where workspace_id = p_workspace and user_id = p_user and role <> 'owner';
  if not found then
    raise exception 'member_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.notifications (workspace_id, user_id, type, payload)
  values (p_workspace, p_user, 'role_changed',
          jsonb_build_object('role', p_role, 'by', auth.uid()));
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.remove_member(p_workspace uuid, p_user uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not public.has_workspace_role(p_workspace, 'admin') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_user = auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'use_leave_workspace' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  delete from public.workspace_members
  where workspace_id = p_workspace and user_id = p_user and role <> 'owner';
  if not found then
    raise exception 'member_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.notifications (workspace_id, user_id, type, payload)
  values (null, p_user, 'removed_from_workspace',
          jsonb_build_object('workspace_id', p_workspace, 'by', auth.uid()));
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.leave_workspace(p_workspace uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_role public.workspace_role; v_kind public.workspace_kind;
begin
  select m.role, w.kind into v_role, v_kind
  from public.workspace_members m
  join public.workspaces w on w.id = m.workspace_id
  where m.workspace_id = p_workspace and m.user_id = auth.uid() and m.status = 'active';

  if not found then raise exception 'not_a_member' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_role = 'owner' then raise exception 'owner_cannot_leave' using errcode = '22023'; end if;

  delete from public.workspace_members
  where workspace_id = p_workspace and user_id = auth.uid();
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.list_workspace_members(uuid) from public;
revoke all on function public.change_member_role(uuid, uuid, public.workspace_role) from public;
revoke all on function public.remove_member(uuid, uuid) from public;
revoke all on function public.leave_workspace(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.list_workspace_members(uuid) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.change_member_role(uuid, uuid, public.workspace_role) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.remove_member(uuid, uuid) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.leave_workspace(uuid) to authenticated;

-- 5. Atribuição de tarefas ---------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.validate_task_assignee()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_role public.workspace_role;
begin
  if new.assignee_id is null then return new; end if;
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.assignee_id is not distinct from old.assignee_id then
    return new;
  end if;

  select role into v_role
  from public.workspace_members
  where workspace_id = new.workspace_id and user_id = new.assignee_id and status = 'active';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'assignee_not_member' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  if v_role = 'reader' then
    raise exception 'assignee_cannot_work' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger tasks_validate_assignee
  before insert or update of assignee_id on public.tasks
  for each row execute function public.validate_task_assignee();

create or replace function public.notify_task_assigned()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.assignee_id is not null
     and new.assignee_id is distinct from auth.uid()
     and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or new.assignee_id is distinct from old.assignee_id) then
    insert into public.notifications (workspace_id, user_id, type, payload)
    values (new.workspace_id, new.assignee_id, 'task_assigned',
            jsonb_build_object('task_id', new.id, 'title', new.title, 'by', auth.uid()));
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger tasks_notify_assigned
  after insert or update of assignee_id on public.tasks
  for each row execute function public.notify_task_assigned();

-- 6. Comentários ------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.validate_comment()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_exists boolean;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    execute format(
      'select exists (select 1 from public.%I where id = $1 and workspace_id = $2 and deleted_at is null)',
      case new.entity_type
        when 'project' then 'projects' when 'task' then 'tasks'
        when 'course' then 'courses' when 'idea' then 'ideas'
        else 'files_metadata' end)
    into v_exists using new.entity_id, new.workspace_id;
    if not v_exists then
      raise exception 'entity_not_found' using errcode = '23503';
    end if;
  else
    if new.workspace_id <> old.workspace_id or new.entity_type <> old.entity_type
       or new.entity_id <> old.entity_id or new.author_id <> old.author_id then
      raise exception 'comment_identity_immutable' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if new.body is distinct from old.body then
      new.edited_at := now();
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger comments_validate
  before insert or update on public.comments
  for each row execute function public.validate_comment();

create or replace function public.notify_comment()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_people uuid[] := '{}';
  v_title text;
begin
  case new.entity_type
    when 'task' then
      select array[created_by, assignee_id], title into v_people, v_title
      from public.tasks where id = new.entity_id;
    when 'project' then
      select array[created_by, owner_id], title into v_people, v_title
      from public.projects where id = new.entity_id;
    when 'idea' then
      select array[created_by], title into v_people, v_title
      from public.ideas where id = new.entity_id;
    when 'course' then
      select array[created_by], title into v_people, v_title
      from public.courses where id = new.entity_id;
    else
      select array[created_by], file_name into v_people, v_title
      from public.files_metadata where id = new.entity_id;
  end case;

  v_people := coalesce(v_people, '{}') || coalesce((
    select array_agg(distinct c.author_id)
    from public.comments c
    where c.entity_type = new.entity_type and c.entity_id = new.entity_id
      and c.id <> new.id and c.deleted_at is null
  ), '{}');

  insert into public.notifications (workspace_id, user_id, type, payload)
  select new.workspace_id, m.user_id, 'comment',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'comment_id', new.id, 'entity_type', new.entity_type,
           'entity_id', new.entity_id, 'title', v_title,
           'by', new.author_id, 'excerpt', left(new.body, 120))
  from public.workspace_members m
  where m.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
    and m.status = 'active'
    and m.user_id = any (v_people)
    and m.user_id <> new.author_id;

  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger comments_notify
  after insert on public.comments
  for each row execute function public.notify_comment();

-- Autor ou admin apagam (exclusão lógica); admin não edita texto alheio.
create or replace function public.delete_comment(p_comment uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_c public.comments%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_c from public.comments where id = p_comment and deleted_at is null;
  if not found then raise exception 'comment_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if v_c.author_id <> auth.uid() and not public.has_workspace_role(v_c.workspace_id, 'admin') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  update public.comments set deleted_at = now() where id = p_comment;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.delete_comment(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.delete_comment(uuid) to authenticated;

-- 7. Notificações: só read_at muda; criação só por gatilho/RPC ---------------------------
create or replace function public.guard_notification_update()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if (new.id, new.workspace_id, new.user_id, new.type, new.payload, new.created_at)
     is distinct from
     (old.id, old.workspace_id, old.user_id, old.type, old.payload, old.created_at) then
    raise exception 'notification_immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger notifications_guard
  before update on public.notifications
  for each row execute function public.guard_notification_update();

create or replace function public.mark_notifications_read(p_ids uuid[] default null)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  update public.notifications
  set read_at = now()
  where user_id = auth.uid() and read_at is null
    and (p_ids is null or id = any (p_ids));
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.mark_notifications_read(uuid[]) from public;
grant execute on function public.mark_notifications_read(uuid[]) to authenticated;
